lkoṣ+ṭha)ngan bskul byas te ci lin wan po hran (tshim(tsho1)gyi dmangs zhing btsan 'phrog byed du bcug pas/ sa de'i mang tshogs khong khro langs te/'jar dmag dang gdong thug byung / de la brten nas 'ja' phan btsan 'dzul pas 6 sog po dang man ju'i nyams nyen ’ zhes pa'i gleng phyogs cher bzo byas/ don rkyen de da rung thag bcad med pa'i skabs su/ yang lo de'i zla 8pa'i nang don rkyen gzhan zhig byung ba 'di lta ste/ 'ja' phan gyis 6 krung tshun hreng we bor ba'i don rkyen ’ zhes pa zhig la kha g.yar nas/ krung go'i srid gzhung la ra rgol gtam btang zhing / dmag dpung drangs te krung gor dpung 'jug byed pa'i gra sgrig byas par ma zad/ kho tsho'i rgyal nang du dmag 'khrug gi smyo ham ngan bskul byas pas/ krung go'i byang shar gyi gnas tshul dza drag tu gyur/ skabs der krung go'i go min tang srid gzhung gis 'ja' phan gyi btsan 'dzul bya spyod la mgo 'dogs pa dang rgya yan du gtong ba'i srid jus lag bstar byas/ 1931lo'i zla 8pa'i tshes 16nyin cang ce hris (lko17)krang zho leng (lkolha'i)la gsang ba'i glog 'phrin btang ste/ 6 'ja' phan dmag dpung gis rjes su ji ltar byang shar sa khul nas 'gran ya btsal kyang / nged phyogs nas 'gog rgol byed mi rung ba dang / gang thub kyis gdong thug g.yol thabs byed dgos/ spun zla khyed kyis re zhig gi khong khro la rkyen byas nas rgyal khabadang mi rigs kyi las don la mi 'dzems pa'i rigs gtan nas byed mi rung mi zhes bshad/ krang zho leng gis glog yig de byang shar dmag gi dmag dpon nang du bkram nas kun gyis brtsi srung byed dgos pa'i bka' phab/cang ce hris mtha' gcig tu ya lan mi sprod pa la brten nas 'ja' phan btsan 'dzul pa'i snying stobs je che nas je cher song / zla 9ba'i tshes 18nyin/ krung go'i byang shar sa khul tu sdod pa'i 'ja' phan kon tong dmag gis hrin tāsang —

grongakhyer byang mtha'i lig the'o go'u sa khul gyi lcags lam dum bu zhig 'gas gtor btang rjes de ni krung go'i byang shar dmag gis byas pa yin par ma nyes kha g.yog byas te hrin dbyang byang phyogs dmag sgar gyi krung go'i sdod dmag la 'dzem bag med par tshur rgol byas/ de ni 'dzam gling yongs nas ha las pa'i 66dgu ba'i bco brgyad mi nyin gyi dus 'gyur yin/ de'i phyi nyin snga mor 'ja' phan jag dmag gis hrin dbyang grong khyer btsan 'dzin byas shing / kon tong dmag gi nyul ma'i mgo gte thu'u gles yon zhan ler ( shākhu.a long)gyis 6 grong khyer hrin dbyang gi hri krang ’ khur/'ja' phan jag dmag gi btsan 'dzul bya spyod kyi mdun nas go min tang srid gzhung gis byang shar dmag la 6 gtan nas 'gog rgol mi byed pa'i ’ bka' phab ste/ mnyam 'brel rgyal khab kyis 2 nyes med la rgyab bskyor nas ’ 66spyi snyoms thag gcod byed par mi re ba byas/ don dngos thog mnyam 'brel rgyal khab kyis 'ja' phan gyis krung gor btsan 'dzul byed par 'dzin pa'i rnam 'gyur ni ma'o so li nyi yis tsa mnyam 'brel rgyal khab kyis krung go phyir btsong pa red mi ces pa ltar yin/ der brten 'ja' phan jag dmag gis gza' 'khor gcig kyang ma 'gor bar le'o nyin (77)dang / ci lin (lharnye )zhing chen gnyis kyi sa khul mang che ba btsan bzung byas/ zla bzhi ma 'gor tsam la byang shar sa khul yongs rdzogs 'jar dmag gis bzunge pa red/rgyal spyi'i gleng phyogs la mgo skor gtong ba dang mi ser spel yul gyi dbang bsgyur byed bde ched/ 'ja' phan btsan 'dzul pas mnyam 'brel rgyalakhab kyi lha lis tun rtog zhib tshan chung ma thon gong 6 man ju rdzun ma'i rgyal khab mi btsugs te/ 'grub tshar song ba'i ba'i don rkyen zhig bzos shing /rgyal khab 'di'i thag sgul 'dra gzugs la kho tshos snga mo nas man ju'i rgyal bo rjeXsdu e zhin jo lo h+phu dbyi (tsho77༅ 74)blo la bab yod pa red/

skabs der h+phu dbyi ni then cin tsa cin yon midu phyi la 'brel 'dris ma byas par bsdad yod/ de snga smyo dgu ba'i bco brgyad :nyin gyi dus 'gyur ma byung gong gi zla gnyis kyi sngon la 'ja' phan gyis h+phu dbyi la gsang brda btang nas/ nye char man kro'u nas don rkyen zhig 'byung nyen yod pas 66zhon thun rgyal bos (ṣ+ṭhalko༅lko)thugs gzab byed dgos mi shes bshad/ 'ja' phan gyis h+phu dbyi la gsang brda btang rjes khos tsa kha rog tu gnas tshul 'gyur ldog la bltas te go skabs e rnyed bltas mishing / zu yang bskyar rgyal khrir 'dug mipa'i stong bsam bcangs/1931lo'i zla 11pa'i tshes 2nyin gyi dgong mor/ thu'u gles yon zhan ler dngos su then cin cen yon la yong nas h+phu dbyi la 'brel gtugs byas/gleng mo'i mgo nas mjug bar thu'u gles yon zhan ler gyi gdong la 6 dman sa 'dzin pa dang 'dzum gyis khengs te/ skad ngag la 6 re zhu mi dang ldan pas/rmu dbyi nas tsa khos bshad pa'i skad cha la rlom mi thub pa gcig kyang med par ’ bsam/ khos h+phu dbyi la gsar tu 'dzugs pa'i 6 rgyal khab mi ni 6 rang btsan rang bdag yin pas/ zhon thun rgyal bos rang dbang kho na byed chog mices khas blangs/ de ltar thu'u gles yon zhan 'or gyis bsru brid dang mgo skor btang 'og 1931lo'i zla 11pa'i tshes 18nyin 'jar dmag gis h+phu dbyi then cin nas byang shar gyi le'u hreng (smos/7)du khrid/rmu dbyis dang thog byang shar la 'byor ma thag lha rgyal bo'i khri la bsdad nas ’/ 66ching chen po'i rgyal khab slar gso byed thub par bsam mod/ 'on kyang / 'ja' phan kon tong dmag gi tshan mu'u pan yon krin si leng (yon61 longayi1khris)gis kho la ru rgyal khab 'di'i ming ni tsaman kro'u rgyal khab miyin pa dang / nga tshos sngon nas sku zhabs khyed rgyal khab gsar ba 'di'i gtso bdag la bkur rgyu'i 'dun pa yod mices bshad ma thag spu dbyi'i gdong /snar

por gyur nas lus yongs kyi khrag rgyun tshang ma ngo la brgyug pa dang 'dra/ 6 rgyal bo lags de 6 sku zhabs mis 'gyur ba de sems rgyud la'ang ma shar/ khos skabs de'i sems khams bshad skabs 6 'bod tshul 'di thengs dang por 'ja' phan mi'i kha nas thos pa yin/ de ltar 6gong ma zhon thun minam 6gong ma lags zhes pa'i 'bod tshul de kho tshos de ltar med par bzos pa red/'di ngas ji ltar bzod bsran byed thub/ kho'i sems nas byang shar gyi spyi le gru bzhi ma khri tsho 200mnga' khongs dang / mi dmangs khri tsho 3000yod tshad de/6rgyal po lags shig brjod par mi do/ mi der brten spru dbyi khong khro langs nas pan gin la 6 ming ma drang na skad mi drang pa dang / skad ma drang na don mi 'grub pa red/ man kro'u yi mi sems 'khor sa de chin chen po'i rgyal khab yin pa las/ nga rmu dbyi ma red ’ ces bshad nas khas ma blangs pas/ pan gin gyis ngo 'dzum bsdus nas/ da dung mu mthud du 66sku zhabs ’ shes brjod pa dang / 4 khyod kyis yang bskyar bsam blo zhig thongs ’ shes bshad rjes/ ma dga' bar phyir log phyi zhin pan ken gyis mi gzhan par skad btang ste/6 dmag spyi khang gi thag gcod la bcos bsgyur byed mi rung bas/ gal te khyod kyis dang len mi byed na/ nga tsho dgra ru 'dzin pa dang gnyis su med pas nga chos khyod la dgra bo'i lag thabs spyod rgyu yin mi zhes 'jigs skul byas pas/rmu dbyis skad cha de thos ma thag tu skrag nas re zhig la skad cha yang bshad ma thub par lus pa dang / 'ja' dmag gi bka' dang len mi byed ka med byung /1932lo'i zla 3pa'i tshes 1nyin/ 6 man kro'u rgyal khab rdzun ma btsugs pa khyab bsgrags byas shing / spru dbyis 6 rgyal khab gsar ba'i ’ gtso bdag khur ba dang / krin zho zhi (lkokhyatho 31)yis 6 rgyal srid blon chen khur/blon chen gyi gsham 'og tu 66spyi gnyer thin kung ’ zhes pa zhig bzhag ste/'judī phan gyi mis go gnas de khur/ phyi 'brel pu'u dang / dmag srid pu'u/

nor srid pu'u sogs kyi pu'u krang gi gsham 'og tu las rogs gzhon pa re bzhag pa thams cad tshang ma 'ja' phan gyi mis khur/ blon chen dngos ni spyi gnyer thin krang cis cin te san (lha)mo'i'agroza)zhes pa de yin na'ang / rgyal don gros tshogs kyi gros gzhi tshang ma las rogs gzhon pa'i tshogs 'dus thag bcad tshar ba'i gros chod yin/ rmu dbyi nas cis cin te san ni zu don dngos thog gi blon chen yin la/ khos dngos su brtsi ba'i mgo ba ni kon ton dmag gi dmag spyi yin pa las/ ming thog gi srid 'dzin nga min zhes bshad/rmu dbyi nas 2 srid 'dzin mipa de 6 ngo so med pa mizhig yin tshul shes na'ang / khos tsa gser khri la dbang bsgyur ba'i stong bsam da dung ma nyams par/ srid 'dzin byed pa ni ra rgyal bo'i rin chen khri la bzhugs pa'i them skas yin par sems pa dang / kho'i re ba de yang don yod du gyur bar mngon pa ni 'ja' phan btsan 'dzul pas kho tsho rang gi dgos mkho ltar lha man kro'u rgyalakhab ’ de 6 man kro'u btsan rgyal du bsgyur ba de red/ 1933lo'i zla 10par/ spru dbyis kon tong dmag gi ngag nas kho rang ra man kro'u btsan rgyal ’ gyi rgyal bor 'dug chog pa thos rjes/ 66dga' spro chen po skyes ’ shing /khos phyir dran byas pa la ca nga'i sems la thengs dang por dran pa ni rgyal po'i na bza' 'brug ris ma de yin/ na bza' de ni ngas lo 22ring sems la dran mizhes bshad/ 1934lo'i zla 3pa'i tshes 1nyin 66man kro'u rgyal khab mide 6 man kro'u btsan rgyal la ming brjes/ ming brjes nas dus yun ring bo ma lon pa'i bar der tsa btsan rgyal ’ 'di'i rgyal pos sgrub rgyu kho na ni 2 'ja' phan gyi mi'i mdun nas rang nyid kyi bde 'jags ji ltar srung par bsam blo gtong rgyu de yin/ zhes bshad pa dang / h+phu dbyi ni don dngos thog 'ja' phan lag 'og gi dbang med rgyal bor gyur/krung go'i byang shar sa khul btsan 'dzin byed pa ni 'ja' phan h+pha swā ḍi'i

dmag shed can gyis krung gor btsan 'dzul byed pa'i 'char gzhi dang po yin te/ de dang mthun nas kho tshos gnas bab la gzhigs nas gom stabs gnyis pa ji ltar spo dgos pa ste krung go la phyogs yongs nas btsan 'dzul byed par bsam blo btang /(gnyis)dbyi tha lis e tse o bra ya /tshi tshe ༅/la btsan 'dzul byas pa/h+pha shi si de dbyi tha li nas kyang gong du 'phel ba shin tu mgyogs/ ma'o so li nyis dbang bzung rjes 6 srid dbang tshang ma h+pha shi si la dbang ’ zhes pa'i srid jus lag bstar byas pas/ dbyi tha li'i srid gzhung yongs rdzogs myur bar h+pha shi si can du bsgyur bar ma zad/ h+pha shi si'i 66gson shugs de 6 rgyal yongs kyi 'tsho ba'i khrag rtsa'i nang mi bzhur tu bcug pa red/ lo lnga drug tsam gyi ring la dbyi tha li'i mang tshogs rang bzhin gyi rtsa 'dzugs mang po zhig la h+pha shi sis tshod 'dzin dam po byas pa red/ma'o so li nyis h+pha shi si'i srid gzhung sra brtan yong dgos na nges par tu dpal 'byor gyi gzhi rtsa'ang 'dzin dgos par bsam yang / kho dang nyes thi li gnyis 'dra bar dpal 'byor bad kyi shes bya cung zad kyang med pa red/gnad don mang ba'i dbyi tha li'i spyi tshogs dang dpal 'byor gyi gnad don thagagacod pa la/ khos gtso che ba ni h+pha shi si'i rgyal khab kyi dbang cha spyad pa red/ khos bshad rgyur/ 6 nga tshos bshad pa'i rgyal khab kyi the gtogs zhes pa de'i don ni/ bya dngos gang zhig sgrub ma thub na rgyal khab kyis the gtogs bye/ ༵ de la zer/ 6 ma rtsa ni dmigs yul 'grub pa'i lag thabs shig las de

bla na med pa zhig ga la yin/ mi ma'o so li nyis de lta bu'i 66rgyal khab kyi the gtogs byas pa la brten nas/ dmag 'khrug mjug sgril rjes kyi dbyi tha li'i dpal 'byor la h+pha shi sis dbang bsgyur ba'i lo sngon ma 'ga'i ring la 'phel rgyas nges can byung / yin 'ang rgyal khab kyi dbang cha spyad nas btsan thabs kyis the gtogs byas par re zhig la phan pa 'byung srid kyang / mu mthud nas dar rgyas yong mi thub pa thag gis chod/ 1929lo'i 'dzam gling dpal 'byor nyams nyen gyi shugs rkyen thebs 'og dbyi tha li srid gzhung gi yong sgo yong khungs med par gyur te/ lo re bzhin dpal 'byor mar la rdib/1933lo nas 1934lo'i bar gyi dpal 'byor de sngon rtsis kyi bzhi cha'i gcig rdidī cing / khe las khri tsho 5 5ma rtsa rdib de bzo ba khri tsho brgya yan chad kyi las ka 0rad/ pal 'byor la nyams nyen byung pa de las h+pha shi si'i dbang bsgyur la g.yo 'gul byung zhing / rgyal nang gi chab srid dang dpal 'byor gyi gnas tshul gyis ma'o so li nyis mig rgyang phyi rgyal la mi 'phen ka med byung du bcug khos btsan 'dzul dmag 'khrug la brten nas dpal 'byor gyi dka' ngal sel ba'i stong bsam bcangs/ 'di ni sger sdom mkhan gyis rgyun du spyod pa'i lag thabs yin te/ mi la las ma'o so li nyi yis dmag 'khrug rgyag mi rung ba'i rgyu rkyen ni khos dmag 'khrug byas pa de yin zhes bshad/ 〈yo rab gling gi gsang ba〉zhes pa'i dpe deb kyi rtsom pa po yo han gin hri (2gis stso)zhes pas phu 'di ni khos dmag 'khrug byed min gyi gnad don min te/ khos dmag ༷khrugaji rdor mi rgyag pa'i gnad don yin mizhes gsungs par gnas lugs sa ca/ ma/ 'a/khrug gi thabs la brten nas dka' ngal las thar thabs byed pa las gzhan/ da dung der brten nas btsan 'dzul rgya bskyed byed pa sdi /'o

so li nyis yun ring bsam blo btang ba'i don zhig yin/ khos rang gis rang la lha khe sa gsar ba (soshārjismon yiming (gna' rabs ro ma'i rgyal po )btags te/ yang bskyar che ro ma btsan rgyal mi slar gso byed pa 'ur sgrog byas nas/ ti krung ha'e rgya mtsho lha dbyi tha li'i nang khul gyi rgya mtshor bsgyur ba'i ’ stong bsam bcangs/ khos 6 dbyi tha lis ti krung ha'e rgya mtshor bdag po byed ma thub na/ti krung ha'e rgya mtsho'i btson mar 'gyur ’ bar bshad pa dang / dbyi tha li la zhi chings rgyal khab kyis mgo skor btang ba dang / er sel zhi bde'i tshogs thog tu ngo gnong dgos pa'i pham kha nyos/ 6 dbyi tha li la ci zhig mkho zhe na/dngos su mkho ba ni dgra sha len mkhan 'ig dgos mi shes ma'o so li nyis rang gis dris pa la rang gis lan btab/ma'o so li nyis bltas na/ dbyi tha li 'tsho gnas thub pa de mi ser spel yul sa khul dang kha 'bral thabs med la/ dgra sha len mkhan gyis thog mar mi ser spel yul gyi gnad don thad nas mgo rtsom dgos bsam/ khos 〈nga'i rang rnam 〉zhes pa'i nang du 6 mi ser spel yul gyi 'phel rgyas kyis rgyal nang gi mi grangs mang drags pa'i gnad don thag gcod thub par ma zad/ nga tsho'i dpal 'byor gyi gnad don yang de dang bstun nas thag gcod thub mi ces bshad/ der brten e tse o phi ya ('bod tshul rnying bar abs zhi nyi ya (khu1tre'isgyusgokhur+sā)zer )ni ma'o so li nyi'i mig nang gi mi ser spel yul dang po'i che sha tshon por gyur/ e tse o phi ya ni rgya mtsho dmar po'i lho phyogs kyi a h+phe ri ga'i gling sne na yod la/ ti krung ha'e rgya mtsho nas rgya mtsho dmar po'i bar dang de nas hin di'i rgya mtshor bgrod pa'i brgyud lam na yod pas/ de la 'thab jus kyi go gnas gal chen yod/dbyi tha li ni btsan rgyal ring lugs pas 6 h+phe gling bgo bsha' byed mi pa —la /sdu nas thon mkhan yin/ dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i mjug tu bye thang dang

phyed ka bye thang yin pa'i sa khul 'ga' 'phrog pa las gzhan/ dbyi tha li la rgya mtsho dmar po'i lho sne dang ya tun mtsho khug (༅ 17)nas e tse o phi ya la gtad yod pa'i yig lis thi lis ya (khya2 cis/l+lī )dang so ma li'i (tshe 64)sa khul skor zhig btsan 'phrog byas nas thob/ gal srid dbyi tha lis e tse o phi ya yang 'phrog yod na/ de dang dbyi tha li la gtogs pa'i so ma li dang /yig lis the li ya sbrel thub par ma zad/ nyis lo gtsang po'i (77 ma)chu mgo yang 'dzin thub pa las/ nyis lo gtsang bo'i smad rgyud kyi su'u tan (79)dang / e cib (ṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭha)rgyal khab kyi chu bed la'ang tshod 'dzin byed thub pas/ dbyi tha li'i sna a h+phe ri ku'i btsan rgyal mi'adzugs par phan pa shin tu che/1896lor/ dbyi tha li mi ser spel yul dmag dpung gis yig lis the li ya nas e tse o phi ya la dpung 'jug byas te/ e tse o phi ya yongs rdzogs btsan 'dzin byed pa'i stong bsam bcangs/ 'on kyang / a tu'u wa'i (༅rnye37)g.yul 'gyel khrod dbyi dmag la pham nyes tshabs chen byung ste/ btsan 'dzul gyi rmi lam skyid po chu yi wu bar gyur/ dbyi tha li btsan 'dzul pas pham kha de'i snying nad khog la bcug cing / ma'o so li nyis kyang a tu'u wa'i pham kha ni dbyi tha li rgyal khab kyi 6 ngo tsha zhig yin pas/ nges par du skyin pa len dgos par 'dod/ der brten/ khos kha g.yar sa zhig btsal nas pham skyin len grabs byas/1934lo'i zla 12pa'i tshes 5nyin/ so ma li'i 'brog pa dang 'brog phyogs la rtogs zhib byed mkhan dbyin e mnyam 'brel tshan chung srung skyel byed pa'i e tse o phi ya'i sku srung ru khag cig war war (777lo)zhes pa'i sa khul nas dbyi tha li la gtogs pa'i so ma li'i mi ser spel yul gyi dmag dang gdong gtug byas/ dbyi dmag gis gnam gru dang / krong ca dmag 'thab rlangs 'khor sogs spyad nas e tse o phi ya'i ru khag chung ngu de kā /ra

rgol byas te e phyogs kyi dmag mi 110bsad pa dang / dbyi tha li'i phyogs nas mi 32las ma shi ma'o so li nyis rkun mas rkun ma 'dzin dgos zhes ki co sgrog pa ltar/ e phyogs la 6 bzod gsol zhu dgos mi pa'i btsan gtam bshad pas/ ra dmag 'khrug tu zhugs pa'i :e tse o phi ya'i dmag dpon dang 'thab mo bas war war nas bsad pa'i dbyi tha li'i dmag mi la 6 gus phyag 'tshal mi bar ma zad/ e sgor khri tsho sum cus 6 dmag skyin sprad / cha rkyen lci mo yin pa des mjug mthar dbyi tha lis dmag brda rgyag pa 'gog ma thub/e tse o phi ya'i rgyal bo ter ze la zhi ( po ṣ+ṭhapo)yis gyod gzhi de mnyam 'brel rgyal khab la sprad nas thag gcod par zhus/ 'on kyang / ma'o so li nyis mnyam 'brel rgyal khab rtsa ba nas mig nang du mi 'jog pas/ kho'i sngon gyi btsan 'dzul 'char gzhi mu mthud nas sgrub/ zla 12pa'i tshes 30nyin/khos dbyi dmag la 6 a pis zhi nyi ya'i drag chas dmag dpung rtsa gtor byas te/e tse o phi ya yongs rdzogs dbang du bsdu ba'i mi bka' phab/1935lo'i zla dang por/ ma'o so li nyis te po ro ( ṣ+ṭha )zhes pa h+phe gling shar ma'i dbyi dmag gi spyi khyab dmag dpon la bskos/ zla 2pa nas mgo brtsams te/ dbyi dmag 'bor chen rgyal nang nas yig lis the li ya dang / dbyi tha li la gtogs pa'i so ma li la drangs shing / lo de'i ston khar dbyi dmag khri tsho 30lhag a h+phe ri kha shar mar 'dzoms/ dmag 'khrug gra sgrig byas tshar rjes/ ma'o so li nyis te po ro la nges par tu dbyi e dmag 'khrug slong thabs byed dgos pa'i bka' phab/ khos 6 gal srid e tse o phi ya'i rgyal bos nga tsho la tshur rgol byed 'dun med na/ nga tshos nges par tu rang 'gul gyis bya 'gul spel dgos mi zhes gdams/ 1935lo'i zla 10pa'i tshes 3nyin/dbyi dmag khri tsho sum cus dmag brda ma brgyab par e tse o phi ya la dmag drang6sdu te/ yig lis the li ya dang dbyi gtogs so ma li nas e tse o phi ya la

glo bur du btsan 'dzul byas/dbyi dmag gis e tse o phi ya la btsan 'dzul byas pa de ni/ 'ja' jag gis krung go'i byang shar sa khul btsan 'phrog byas pa'i rjes kyi h+pha shi si'i btsan 'dzul don rkyen 'ig yin pas/ 'dzam gling gleng phyogs la zing cha langs/ 'dzam gling sngon thon gleng phyogs kyis bskul 'ded byas 'ogamanyam 'brel rgyal khab kyis dbyi tha li ni btsan 'dzul pa red ces mi zer ka med byung bar ma zad/ de la dpal 'byor thad nas chad pa gcod rgyu'i thag bcad/ dbyi tha li ches skrag pa'i rdo snam bkag sdom de chad pa'i nang mi the ba las/ mnyam 'brel rgyal khab kyi chad pa la nus pa med pa shes/ zla 10ba'i tshes 9nyin/ dbyi dmag gis a to'u wa (a 87) bzung rjes/ ched dmigs kyis sa khul der rdo ring bsgrengs nas/ steng du 661896lo'i zla 3pa'i tshes 1nyin a to'u wa rgyal don du bshegs pa'i dpa' bor gus zhu dang / khyed cag gi zhe 'khon spyi lo 1935lo'i zla 10ba'i tshes 9nyin rgyal kha'i ngang blangs rī ma ba ni ga tsho—44yi44 chu sna mo cho ༅ sgo la i shā 6tshetsho'i— tshi sna tsha —— tre sgyu — mo la —1 — —— — —1———5 — spro 34 — ———6 3 4 tsho 4 stsestangar+shapa cho gdamag 'khrug skabasakyi sa'e la zhi gong ma/61

yod ’ ces bris yod pa red/ 1935lo'i zla 5ba'i tshes 15nyin/ dbyi dmag gis e tse o phi ya'i (lhabyuzloji/ridzekrokhru)rgyal sa ya ti si ya pi pa (krokhrulo46krokhrukhra3)btsan bzung byas pa red/ zla 5pa'i tshes 9nyin/ ma'o so li nyi ro ma we nyis chi ya pho brang (7679(༅lha)gi nyin stegs thog tu bud nas/ ngar langs ba'i mi tshogs la e tse o phi ya dbyi tha li'i rgyal khongs su bsdus par ma zad/ dbyi tha li'i rgyal bo we khi to ye man nyer nyid tsa e tse o phi ya'i rgyal bo ’yin zhes khyab bsgrags byas/ khos 6 dus rabs 15la sgug rjes da gzod btsan rgyal slar gso byas mi shes gnon mi thub pa'i dga' spros bshad/skabs der ma'o so li nyis kho rang nyid khe sa yin par rlom pa ni rang mtshang brjed song ba'i mngon rtags zhig red/ya ti si ya pi pa (krokhruṣ+kashāskokrokhru'i3)dbyi dmag gi lag tu shor rjes/ se la zhi (677)rgyal bo dbyin jir 'khyam zhing / 1936lo'i zla 6par khos mnyam 'brel rgyal khab nas dbyi tha li'i nyes mtshang brjod de 6 ngas btsan 'dzul gyi 'jigs skul thebs bzhin pa'i mi rigs nyams chung gi las don la la srung skyob byed kyin yod/ kho tshos sngon chad khas blangs ba'i dam bca' de da lta gang la 'gyur song / gong ma lha dang lo rgyus kyis khyod tshor khrims thag gcod nges yin ’ zhes bsgrags pas/ gzugs po thung ba'i rgyal po des 'dzam gling gi zhi bder dga' ba'i mi dmangs la sems 'gul thebs su bcus phyis su dbyin ji'i phyi 'brel blon chen e nyin (4ṣ+ṭha)gyis don de la phyir dran byas te 661935lor sems thag bcad de dbyi tha li la chad pa gcod mi thub bam/ gal srid nga tshos sems thag bcad pa yin na/ ma'o so li nyi'i gdong 'bag rdzun ma bshu mi thub bam/ de las ma mtha' yang dmag 'khrug 'di phyir 'gyang byed thub/ ma'o so li nyi mi stobs chen zhig du gyur ba ni nga tsho raX ༵ thug pa red mi ces bshad/ e tin gyi skad cha 'di ni don byung

tshar rjes kyi skad cha yin mod/ 'on kyang des dbyin phos ma'o so li nyi rgya yan du btang ba'i mjug 'bras las e tse o phi ya la btsan 'dzul byas pa'i lo rgyus kyi bslab bya de spyi sdom byas pa red/pa/ (gsum) nyes thi lis 〈yer sel zhi chings 〉rbad de ma brtsis 'jar man nas nyes thi li go sar bsdad ma thag pho shi si'i sger sdem srid dbang btsugs te yo rob gling la dbang bsgyur ba dang / de nas 'jom gling yongs rdzogs dbang 'og tu bsdu ba'i bya 'gul gyi mgo brtsams/ kho srid blon la bsdad pa'i phyi nyin/ na tshas tang gi dril bsgrags pu'u krang ki pher (2767)gyis kho'i zin thor 6 nga chos gtso bdag dang mnyam du gros tshogs 'tshogs skabs/ dmar bo'i 'jigs skrag la ngo rgol byed pa'i byed phyogs gtan 'bebs byas mi shes bris yod/ de ltar na tshas tang gis gung khron la drag gnon byed pa'i 6 byed thabs mi myur bar lag bstar byas/ 1933lo'i zla 2pa'i tshes 24nyin/ nyen rtog pas khrims dang 'gal nas per lin gyi gung khran tang gi spyi khyab khang la sngog bsher byas te/ 6 gung khran tang gis gsar brje slong ba'i 'char gzhi rnyed song ’ zhes bshad kyang / 'char gzhi de'i yig cha nam yang ston rgyu ma byung pa red/ de'i rjes kyi nyin gsum pa ste zla 2pa'i tshes 27nyin/ ci yin 'di yin ma shes par rgyal tshogs kyi thog khang chen mo la me shor/ gdong mchong ru khag gis me lce drag tu 'bar bzhin pa'i thog khang chen mo'i nang ming la h+phan te lu'u po (༅/ 0 77)zer ba'i ho lan (lo5)gyi gung khran tang mi zhig 'dzin bzung byas/ ki lin (༅lo)gyis ra rgyal sa ///)////

tshogs la me btang ba'i gyod gzhi ’ ni gung khran tang gis btang ba'i 6 sngon brda red ces bshad/ der brten/ myur du ci mis the ro spru (r+sālkoṣ+ṭha lko)gtso byas pa'i po ka ri ya'i (6mebs/sgro)gung khran tang mi gsum 'dzin bzung byas nas gsar brje'i stobs shugs la rdung rdeg byas/ don dngos thog rgyal tshogs kyi thog khang chen mor me gtong mkhan ni na tshas ba rang nyid yin te/ h+phan te lu'u po ni gdong mchong ru khag gis 'dzin bzung byas rjes thog khang bsregs sar rdzun bshad nas khrid pa red/ phyis su ci mis thi ro kyus le pis zhi (lkog )khrims ra'i nang h+pha shi sis me btang nas ma nyes kha g.yog byas pa'i lkog g.yo la mtshang 'byin nan mo byas/ kho'i tshig rno ba'i skad cha de ral gri zhig dang 'dra bar dgra bo'i snying khar 'dzer nas gung khran tang yon zhig gi zhum pa med pa'i snying stobs mtshon/ khos 6 ngas skyon 'dzugs byas pa'i gung khran tang yon zhig dang / gung khran ring lugs kyi gsar brje'i mtshan snyan la dag sel byed rgyu yin/ ngas nga rang gi phugs bsam dang gung khran ring lugs kyi dad mos la dag sel byed rgyu yin/ nga tsho bzo ba'i gral rim dang / gung khran tang mi rnams 'thab phyogs gcig sgril khrod nas mnyam 'brel byas te/ nges par tu h+pha shi si'i 'gro lam 'gog rgyu yin/ mizhes ki lin sogs la mtshang 'byin nan mo byas pa dang / gung khran tang gis rgyal tshogs kyi thog khang la me btang ba'i bden dpang zhig ston rgyu ma byung bas/gleng phyogs kyi gnon shugs la brten nas ci mes the ro rmu sogs gsar brje ba gsum por nyes ba med pa khyab bsgrags byas/na tshas tang gis ra rgyal tshogs la me btang ba'i gyod gzhis migung khran tang la ma nyes kha g.yog byed pa'i re ngan mngon 'gyur ma byung yang / kho tshos zu rgyal tshogs la me btang ba'i gyod gzhi mibazos pa la brten nas rgyal nang du h+pha ༷ /'i sger gcod dbang bsgyur byed pa'i dmigs yul 'grub song ba red/

6 rgyal tshogs la me btang ba'i ’ phyi nyin/ nyes thi lis smyo mi dmangs dang rgyal khab srung ba'i ’ khrims srol zhes pa khyab bsgrags byas te/ 8 gung khran tang gi drag shugs bya spyod mil sngon 'gog byed dgos par kha g.yar sa btsal ba dang /we ma (sgro 11)spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi bca' khrims nang gtan la phab yod pa'i mi sger gyi rang mos la srung skyob byed pa'i don tshan med par btang ba dang /de dang bstun nas 6 'jar man srid gzhung la mi dbang cha chen po sprad de/66rgyal khab la ngo log pa dang / dug las byed pa/ me btang ba/ gtor brlagacos pa ’ sogs kyi nag nyes bzos pa'i dogs pa yod mi la/ gsod khrims sam tshe btson du 'jug pa dang / dgos pa byung tshe 6 zhing chen gang yin kyang dbang cha tshang ma mi bdag du 'dzin chog pa sogs byas/ 'di lta bu'i 'jigs su rung ba'i dbang cha yod par brten/ nyes thi lis gang 'dod kyis ngo log byed mkhan yod tshad la drag gnon byed thub pa red/ zla 7pa'i tshes 14nyin/ hes thi lis yang bskyar 6 rgyal khab spyi tshogs ring lugs 'jar man bzo ba'i tang gcig pu 'jar man gyi srid tang yin pa'i khrims srol zhig khyab bsgrags byas/ de nas bzung na tshas tang gis mngon lkog med par tang gcig gis srid dbang sger 'dzin byas pa red/de dang bstun nas nyes thi lis srid dbang bzung rjes myur bar dmag shugs rgya bskyed dang dmag 'khrug gi gra sgrig byas shing / kho'i phyi phyogs srid jus kyi dmigs yul ang dang po ni (er sel zhi chings 〉med par bzos nas dmag 'khrug gi gleng phyogs cher bzo byed rgyu de red/ khos 'jar man mi rigs ni ru sa'i go la thog ches khyad du 'phags pa'i mi rgyud yin pas/ mi gzhan par dbang bsgyur byed chog ces mi bshad dgu bshad byas/ kho yang ma'o so li nyi dang 'dra bar 66'jar man gyi mi mang drags pa dang / 6 mi grangs mang drags pa'i mi gnad don thag gcod thabs gcig po ni 6 mi /snas

yongs kyi chab srid stobs shugs phyogs gcig tu bsdus te mi 'tsho ba rol sa gsar ba 'tshol dgos ’ par 'dod/ 6 'tsho ba rol sa 'phrog rtsod byed dgos na drag shugs la brten dgos pa red/ khos ra 'jar man gyi gnad don thag gcod par byed thabs gcig las med pa de ni drag thabs la brten dgos te/ drag thabs la brten na nyen kha cung zad la'ang mi 'phrad pa yong mi srid ’ ces bshad/1933lo'i zla 10par/ nyes thi lis dmag stobs 'dra mnyam min par kha g.yar nas ri ne+e wa'i (577)dmag dpung nyung 'phri'i tshogs 'du las phyir bud pa dang / de nas cang ma 'gor bar mnyam 'brel rgyal khab nas kyang phyir bud/ 1934lo'i zla 10bar / nyes thi lis skam dmag khri tsho 10de ((er sel zhi chings 〉kyis thag bcad pa'i mang mtha' )khri tsho sum cur rgya bskyed pa dang / mtsho dmag ldab gcig gis rgya bskyed par ma zad/ skog nas kun khri tsho 2 6gi rim pa can gyi mtsho skor dmag gru gnyis bzos/ 1935lo'i zla 3par/ ki lin gyis yang 'jar man gyi mkha' dmag bskyar 'dzugs byed rgyu khyab bsgrags byas par ma zad/ 46'di'i phyogs nas nga tsho dbyin ji dang 'dra mnyam yin mizhes 'jigs skul rang bzhin gyis bsgrags/ zla 3pa'i tshes 10nyin/ nyes thi lis 66rgyal srung dmag mi'adzugs pa dang / yongs khyab kyi 'gan bab dmag bsdu'i lam lugs lag bstar byed pa'i bka' khyab bsgrags byas shing / bde 'jags yin pa'i skabs su cun thon 12dang hri 36btsugs te dmag mi khri tsho 50yod pa'i 'dod blo bzung / 'di ni mngon sum du 〈yer sel zhi chings 〉kyis 'jar man gyi dmag don tshod 'dzin byas yod pa med par btang ba dang khyad med/nyes thi li 'jar man srid gzhung gis chings yig dang 'gal ba'i bya spyod6 spya tshogs sgrub par dbyin h+pha dbang 'dzin pas rgya yan du btang / dbyin

h+pha dbang 'dzin las khungs gnyis kyis phyi rol gleng phyogs la 'jom nas rnam pa tsam gyi ngo rgol byas mod/ don dngos thog rgya yan du gtong ba'i srid jus lag bstar byas/ de'i mngon gsal gyi rtags mtshan zhig ni 1935lo'i zla 6par/ 'jar man dang dbyin jis h+pha ran si la gsang nas 〈dbyin 'jar gnyis kyi mtsho dmag gi gros chod 〉ces pa'i chings yig cig bzhag chings yig de'i nang du dbyin jis 'jar man gyi mtsho dmag gi stobs shugs h+pha ran sa'i mtsho dmag gi stobs shugs las brgal chog pa ste/ 'jar man la dbyin ji'i dmag gru spyi'i tun grangs kyi 35chadamag gru dang / 457mtsho 'og dmag gru yod chog pa khas blangs de ltar (er sel zhi chings sminang 'jar man gyi dmag stobs la tshod 'dzin byas yod pa'i don tshan yod tshad med par btang da/ mag shugs rgya bskyed nas dmag 'khrug gra sgrig byed pa'i gom stabs la bstun ched/ nyes thi lis 'jar man gyi dpal 'byor yang smyo spyi'i dmag 'khrug gi dpal 'byor sgrig gzhi'i mi khongs su bsdus/ btsan rgyal dngul khang gi mgo bdag sngon ma ste hra hi thi (mi/76)dang / mtshon cha'i tshong ba chen po khi li pe(mtsho khye)/ rno lcags gnyer mkhan chen po te sin sogs sger sdom ma rtsa can dang na tshas ba skor zhig gis 6 'jar man dpal 'byor spyi'i u yon lhan khang mi zhes pa zhig btsugs nas/ gang 'dod du rgyal dmangs dpal 'byor dmag don can du bsgyur ba'i srid jus lag bstar byas pa des/'jar man gyi bzo las myur tu mtshon cha thon skyed kyi phyogs la bskor/ h+pha shi si'i mgo bas lha me skyogs kyis mar ser gyi tshab byed pa'i mi 'bod bskul btang 'og ngal rtsol mi dmangs la bshu bzhig dang 'phrog bcom byed par shugs bsnan te/ sngar las lhag par dmag dpung rgya bskyed dang dmag 'khrug gra sgrig gi gom stabs je mgyogs su btang / de ltar 'jar man gyi dmaX spyan

༷gro song de myur tu 'phar nas rgyal dmangs dpal 'byor gyi sum cha'i gcig na/ hos thi lis (er sel zhi chings 〉kyi bkag rgya gtor ba des 'jar dmag gi stobs shugs tshod 'dzin pa'i bkag rgya yod tshad gtor ba yang min te/ zhi chings kyis 'jar man gyi dmag don la mjug mtha'i tshod 'dzin cung zad yod pa ni/ 'jar man nub phyogs kyi le dbyin sa khul (lkotho4)dmag don stobs shugs med pa'i sa khul du thag bcad yod pa de yin/ 1925lor bzhag pa'i 〈lo ka no spyi chings 〉kyi nang yang / gal srid 'jar dmag dmag don med sar yong na h+pha ran sis 'jar man la dmag don bya 'gul byed dbang yod pa dang / dbyin jis drag po'i stobs shugs kyis h+pha ran si la rogs byed pa'i 'os 'gan yod tshul thag bcad yod/ nyes thi lis go skabs btsal nas dmag don med sa'i sa khul der dmag dpung gtong ba'i gra sgrig byed bzhin yod/1936lo'i zla 3pa'i tshes 7nyin/ 'dzam gling gleng phyogs kyis ma'o so li nyis e tse o phi ya la btsan 'dzul byas par do snang byed bzhin pa'i sgang la/nyes thi lis glo bur tu dmag dpung btang nas yang bskyar dmag don med pa'i le dbyin sa khul btsan 'phrog byas/ don rkyen 'di mi rnams kyi blo yul du ma shar ba'i phan chad nas/ dbyin h+pha rgyal khab gnyis kyis dka' khag gnyis la kha gtad 'jal dgos pa byung / 'dis ma'o so li nyi la rgyal spyi'i gleng phyogs kyi gnon shugs thebs pa je yang du btang bar ma zad/ lhas thi li la'ang phan pa byung / skabs der dbyin h+pha gnyis la zing 'tshab chen po langs shing / 'jar dmag gis dmag don sa khul min pa'i le dbyin bzung ba des h+pha ran si la nyen kha shin tu che/ h+pha ran si'i srid 'dzin las khungs kyi mi swā ༵ las dmag dpung gtong rgyu'i 'dod tshul bzung yang / dbyin ji'i

dbu bzhugs blon chen por wun ( lo7)gyis 4 dbyin jis dmag 'khrug gi nyen kha 'khur mi thub /ces bshad pas/ h+pha ran si la bya thabs ma byung bar ngag thog nas rgol gtam gtong ba tsam las/ dmag dpung 'gul tsam yang ma byas pa red/ don dngos su skabs thog de'i stobs shugs la bstun na 'jar man gyis dbyin h+pha gnyis kyi 'gran ya gtan nas yong mi thub pa red/nyes thi li la mtshon na dmag dpung le dbyin dmag don med pa'i sa khul la bskyod pa ni shin tu nyen kha yod pa'i bya ba zhig yin pas kho'i sems na gdeng tshod gtan nas med pa red/ don rkyen de'i rjes nas tsa le dbyin dmag don med pa'i sa khul la dpung 'jug byas pa'i chu tshod 48kyi ring ni nga'i mi tshe'i khrod ches 'tshub cha che ba'i dus skabs shig yin/ gal srid de dus h+pha ran sis le dbyin sa khul la dmag dpung btang ba yin na/ nga tshos wa rnga ma drud nas phyir yong ba las 'os med/ rgyu mtshan ni nga tsho'i dmag don stobs shugs de tsam gyis h+pha ran si 'gog pa'i stobs shugs cung tsam yang med ces bshad/ yin na yang nyes thi lis nyen mchong 'grub song bas/ kho'i snying stobs lhag par je cher song / le dbyin dmag don med pa'i sa khul la dpung 'jug byas pa des lhas thi lis (er ser zhi chings 〉rbad de med par btang nas/ dmag 'khrug slong ba'i lam la gom pa dang po spos pa mtshon/1937lo'i zla 1pa'i tshes 30nyin te/ nyes thi lis dbang bzung nas lo 'khor bzhi lon pa'i nyin mor/ khos dngos su 'jar man gyis 〈yer sel zhi chings 〉la 'khur ba'i 'gan khur tshang ma med par bzos pa khyab bsgrags byas par ma zad/ blo tshim yid khengs kyis 66de ring ngas nges par tu gnam rgan mar gus pa'i ngang bka' drin zhu dgos te/ dus skabs shig gi nang du grags 'gul med pa'i dmag mi dkyus ma zhig gis nga tsho mi rigs kyi gzi brjid dang khe dbang gi 'thab rtsod de yongs su 'grub par byas ’ shes sdu/da

pa dang / de dang mthud nas khos gom stabs gnyis pa dang gsum pa bstud mar spos nas/ 'jar man de yo rob gling gi ches nyen kha che ba'i dmag 'khrug 'byung gzhi la bsgyur/(bzhi) 'jar man dang dbyi tha lis si pan /khro cha/gyi nang 'khrug la the gtogs byas pa/ma'o so li nyis e tse o phi ya la btsan 'dzul byas pa dang / nyes thi lis 〈klor sel zhi chings 〉med par btang ba'i khar lkog nas dmag dpung rgya bskyed dang dmag 'khrug gra sgrig byed pa rim bzhin mngon 'gyur byung rjes/h+pha shi sis ham sems pis li nyig si ( lko/47)phyed gling du yod pa'i si pan la bcangs/ si pan gyi rgyab phyogs ni pis li nyig si ri bor gtad yod pa dang / byang phyogs nas h+pha ran si dang 'brel ba/ lho phyogs nas a h+phe ri ku'i skam sa chen po'i bar tu zheng la spyi le 20las med pa'i kri pu'u lo tho mtsho 'gag (ṣ+ṭhalo77677)gis bcad yod pas/ nub phyogs rgya mtsho chen po nas ti krung ha'e rgya mtshor bgrod pa'i 'gag 'phrang yin/ de ni sngon chad nas dmag don pas 'phrog res byed pa'i 'thab jus gnad sa zhig yin la/dbyin h+pha gnyis la sa khul 'di ru shugs rkyen chen po yod/ khyad par dbyin jis kri pu'u lo tho'i 'gag lam thad kur du tshod 'dzin byas yod pas/ chen po dbyin ji btsan rgyal gyi 6 tshe srog gi bgrod lam mi gyi bde 'jags khag theg byas yod/ 'jar man dang dbyi tha li'i h+pha shi sis rang nyid la rim bzhin gshog rtsal rgyas rjes si pan la tshod 'dzin byed 'dod pas/ thog mar mdung rtse dbyin h+pha gnyis la ma gtad rang gtad du gyur/ yin na yang / kho chos 'di/ man h+pha shi si'i nyen khar do snang de 'dra ma byas pa ni/ kho tshos phyar ba'i

dar cha ni tsa pur hri we khe la ngo rgol byed pa miyin pas/ skabs der dbyin h+pha dbang bsgyur tshogs khag nang gi mi skor zhig la 6 gung khran ring lugs la skrag pa'i nad byung yod mipa'i stabs kyis de rgya yan du btang pa red/h+pha shi si'i stobs shugs de yo rob gling nas phyogs kun du khyab pa dang mnyam du/ rgyal khab la la'i gung khran tang gis dus thog tu h+pha shi si la ngo rgol byed pa'i 'thab phyogs gcig sgril 'dzugs pa'i 'bod skul bsgrags/ de 'dra'i 'thab phyogs gcig sgril la skabs der 6 mi dmangs kyi 'thab phyogs zer/ 1936lo'i zla 2par/ si pan gyi mi dmangs 'thab phyogs la dbyi hu'e gros tshogs khrod nas rgyal kha thob ste/ srid dbang 'dzin pa'i mgo brtsams/de dang mthun nas h+pha ran si'i mi dmangs 'thab phyogs la'ang rgyal kha thob/don de la dbyin h+pha dbang bsgyur pa dngangs skrag chen po skyes te/ de ni kho tsho'i dbang bsgyur la nyen kha yod pa'i tsa gung khran ring lugs kyi nad yams ’ yin par 'dod/ dbyin ji dbang bsgyur pas 2 gal srid da lta si pan dang h+pha ran si na mched bzhin pa'i gung khran ring lugs kyi 'gos nad de rgyal khab gzhan par yang khyab na/ rang gi rgyal khab nas 'gos nad 'di med par btang zin pa'i srid gzhung gnyis te/ 'jar dbyi srid gzhung ni nga tshor phan pa'i grogs por 'gyur srid ’ ces mngon sum du bsgrags/ de ltar si pan gyi gsar brje'i stobs shugs med par bzo ched dbyin h+pha dbang bsgyur tshogs pas h+pha shi si'i stobs shugs la brten par yang mi 'dzems pa red/ spyir dbyin h+pha gnyis la skul ma gtong dgos pa ma red/ ma gzhi 'jar man dang dbyi tha lis sngon nas gra sgrig byas yod pa red/ ma'o so li nyis ti krung ha'e rgya mtsho de dbyi tha li'i nang khul gyi rgya mtshor bsgyur ba'i ham sems bcangs yod pas/ si pan gyi gnad don thad nas ma'o so li nyis nyes thi li las kyang stobs shugs bton pa shugs che/ de la per lin srid gzhung gis kyardo rdo si

pan na dbyi tha li'i khe phan gzhan las lhag pa yod ’ ces bshad/ de snga 1934lor ma'o so li nyis si pan gyi h+pha shi si la rogs skyor byed rgyu khas blangs yod de/ mi dmangs 'thab phyogs la rgyal kha thob rjes ma'o so li nyis zing 'khrug la rgyab skyor byas/1936lo'i zla 7pa'i tshes 21nyin/ h+pha ran si'i ma ze (67)nas yong ba'i gnam gru zhig ro mar (76)thon/ gnam gru'i thog nas si pan gyi gsar 'gyur 'god mkhan gnyis thang la babs/ de'i gcig ni 〈a pe ze tshags par 〉gyi gtso sgrig pa yin zhing / gcig ni tshags par de'i lun ton na yod pa'i gsar 'gyur 'god mkhan lu'u yi si po lin (77lo lo)yin/kho gnyis yong don ni si pan gyi zing 'khrug dmag gi mgo ba h+pho ling kho'i (lkotshos)sprad pa'i las 'gan sgrub ched yin/ nyin bzhi'i sngon la si pan nas mi dmangs 'thab phyogs srid gzhung la ngo rgol byed pa'i zing 'khrug langs/zing 'khrug mgo rtsom skabs zing 'khrug gi mgo ba hrin hu'u ler ho (chamaposmra1)gnam gru thang la lhung ba la brten nas shi bas/ zing 'khrug dmag la mgo ba med par kha thor tu 'gro ba'i nyen kha yod/ gnad 'gag gi skabs su spyang grung ldan pa'i po len gyis dbyin ji'i 6 'phur mda' mirtags can gyi gnam gru zhig glas te/ hrin hu'u ler ho'i ngan rogs pa h+pho ling kho rgyang 'bud byas yod pa'i ca ni li gling tshom (mebasmokhyimatshalo)nas ma'o lo ki'i ti hri an ( stsa6714 6ṣ+ṭha)la bskyal/ skabs der h+pho ling kho'i mnga' 'og na a h+phe ri kha'i dmag mi khri gsum yod kyang / si pan gyi mi dmangs 'thab phyogs srid gzhung gis mtsho dmag mang che shos la bkod 'doms byed thub/ a h+phe ri kha'i dmag dpung kri pu'u lo tho mtsho 'gag brgyud nas si pan gyi rgyal nang du yong ste/zir+sha ༷khrug la zhugs rgyu ni de 'dra'i las sla mo zhig ma red/ skabs der spro

ling khos mtho so li nyi la skyabs bcol rgyu sems la shar te/ po lin mngags nas glas pa'i gnam gru la bsdad de ro mar song nas ma'o so li nyir skyabs 'jug ṭ+wāṃ sdu/nga kho'i gsang ba'i pho nywa ro mar thon rjes ma'o so li nyis stobs shugs yod tshad kyis rgyab skyor byed rgyu khas blangs/ de nas nyin 9'gor rjes te/ zla 7pa'i tshes 30nyin/ dbyi tha li'i gnam gru nyi shu sa nyin gling phran (91lo)nas mo lo ki ( ༷ )la 'phur ba dang / dbyi tha li'i mkha' dmag de si pan gyi phyi rgyal dmag gi nang bsres te/ si pan gyi rgyal nang du zing 'khrug dmag dpung bskyal nas thad kur si pan gyi nang 'khrug la zhugs/dbyi tha li'i gnam gru mo lo ki la thon rjes dbyi tha li'i mkha' dmag gi rtags kyang len khom ma byung par dmag 'khrug la zhugs/ de nas ma'o so li nyis ched du 2 si pan la song nas dmag rgyag pa'i u yon lhan khang mi zer ba zhig btsugs shing / 6 dang blangs dmag mi gi ming thog nas dmag dpung hri mang po si pan gyi rgyal nang du drangs nas dmag 'khrug brgyab/ 1937lo'i lo mgor ma'o so li nyis si pan la btang ba'i dmag dpung khri tsho 4dang stong tsho 4yod zer rung / don dngos thog dmag dpung khri tsho 15btang yod/ de las gzhan gnam gru 1000dang / me skyogs 2000/ than khe 700/ rlangs 'khor khri tsho 1 4/ me mda' khri tsho 24yod pa'i grangs ka 'di dag las dbyi tha lis si pan gyi nang 'khrug la the gtogs byed pa'i rgya che chung shes thub pa red/na tshas 'jar man yang rjes su lus pa min te/ lo 3gyi dmag 'khrug khrod snga gzhug tu 'jar man gyi dmag khri tsho 5se pan la song nas dmag 'khrug byas pa dang / 'jar sgor dung phyur lnga'i dmag gron btang / nyes thi lis ma'o so li nyi dang dpung ba mnyam gshib sgos si pan gyi nang 'khrug la drag chas kyis the gtogs byas mod/ kho la'ang rang gi dmigs sa zhig yod 71 ni/

h+pho ling kho la myur du rgyal kha thob mi 'dod de/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni 1937lo'i zla 11par na tshas tang gi mgo bar sems gtam bshad pa ltar te/ tsa 'jar man gyi thad nas bltas na/ h+pho ling kho la brgya cha'i brgya'i rgyal kha thob na de 'dra bzang rgyu med de/ nga tshos mig sngar sems khur byed pa ni ti krung ha'e rgya mtsho'i sa khul gyi 'gal ba mu mthud du gnas thub min de yin/’ 'dir nyes thi li la dmigs yul gnyis yod de/ gcig ni si pan gyi nang 'khrug gi dus yun je ring du btang ste dbyin h+pha gnyis kyis de la do snang byed pa'i skabs su/khos lkog tu dmag don rgya bskyed dang dmag 'khrug gra sgrig byed pa 'geb thub pa dang / gnyis ni ma'o so li nyis stobs shugs yod tshad kyis h+pho ling kho la rgyabaskyor byed pa'i brgyud rim khrod yun ring dbyin h+pha gnyis kyi kha gtad du langs pas/ ma'o so li nyi rang dang mnyam por dam du sbrel thub pa de yin/do/ dngos thog hes thi lis ma'o so li nyi la blo gtad de 'dra byed thub kyi med pa dapho/ shi sis 'dzem bag med par si pan la drag chas kyis the gtogs byed pa'i mthar thug gi dmigs yul dngos ni dbyin h+pha gnyis la mdong rtse sprod 'dod yin pa de yo rob gling gi srid phyogs kyi rig pa dwangs pa'i mi snas shes yod na'ang / dbyin h+pha gnyis kyi dbang bsgyur tshogs khag gis si pan gyi don rkyen ni 66'jar man gyis mgo khrid byed pa'i pur hri we khe la ngo rgol byed pa'i rgya gram dmag gis dpung 'jug dmag 'khrug dang po yin par 'khrul ’ yod pas/ h+pha shi si'i btsan 'dzul bya spyod la smyo the gtogs mi byed pa'i srid jus lag bltar byas/mi der ma zad kho tshos phyogs phyogs su bya 'gul spel nas yo rob gling gi rgyal khab 27bsdus te/tsho the gtogs mi byed pa'i gros chod mices pa zhig bzhag par ma zad/ 2 the gtogs mi byed pa'i u yon lhan khang mizhes pa /sdu kyang btsugs/ smyo gros chod mide'i nang mtshon cha dang dmag bkol

dngos rdzas si pan la mi 'dren par thag bcad yod/ a ris 6 bar sdod kyi dar cha phyar te/ dbyin h+pha rgyal khab gnyis dang khog 'brel byas shing /dbyin ji dang h+pha ran si a me ri ka bcas rgyal khab gsum pos phyi tshul du drang bden byed kyi yod mod/ 'on kyang / don dngos thog 'jar dbyi gnyis dang 'brel nas si pan gyi gsar brje la mgo gnon byed kyi yod/si pan gyi mi dmangs 'thab phyogs srid gzhung dka' tshegs shin tu che ba'i gnad la thug yod mod/ 'on kyang / si pan gyi h+pha shi sir ngo rgol byed pa'i dmag 'khrug gis mi'i rigs kyi lo rgyus thog bstod bsngags byed 'os pa'i shog lhe zhig bsnan yod pa red/ rgyal khab so so'i sngon thon mi snas mi grangs khri tsho 3 5yod pa'i 6 rgyal spyi'i dpung khag cig rtsa 'dzugs byas pa dang / de'i nang gi rgyal khab so po'i dmag mi khri 1lhag si pan gyi g.yul sa nas rang srog blos btang pa red/ dbyi tha li'i h+pha shi si la ngo rgol byed pa'i 'thab mo ba 35006 rgyal spyi'i dpung khag ’ la zhugs par ma zad/ thad kur dbyi tha li'i h+pha shi si'i 6 dang blangs dmag midang g.yul 'thab byas shing /de'i nang h+pha shi si la ngo rgol byed pa'i 'thab mo ba 700lhag gis rang srog blos btang pa red/ krung go tshan chung gi dmag mi brgya lhag dmag 'khrug der zhugs pa dang / de'i nang mang che bas si pan gyi g.yul sa nas rang srog blos btang / 'jar dbyi h+pha shi si'i mi shugs dang dngos zog mtshams ma chad par si pan gyi zing 'khrug dmag gi sar bskyal bas/ phyogs gnyis kyi stobs shugs la khyad par chen po byung nas/ mi dmangs 'thab phyogs kyi gnas bab bsdad gin dka' tshegs che bar gyur/ 1938lo'i dpyid ka nas bzung ste/'jar dbyi h+pha shi si'i dmag dpung de h+pho ling kho'i zing 'khrug dmag dang ma nyam 'brel byas nas spyi'i tshur rgol bslangs/ lo de'i zla 12par/ kho tshos dmag grangs khri tsho 30bsdus te/ mi dmangs 'thab phyogs srid gastaX gi

dbang 'og na yod pa'i ka ta lo nyis ya (meXr+sā༅༅༅)la skor rgol byas/1939lo'i zla 3par si pan gyi rgyal sa ma tig lis (pho〈glitsho)bzung / de rjes mi dmangs 'thab phyogs srid gzhung de h+pha shi sis rtsa slog byas/rwagatsha ༷ sa mnyam 'brel drag dpung gis si pan — — byeX4 tsho gyi nang 'khrug la the gtogs byed pa'i brgyud 7 3nga ༷ zirdom khye1da/ mtshe( sbas 6sgo nyis stobs ro/gas sna ri che chen po bton zhing / hes thi lis le dbyin — mi dmag don med pa'i sa khul la dmag dpung drangs rjes/ si pan gyi don rkyen des ci rka 'dzam gling gling phyogs kyi kha nas dbyi tha lis e tse o phi ya la btsan 'dzul byas pa'i ma don rkyen de mu mthud nas smyo rje chung ’ du bsgyur/ don rkyen rab dang rim pa 'di nyes thi li dang ma'o so li nyi/ dag brgyud nas/ sger ga'od pa ma'o so li ci nyi dang nyes thi lis kho tsho mnyam 'brel byas nas dbyin h+pha gnyis kyi zhan cha bed spyad na/ 'jar dbyi phyogs gnyis kur phan pa che ba'i gnad 'gag shes/ tsa gtso 'dzin ’ mdun du mchong skabs 66gtso bdag migis ltad mor bltas pa dang / 66gtso bdag 'gul bskyod byed skabs 6 gtso 'dzin ’ gyis go skabs la bstun nas lag bsnyab cig byas/de nas bzung kho tsho phan tshun gyi bar thag je nyer btang ste/ 6 phyogs gnyis kur phan ’ pa'i 6 srid jus gsar ba ’ lag bstar byed rtsis byas/ brgyud rim 'di'ikhrod ma'o so li nyi dang dbyin h+pha rgyal khab gnyis bar gyi 'brel ba je ring du song na'ang / khos nyes thi li dang bar thag je nyer mi gtong ka med byurdo 6/ 1937lo'i zla 9par ma'o so li nyis per lin la mtshams 'dri byed

skabs nyes thi li dang mnyam du/ si pan nas 6 dbyi tha li la'i khe phan dang sngon med stobs shugs ang dang por 'jog dgos pa dang / spyir btang du bshad na/ 'jar man gyis ti krung ha'e rgya mtsho (lo lha)nas dbyi tha li la gnod bar chad mi byed pa/ mi phyogs gzhan zhig nas dbyi tha lis 'jar man gyi o si khru ri ya na yod pa'i dmigs bsal khe phan la yang gnod mi skyel ba de red/ bcas gros thag bcad/ drag chas kyis si pan gyi nang srid la the gtogs byed pa'i don rkyen brgyud nas/ h+pha shi si'i sger gcod pa gnyis phyogs gcig tu 'khor ba red/ yin na yang / kho gnyis kyis phan tshun la dogs pa za ba da dung sel thub med de/ kho gnyis gas h+pha shi si la dad pa byed /sdo / rang rang gi khe phan thad nas phan tshun bar rgyun du 'thab rtsod yod pa (lnga) yo rob gling gi srog shing mi nas 66'dzam gling gi zur gsum/ nyes thi li'i mnga' 'og gi dpon rigs la las bshad pa ltar na/'jar man h+pha shi si'i sger gcod srid gzhung btsugs rjes/ lhas thi lis spyir btang du srid gzhung gi las khungs so so'i nyin rgyun gyi bya ba la the gtogs mi byed par/ las khungs so so'i mgo bas rang gi stobs shugs rgya bskyed pa rgya yan du btang nas/ na chos tang gi nang khul du dbang cha'i don du 'thab rtsod byung na nyes thi lis 6 bar 'dum byed thabs bkol nas/ kho ni ches mtho'ikha lo bsgyur mkhan yin pa'i go gnas brtan srung yod byas mod/ phyi 'brel las khungs dang dmag dpung ni de'i nang du tshud med de/ mi sta /ga

gis kyang las khungs de gnyis la lag bsring du gtan nas mi 'jug pa red/gnas tshul de la ki lin gyis tsa thog mar/ phyi 'brel srid jus ni gtso bdag rang nyid kyis sger gcod byed pa'i khyab khongs yin zhes bshad pa ltar red/6yo rob gling gi sgrig lam gsar ba 'dzugs pa'i mi blo bkod 'then skabs/nyes thi li'i lta ba ni 'jar man gyis rgyal khab gnyis la mna' 'brel byas chog ste/ gcig ni dbyin ji dang / gcig ni dbyi tha li yin/ rang gi phan gnod gyi 'brel ba las 'jar man dang dbyi tha li gnyis gas 〈yer sel zhi chings 〉dgra ru 'dzin pa red/ de'i khar rgyal khab gnyis ka h+pha shi si'i sger gcod kyi lam la song pas/ rgyal khab gnyis bar la myur bar mthun lam byung /ma'o so li nyis e tse o phi ya la btsan 'dzul byas pa'i gnad don thad/skabs shig la grogs med khor rkyang du bud na'ang / hes thi lis dus thog tu kho la rogs skyor byas/ drag chas kyis si pan la the gtogs byed pa'i gnad don thad yang 'jar dbyi gnyis la lta tshul mthun sa yod de/ ti krung ha'e rgya mtsho'i stobs shugs kyi khyab khongs thad nyes thi lis dbyi tha li'i gzhan las lhag pa'i go gnas ru brtsi bsrung ’ byas/ de dag gi stabs kyis ma'o so li nyi myur bar 'jar man gyi phyogs la 'khor bas/ tsa ro ma nas nas per lin bar gyi 'khor lte'i :rgyal khab gyi bsam blo 'dzugs thub pa red/1936lo'i zla 6par/ ma'o so li nyis 6 phyi 'brel mkhas pa zhig go sar bzhag pa ni kho rang gi bu mo'i mag pa ja le a tso chi ya no (me'ilko.akhri (༅glo)red/ chi ya no ni ro ma slob chen gyi khrims lugs sde khag nas mthar phyin/phyis su sku drag gi go gnas thob/ lo rabs sum cu pa'i stod la dbyi tha li'i krung go'i hrang ter sdod pa'i spyi'i gzhung tshab dang pho nya byed myong / kho ma'o so li nyi'i bu mo che ba e ta la dang gnyen sgrig rjes/ go sa myur bar 'phar ba red/78ma'o so li nyis phyi 'brel dpon po gsar ba 'jog don yang nyes thi li la

dbyi tha lis 'jar man la phyogs pa'i phyi 'brel srid jus gsar ba lag bstar byed pa'i brda gtong ched red/ de la per lin nas tes thi lis myur bar rnam 'gyur bstan pa ni/ 6 gtso 'dzin migyis 'jar man la 'tshams 'dri byed pa'i gdan 'dren zhu yig yong ba dang mnyam du / phyi 'brel blon chen chi ya no la 6 khor thug byed pa'i re ba bton/ ma'o so li nyis nyams shig bsrings te/khos mtshams 'dris 2 grags 'gul chen po slong mi rgyu yin par bshad pa dang /smyo de la gra sgrig gang legs byed ched michi ya no per lin la thengs gcig 'gro ru bcug nas 'brel gtugs byas/ der brten chi ya nos 'gan khur ma thag per lin la song nas ma'o so li nyi'i bka' mngags sgrub/1936lo'i zla 10bar/ chi ya nos per lin du nyig le thi (477)dang mnyam du 6 'jar dbyi mnyam las gros mol chings yig mi bzhag cing /rgyalakhab gnyis kyis par kun (3lor)dang to no gtsang ba'i (lkolko /7)bzhur rgyud nas so so'i stobs shugs khongs gtogs kyi bar mtshams bkar bar ma zad/ mnyam du drag shugs kyis si pan la the gtogs byed rgyu thag bcad/ ma'o li nyis kho'i mag pas sgrub pa'i las 'gan shin tu blo la bab cing / khos 'jar man la mnyam 'brel byed pa brgyud nas rang gi stobs shugs khongs gtogs 'dzugs par bsam/ zla 11pa'i tshes 1nyin/ mes lan ( sko༅)chos khang gi mdun gyi tshogs ra'i nang 6 mig sngar rlabs che ba'i rgyal khab cig dbyi tha li'i mang tshogs kyi blo la 'bab kyin yod/ rgyal khab de ni 'jar man red/’ 6 per lin gros mol gyi 'bras bu ni gnad don la la'i thad nas rgyal khyab gnyis kyi bsam 'char gcig mthun byung per len nas ro ma bar gyi lam drang bo 'di ni 'khor lte zhig yin te/ 'khor lte 'di'i mtha' 'khor nas mnyam 'brel dang zhi bder srung skyob byed 'dod pa'i yo rob gling gi rgyal khab yod tshad la mthun sgril byed rgyu yin/ mizhes gtam shāḥd

cing / de nas bzung 4per lin nas ro ma bar gyi 'khor lte ni mi 'jar dbyi h+pha shi sis yo rob gling dang 'dzam gling la dbang bsgyur ba'i tshab ming du gyur/'jar dbyi rgyal khyab gnyis kyis lag sbrel byas pa dang / kho tshos shar phyogs kyiwo shi si'i rgyal khab 'ja' phan yang phyogs gcig tu 'then na 'dod yod/chi ya nos 6 gal srid ro ma nas tho khe yo (lkotho)bar thig skud cig 'then thub na/ 'khor lte 'di'i ma lag cha tshang tu gyur/ zhes bshad/ lhas thi lis gom gang mdun spos sgos 'ja' phan nang du tshud pa'i 6 'dzam gling gi zur gsum mi 'brel ba zhig 'dzugs 'dod yod/skabs 'dir 'ja' phan gyis kyang 'jar man dang dbyi tha li rgyal khab la mna' 'brel 'dzugs 'dod yod de/ 1936lo'i zla 8par/ 'ja' phan gyi blon lnga'i tshogs 'dus 6 gzhi rtsa'i rgyal jus rtsa don ’ la gros 'chams byung rjes/ zla 11par lu'u kre zho lu'u (767/ritsho )per lin la song nas/ li pin the lo phu (༅r+sās r+sā)la ('jar man dang 'ja' phan gyi gung khran rgyal spyi'i skor gyi chod don 〉( gung khran rgyal spyi la ngo rgol byed pa'i gros chod ces pa de red/ )zhes pa zhig bzhag gros chod 'di ni su'u len (nya'isnaji)la dmigs pa yin mod/ 'on kyang de la don gzhan zhig kyang yod pa ni lhas thi lis bzos pa'i mgo skor gtong spyad cig kyang red/ khos sger nas h+pha shi si'i tang la 6 ngas nges par tu sar hri we khi'i bla gshed spyad nas er sel rgyal khab la tshod 'dzin byed rgyu yin te/ kho tshor 'jar man ni dmar bo'i nyams nyen la ngo rgol byed pa'i thag gcod rang bzhin ldan pa'i btsan rdzong yin par yid ches parabyed rgyu ni/ nga tsho dka' ngal dang / er sel zhi chings gi tshod 'dzin las thar te/ yang bskyar drag chas spras pa'i thabs lam nyag gcig yin ’zhes bshad/80'jar man gyis 'ja' phan la 6 gung khran tang la ngo rgol byed pa'i gros

chod bzhag rjes gang thub kyis 'ja' phan dang dbyi tha li gnyis bar gyi 'brel ba je dam du gtong bar bskul 'ded byas/ 1937lo'i zla 11par/dbyi tha li dngos su 6 gung khran la ngo rgol byed pa'i rgyal spyi'i gros chod nyal zhugs/ der brten shar phyogs dang nub phyogs kyi h+pha shi si'i rgyal khab gsum po la btsan 'dzul gyi 'thab phyogs grub pa red/ de la nyes thi li dga' nas 46rgyal khab gsum po mnyam 'brel byed thub byung / dang thog yo rob gling gi 'khor lte grub pa dang / da lta 'dzam gling gi zur gsum grub ces bshad/'jar man dang 'ja' phan dbyi tha li gsum pos ra gung khran tang la ngo rgol byed pa'i ’ mna' 'brel btsugs pa brgyud nas/ phan tshun gyi btsan 'dzul srid jus la rgyab skyor byas shing / 'jar dbyi gnyis kyis 'ja' phan gyis krung go dang zhi bde rgya mtsho'i lho phyogs sa khul la btsan 'dzul byed par rgyab skyor byed pa dang / 'jar man dang 'ja' phan gnyis kyis dbyi tha lis e tse o phi ya btsan 'dzin byed par rgyab skyor byed pa/ 'ja' phan dang dbyi tha lis na tshas 'jar man gyis (er sel 'i chings 〉mi brtsi ba dang / o si khru ri ya (malolko/)dngace khi si lo wa khe (77lo777)la btsan 'dzul byed pa'i srid jus la rgyab skyor bcas byas/don dngos thog nyes thi lis 6 rlabs che ba'i chab srid kyi zur gsum ’ zer ba 'di ni/ phan tshun gyi srid jus la rgyab skyor byed pa'i mna' 'brel zhig yin par ma zad/ mnyam du bya 'gul spel ba'i btsan 'dzul rang bzhin ldan pa'i dmag don gyi mna' 'brel zhig kyang red/ 'jar dbyi bar 'khor lte btsugs rjes/ nyes thi lis 'jar dbyi'i bar 6 da lta 'du shes thad kyi thun mong tshogs pa shig tshugs par ma zad/ bya 'gul thad kyi thun mong tshogs pa zhig kyang tshugs ’ zhes bshad/ 〈nga yi hur brtson 〉zhes pa'i dpe cha'i nang /hes thi lis 66gal srid mna' 'brel dmigs yul gyi nang du dmag 'di/ mi
la don don du

—sa bcad gsum pa/ krung gos phyogs yongs nas 'ja' 'gog byed mgo brtsams/(gcig) zhi an dus 'gyur mi nas 6 bdun pa'i ches bdun nyin gyi don rkyen/mi 'ja' phan btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis ra dgu ba'i tshes bco brgyad ’nyin gyi dus 'gyur bslangs te/ 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa mgo tshugs pa'i rjes nas/ krung go'i rgyal nang gi chab srid kyi gnas tshul la 'gyur ldog chen po byung zhing / phyogs so sos mnyam du 'ja' 'gog byed pa'i re 'dod shin tu che/ 1935lo'i zla 8par/ krung go gung khran tang gi gung khran rgyal spyi ru sdod pa'i 'thus mi tshogs pas gung khran rgyal spyi'i 6 'thus mi'i tshogs chen skabs bdun pa'i h+pha shi sir ngo rgal byed pa'i 'thab phyogs gcig gyur 'dzugs dgos pa'i dgongs don gzhir bzung nas/ krung gung krung dbyang gi 〈brgyad gcig bsgrags gtam 〉bris shing bkram te/ rgyal yongs mi dmangs kyis mthun sgril gcig gyur dang / mnyam du rgyal khab skyob pa'i 'bod skul btang zhing / rgyal gces tang khag dang tshogs pa so sos mnyam du gros bsdur byas te/ rgyul yongs gcig gyur gyi rgyal srung srid gzhung zhig 'dzugs pa dang / 'ja' 'gog mnyam 'brel dmag dpung gi dmag spyi khang 'dzugs pa'i re ba bton/ 〈brgyad gcig bsgrags gtam 〉gyis krung go'i gung khran tang gis bye brag tu mi rigs 'ja' 'gog 'thab phyogs gci/ snar

'dzugs pa'i re 'dun mtshon yod/ lo de'i zla 12pa'i tshes 9nyin/ krung go'i gung khran tang gi mgo khrid 'og pe phen nas slob mas rngam ston khrom skor byed pa'i lha bcu gnyis pa'i tshes dgu'i las 'gul langs te/ rgyal tshong gi zu nyi mes chod yig la ngo rgol byas nas/ phu nang 'khrug mtshams bzhag ste/mnyam gcig tu 'ja' 'gog byed ’ pa'i re ba bton/ 1936lo'i zla 9pa'i tshes 1nyin/ krung gung krung dbyang gis yang bskyar 6 cang ce hri la btsan thabs kyis 'ja' 'gog byed du 'jug pa'i 'bod bskul bsgrags/ tsa cang rgol 'ja' 'gog ’ nas 2 cang 'ded 'ja' 'gog mig 'bod bskul gnyis kyi 'gyur ldog des 'ja' 'gog 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi bsam blo'i 'phel rgyas chen po de mtshon yod/krung gung krung dbyang gis bton pa'i 'ja' 'gog 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi 'dod blo la rgyal yongs kyi las rigs so so'i mi snas dga' bsu chen po thob/ 1936lo'i zla 5par/ rgyal yongs las rigs so so'i rgyal skyob mnyam 'brel tshogs pa de hrang he nas btsugs par ma zad/ bsgrags gtam spel te/ 6 mnyam du rgyal khab skyob pa'i rtsa don gtan 'bebs byed pa dang /gcig gyur gyi 'ja' 'gog srid gzhung zhig 'dzugs pa'i re ba bton/slob mas kyang smyo rgyal yongs slob grwa ba'i rgyal skyob mnyam 'brel tshogs pa rtsa 'dzugs byas/ de'i rjes su rgyal skyob tshogs pa sna tshogs char rjes kyi sha mo rdol ba bzhin snga gzhug tu btsugs/ 'ja' 'gog rgyal skyob kyi bsam blo yang go men tang nub byang dmag dang byang shar dmag gi rgya che'i dpon dmag rnam pa'i sems la brtan por 'jags/yin na yang / skabs 'dir cang ce hris kho'i tsa phyi dgra 'dul dgos na sngon la nges par du nang khul bde 'jags yong ba byed dgos mishes pa'i srid judī snron 'khyongs byas/ khos dmar dmag hran per (cho46)thon ma thag

pa'i go skabs dang bstun nas/ myur du zu nub byang jag 'dul spyi'i zi len pu'u ’ zhes pa btsugs te/ rang nyid kyis spyi'i zi lin khur ba dang / lcags ri ring po'i nang khul du phyir 'then byas pa'i byang shar dmag gi gtso 'dzin krang zho leng spyi khyab zi lin gzhon par bskos shing / des cang ce hri'i 'gan tshab len/ krang zho leng (lkolhatsho)gis bkod 'doms byed thub pa'i dmag shugs khri tsho 30yan yod pa de/ dmar dmag dang bsdur na dmag gi grangs ka dang dmag chas gang thad nas stobs shugs che ba red/ kung zho leng gis las sla mos 6 skor bcom mi gyi rgyal kha blangs nas/ cang ce hri'i yid ches thob ste de las nub byang nas rkang ba tshugs shing byang shar dmag gi stobs shugs rgyas na/ nam zhig gi tshe dgra bo'i lag tu shor ba'i byang shar gyi pha yul phyir 'phrog bde bar bsam mod/ 'on kyang / krang zho ling gi blo yul las 'das pa 'ig ni 1935lo'i ston dgun du byang shar dmag gis hran pe nas thengs gsum la dmar dmag la 'jab rgol byas pa tshang ma pham nas/ hri 'ga'i dmag dpung dang hri krang dang thon krang du ma brlag gung 'dul mi la bsdud mar pham kha byung ba des krang zho leng la sngangs skrag chen po skyes su bcugakho'i sems la gal te mu mthud du dmar dmag la phar rgol byas na/ byang shar dmag la gyong gud chen po 'byung pa dang / gal srid byang shar dmag gi stobs shugs med na 6 pha yul du dmag brgyab nas phyir log mi pa yang stong gtam du 'gyur/ yang gcig bshad na dmar dmag la dmag 'thab stobs shugs de 'dra chen po yod/ gal te dmar dmag dang mnyam 'brel byas nas 'ja' dmag la gtug res byed thub na 'dod thog la rta brgyugs pa red snyam/skabs 'dir krang zho leng gi sems la ci phyir nang mi dgra zlar bzung nas gsod res byed/ 6 gung 'dul byed pa ni 'chi lam nyag gcig red snyam/de nas bzung khos ru hur brtson gyis gung 'dul byed pa jide 6 'gan8 snar

sprugs thabs byed par mi gyur/pe phen gyi 4 bcu gnyis pa'i tshes dgu nyin ’ gyi las 'gul byung pa'i rjes nas/ slob grwa ba'i rgyal gces me lce yang zhi an la mched/ krang zho leng gis slob grwa ba'i las 'gul la gung khran tang gis mgo khrid byed pa shes pa dang /khos lkog nas gung khran tang la 'brel gtugs byas/ 1936lo'i zla 2par krungagung krung dbyang gis lis khi lung (dza'ostamu4 tshu)mngags nas krang zho leng gis blos 'khel ba'i dmag dpon la 'brel gtugs byas/ lo de'i zla 3par/krung gung krung dbyang gi kru'u zhi gzhon pa kro'u yin la'e (ṭha lko)shin tu gsang ba'i sgo nas krang zho ling la gros bsdur byas nas phyogs gnyis ku'i 4 nang 'khrug mtshams ba'ag nas mnyam du 'ja' 'gog byed mipa'i thad nas bsam 'char gcig mthun byung zhing / de'i rjes nas 6 cang rgol miyang mi bshad par gros mthun byung / de dang mnyam du mnyam 'brel byas nas 'ja' 'gog byed pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog krang zho leng dang nub byang dmag gi mgo ba dbyang hu'u khrin (ṣ+ṭha 7)gnyis kyi 'brel ba yang je bzang nas je bzang du gyur/ 1936lo'i zla 10pa'i tshes 22nyin cang ce hri zhi an la thon nas krang zho leng dang dbyang hu'u khrin la 46gung 'dul mi myur du byed par bskul/ krang zho leng dang dbyang hu'u khrin gyis bsam pa rnam dag gis cang ce hri la nang 'khrug mtshams bzhag nas mnyam du 'ja' 'gog byed pa'i re ba bton/ cang ce hris skad cha de thos rjes khong khro chen po langs te lha gung jag rtsa med du ma btang bar 'ja' 'gog gtan nas ma gleng :zhes bshad/ zla 10pa'i tshes 29nyin phyir lo dbyang (chis)du song nas ra skye skar rol/’ krang zho leng gis cang ce hri'i skye skar la rten 'brel zhu ba'i go skabs dang bstun te/ yang brdi/ mthun sgril byas nas 'ja' 'gog byed pa ni thabs kyi mchog yin pa'i

gnas lugs bshad/ cang ce hris nyan ma 'dod par 6 'ja' 'gog 'ja' 'gog ces ci la bshad/ nga shi rjes khyod 'ja' 'gog byed du song zhes gshe gshe btang /krang zho leng gis cang ce hris hren cun ru'u (muṇ+ḍi )sogs tsa zhe rus can bdun 'dzin bzung byas pa'i gnas tshul thos rjes/ sems shin tu mi bde bar gyur nas zla 12pa'i tshes 3nyin gnam grur bsdad de lo dbyang du song zhing / mi rnams kyis ngo rgol mi byed ched 6 zhe rus can bdun po glod 'akrol gtong bar zhus kyang / cang ce hris krang zho leng gi bsam 'char gtan nas khas ma blangs pa red/ krang zho ling khong khro langs nas 6 u yon krang gis 'di ltar sger gcod byas te rgyal gces mi snar gnod 'tshe btang na yon hri khe (za77)dang / krang tsong khrang (lkolkoṣ+ṭha)gnyis dang khyad par ci yod/mi ces bshad pas/ cang ce hri'i gnong la khel te smyo krung go yongs rdzogs nas 'di 'dra'i lta tshul yod pa ni khyod gcig pu red/ khyod krang zho leng las nga la skyon brjod byed mkhan med/ nga ni gsar brje'i srid gzhung yin/ nga ni u yon krang yin/ ngas 'di ltar sgrub pa ni gsar brje yin/ nga'i bka' ma brtsis na gsar brjer ngo rgol byas pa red/ mices bshad nas mtshams 'dir thon skabs khros che nas kha nang la tshig kyang ma yong bas/ krang zho leng spo langs nas phyir log de nas bzung cang ce hri dang krang zho leng gnyis kyi 'brel ba je btsog du gyur/skabs der cang ce hris nub byang gi gnas tshul mi bzang ba shes/ zla 12pa'i tshes 4nyin khreng khrin (ṣ+ṭhatsho)dang / cang den blun(lko'4)/ wis li hang (122 )/ chan ta con (7(7)sogs zhi drag dpon rigs khrid de yang bskyar lo dbyang nas zhi an la yong nas krang zho ling dang dbyang hu'u khrin gnyis la gung rgol byed par tsha 'ded byas/ tsa gcig ni byang shar hā/ga

dang nub byang dmag gis hran kun mdun g.yul du dmar dmag la dpung 'jug byas te 66gung 'dul gyi bka' dang len byas na/ sna krung dbyang dmag gis rgyab rtsa gnon pa dang / gnyis ni gal srid 66gung 'dul byed mi 'dod na byang shar dmag dang nub byang dmag gnyis so sor h+phu can dang an hos la mngags rgyu dang / shul du smyo krung dbyang dmag hran kun yong nas tsa gung 'dul byed pa gnyis gdams ka byed du bcug gdams ka byed rgyu 'di gnyis gang yin rung byang shar dmag dang nub byang dmag gnyis shi lam du ded pa yin pas/ krang dbyang gnyis kyis dang len byed mi 'dod pa red/ gdams ka dang po ni byang shar dmag dang nub byang dmag gnyis mdun g.yul du bud na krung dbyang dmag gis rjes nas g.yul 'gyel la lta bskul byed pas/ rgyal pham gang yin rung shi lam nyag gcig las med/gdams ka gnyis pa ni cang ce hris rang gi dgra zla kha bkar nas mjug mthar rtsa med du gtong ba'i lkog g.yo de lag bltar byed 'dod pa red/ shar byang dang nub byang dmag gnyis ka dmar dmag dang thug 'phrad byed sa'i g.yul gnas yag shas la kha bral pa ni/ rang nyid 'chi lam du bsnyegs ba kho na red/zla 12pa'i tshes 7nyin/ krang zho leng len thung hwa chin tshu tshan (/khri lha77)du yong nas/ sems pa rnam dag gis cang ce hri la zhu 'bul byas te sems 'gul thebs su 'jug 'dod/ khos mig chu bzhur zhor cang ce hri la nang 'khrug bzhag nas gung 'brel 'ja' 'gog byed dgos tshul gyi re 'dod phur tshugs su smras kyang / cang ce hri la sems 'gul thebs pa phar zhogakrang zho leng la 66lo chung bas ci yang mi shes mi zhes bshad pa dang / gung khran tang gi 6 mgo skor thebs pa red mi ces gshe gshe btang zhing / cog tse'i thog thal mo brdab ste lha da lta khyod kyis nga la me mdas brgyab nas bsad kyang /ngardi /gung 'dul 'char gzhi bsgyur rgyu min mi zhes bshad pas/ krang zho leng

gi mdun du lhag yod pa ni cang ce hri la btsan gyis 'ja' 'gog byed du 'jug pa de yin/ dgung mo der kho zhi an mkhar nang du yong nas dbyang hu'u khrin la gsang gros byas te/ smyo dmag la brten nas cang ce hri la re ba zhu ba'i bya 'gul spel grabs byas/zla 12pa'i tshes 9nyin/ zhi an gyi slob grwa bas 6 bcu gnyis pa'i tshes dgu'i las 'gul ’ la lo gcig 'gor ba'i rjes dran zhu ched re zhu'i las 'gul spel te/ nang 'khrug mtshams bzhag nas mnyam du 'ja' 'gog byed pa'i re ba zhus/ khrom skor tshogs pa sngon la lha nub byang jag 'dul spyi'i zi lin pu'u dang 6 zhi yon bde 'jags kung hru'u la song ste re ba zhus kyang lan gsal bo zhig ma btab pas/ kha phyir 'khor te lin thung du song nas thad kur cang ce hri la re 'dun zhu ru song / go min tang dmag gi nyen rtog pas mtshon cha bzung nas drag gnon byed par rtsom dus/ khrag bzhur don rkyen mi 'byung ched krang zho leng rlangs 'khor tu bsdad nas khrom skor tshogs pa'i rjes la brgyugs te/ slob ma phyir 'gro bar bskul ba dang / gza' 'khor gcig gi rjes nas lan gsal bo 'debs rgyu'i khag theg byas pas/ krang zho leng gi ngang rgyud ring pa'i skad chas slob mar sems 'gul thebs te kho'i kha la nyan nas phyir log dgung mo der krang zho leng gis yang bskyar cang ce hri la che re ba nan zhu ’ byas kyang / gnas lugs med par kho'i kha la ma nyan pas/ 6 dmag la brten nas re ba zhu ba'i ’ bsam blo je drag tu song /zla 12pa'i tshes 12nyin gyi tho rengs skabs su/ krang dbyang gnyis sngon la bkod sgrig byas yod pa ltar cang ce hri 'dzin bzung byed du song / byang shar dmag gi rta dmag hri drug pa'i hri krang pe h+phin zhang (0lo7)dang / hri de'i thon bco brgyad pa'i thon krang lig kos wu'u(smo/ṣ+ṭha1)/ srung dmag dbyinaganyis pa'i dbyin krang sun meng ci'u (777)dang hwa chin rdi sbyan

srung skyob byed pa'i dbyin dang po'i dbyin krang wang dbyi tsan (117)sogs kyis cang ce hri gson bzung byed pa'i 'gan blangs/ pe h+phin 'ang myur du hwa chin chu tshan la brgyugs nas cang ce hri'i srung dmag thams cad tshar gcod byas/ cang ce hris me mda'i skad thos ma thag nyal gos gon te sngangs 'tshab ngang gyang la 'gos nas rgyab ri'i ngos kyi brag khung zhig la sbas nas bsdad/ phyis su dmag dpung gis ri ngos la sngogs bsher byed skabs gson bzung byas shing / 'i an mkhar nang du khrid nas sna zhi bde'i kung hru'u mi ru bzang btson du bkag nyin de'i phyi dror/ krang dbyang gnyis gas mnyam du ming rtags bkod pa'i glog 'phrin rgyal yongs la btang ste/ 4 nan cin srid gzhung bskyar sgrig byed rgyu dang / 6 nang 'khrug yod tshad mtshams 'jog pa / smyo chab srid kyi btson ma yod tshad glod bkrol gtong ba/’ 66myur du rgyal skyob tshogs 'du 'tshogs pa ’ sogs nang don byas pa'i 'dod blo brgyad khyab bsgrags byas/ phyi nyin krang dbyang gnyis kus yang krung gung krung dbyang la glog 'phrin btang ste/ 6 dmag la brten nas re ba zhu ba'i miganas tshul bshad par ma zad/ krung gung krung dbyang la mgo ba gtso gras zhi an la mngags nas mnyam du rgyal khab skyob pa'i jus chen la gros bsdur byed par zhus/ cang ce hri bzang btson byas rjes/ krang dbyang gnyis sku dngos su song nas cang ce hrir thug pa dang / yang bskyar rang nyid kyi 'dod blo kho la bshad de/ nang 'khrug mtshams bzhag nas mnyam du 'ja' 'gog byed pa'i re ba nan zhu byas na'ang / cang ce hris sngar ltar rnam 'gyur mkhregs po bzung /zla 12pa'i tshes 13nyin cang ce hris sun mes lin (ṭhar+sā7)la kha chems rang bzhin gyi glog yig cig bris kyang / krang zho leng gis de gtong gi ma bcug pa re//0

krung gung krung dbyang la krang dbyang gnyis kyi glog 'phrin 'byor rjes/de mur kro'u en le dang / po ku'u( rtsa)/ ye jan dbyin (ba/yi/cho)sogs zhi an la mngags/ krang zho ling gis kho tsho rang gi pho brang du sdod du bcugakro'u en les krang dbyang gnyis la bsam 'char brje res byed skabs zhi ba'i sgo nas zhi an dus 'gyur thag gcod byed rgyu dang / cang ce hri la go skon blo 'gug gi slob gso btang ste nang 'khrug mtshams ba'ag nas mnyam du 'ja' 'gog byed du 'jug thub na/ krung gor zing cha chen po langs pa 'gog thub pa dang / gal te cang ce hri bsad na/ nang 'khrug mtshams 'jog mi thub par ma zad/ de las kyang chen po langs pa'i tshabs chen rang bzhin nan bshad byas/ krang zho leng gis cang ce hris 'ja' 'gog byed pa khas blangs na/kho rang nan cin du phyir log chog par bshad/ de nas krang dbyang dang krung gung gi 'thus mis bye brag tu cang ce hrir gros mol byed pa bkod sgrig byas/6 zhi an dus 'gyur mi byung rjes/ rgyal yongs la grag 'gul chen po byung zhing / nan cin go min tang srid gzhung de zang zing long long du gyur/ hi dbyin chin (775)gtso byas pa'i 'ja' phan la phyogs mkhan dang / sun mes lin dang sun tsi wun(lko14)/ khung zhang zhi (166ṭha)gtso byas pa'i a ri la phyogs mkhan gnyis bar gyi 'gal ba rno ngar can du gyur/ hi dbyin chin gyis krang dbyang gnyis 'dul dgos pa'i 'dod tshul bzung bar ma zad/rang nyid kyi 6 ngo log dmag drag 'dul byed pa'i spyi'i zi lin byed pa'i 'dod blo nan bshad byas de/ nang 'khrug rgya bskyed byas nas cang ce hri shi lam la skyel cing rang nyid kyis de'i shul gyi dbang bsgyur go gnas 'dzin pa'i blo bkod 'then/ sun mes lin dang / sun tsi wun sogs kyis brel 'tshub ngang dbyin me'i gzhung tshab la gros byas te/ dbyin ji'i mi ros nā (lkolko)'i an la song nas gnas tshul dngos la rtog zhib byas te cang ce hri skyopa pyar

zhus/ ros nā ni skabs der cang ce hri'i blo 'dri sa yin pa dang / sngon chad krang zho leng gi blo 'dri sa'ang byes myong / ros nās sun mes lin gyi yi ge lag bstar ma khyer nas tshes 14nyin zhi an la 'byor/ sun mes len gyis yi ge'i spyang sbri cang ce hri la smyo mig sngar nan cin phyogs su don gyi nang du don yod las sdos/ nā zhi an la thon rjes thog mar krang zho leng dang kha brda byas/krang gis 66mu yon krang gis nga tsho'i nang 'khrug mtshams bzhag nas mnyam du 'ja' 'gog byed pa'i re 'dun khas len na/ nga tshos khong 'ja' 'gog gi gtso 'dzin du bkur rgyu yin zhes bshad cing / de nas kho ros nā dang mnyam du cang ce hri yod sar song / chung ma'i 'phrin yig la bltas rjes/ cang ce hris nan cin phyogs su 6 don gyi nang du don yod mi ces pa'i tshig de'i ha go ste sems pham yi chad du gyur/ ros nās go skabs de dang bstun nas cang ce hri la krang dbyang gnyis kyi 'dod blo dang len byed pa dang / dbyin me gnyis kyang de la 'thad tshul bshad rjes/ cang ce hri'i rnam 'gyur la 'gyur ldog byung / de nas cang ma 'gor bar sun mes lin dang / sun tsi wun sogs gnam grur bsdad nas zhi an la yong ste krang zho leng dang / dbyang hu'u khrin/kro'u en le bcas dang mnyam du krang zho leng gi pho brang nas dngos su gros mol byas par ma zad/ zla 12pa'i tshes 24nyin chod yig don tshan drug bzhagagros chod kyi nang don gtso bo ni go min tang srid gzhung bskyar sgrig byed pa dang / 'ja' 'gog mkhan khas len pa/ 6 zhe rus can bdun po mi glod 'akrol gtong ba/ chab srid kyi nyes can yod tshad glod 'grol gtong ba/6 gung 'dul mi gyi srid jus mtshams 'jog pa/ dmar dmag la mnyam 'brel byas nas 'ja' 'gog byed pa bcas yin/ zhi an dus 'gyur zhi ba'i sgo nas bkā sducad pa des krung go'i 'ja' 'gog mi rigs 'thab phyogs gcig gyur

de rim bzhin grub pa mtshon thub/cang ce hri 'u thug nas nang 'khrug mtshams bzhag nas mnyam du 'ja' 'gog byed pa'i cha rkyen khas blangs rjes/ ngag thog gi khas len tsam dang rang nyid tshab la bzhag nas mna' skyel ba tsam las/ gros chod thog ming rtags ma 'akod pa red/ mi mang po zhig zhig khos bye brag gi khas len ci yang ma byas pa la blo ma bde bar / kho rang nan cin du 'gro ru 'jug mi 'dod/ skabs der byang shar dmag dang nub byang dmag gi phyi nang du cang ce hri gsod pa'i 'bod sgra shin du che bas/ krang zho leng gis cang ce hri'i bde 'jags khag theg byed mi thub par bsam nas zla 12pa'i tshes 25nyin rang gis sku dngos su cang ce hri bskyal nas nan cin du song / nan cin la thon ma thag cang ce hris kha bshad don la ma gnas par krang zho leng bzang btson byas/ de lta na'ang nang 'khrug mtshams bzhag nas gcig gyur gyis 'ja' 'gog byed pa'i lo rgyus kyi rlabs rgyun phyir 'khor mi srid de/ krang zho leng dang dbyang hu'u khrin rnam gnyis kyi rgyal gces mdzad rjes ni mi'i sems la gting zab tu 'jags shing / lo rgyus deb ther tu bkod/ de ltar tsa zhi an dus 'gyur ’ dus bab 'gyur ba'i gnad sasna ༵ / / n+dha sh+lauzlor/ ’ zhi ba'i sgo nas thag bcad pa des krung go'i 'ja' 'gog gi tsha rlabs shig bslangs nas/ 'ja' phan gyis hwa pe sa khul dum bur bcad de ra man kro'u rgyal khab miganyis pa ste/ smyo hwa pe rgyal khab ces pa zhig 'dzugs pa'i lkog g.yo rtsa thor tu btang / rgyal yongs mthun sgril 'ja' 'gog gi rnam pa'i 'og 6 cis khra srid gnyer u yon lhan khang mi gi u yon krang sun kre yon (ṭha07)gyis lha me mda'i kha nang la skor ba dang / nga tsho'i sa cha btsan 'phrog byas nas/ mi dmangs la brnyas bcos byed mkhan de nga tsho'i dgra bo yin pas/ nga tshos de la nges par tu 'thab 'dzing byed dgos 9 pyes

bstan/de min 6 zhi an dus 'gyur mizhi ba'i sgo nas thag bcad pa des tshad nges can zhig gi sgo nas dbyin me gnyis kyis 'ja' phan la 'dzin pa'i srid jus la 'gyur ldog byung ba dang / krung go'i gnad don thad nas dbyin me gnyis dang 'ja' phan bar gyi 'gal ba rno ngar can du song ba mtshon pa red/krung gor btsan 'dzul byed pa'i bya 'gul la pham kha byung ba'i gnas tshul 'og 'ja' phan gyis 'jar man h+pha shi si la 6 gung rgol rgyal spyi'i gros chod mices pa ba'ag cing / de nas bzung phyogs yongs nas krung gor btsan 'dzul dmag 'khrug slong ba'i thag bcad/ skabs der kon tung dmag gi tshan mu'u krang khur yod pa'i tung the'o dbyin cis (lko〉༅7) su'u len la dmag 'khrug rgyag par gra sgrig byed pa'i lta tshul thad nas krung go'i mig sngar gyi gnas tshul rtog zhib byas na thog mar nan cin srid gzhung la rdung deg byas te/ nga tsho'i rgyab phyogs kyi 'jigs snang sel par byed pa de ni thabs kyi mchog yin zhes bshad/1936lo'i zla 5ba nas bzung 'ja' phan gyis hwa pe sa khul la dmag dpung 'bor chen btang zhing / lo de'i zla 8pa'i nang / 'ja' phan gyis sngon nas gtan 'bebs byas pa'i dmag shugs hri thon 9de hri thon 14la 'phar ba dang / 1936lo'i ston ku'i rjes nas/ hwa pe la sdod pa'i 'ja' dmag gis mu mthud nas pe phen la dpung 'jug byed pa dmigs yul du bzung pa'i dam ga don sbyong brdar byas te/ sun kre yon gyi dmag dpung cun 29bar 'jigs snang bskur bas/ hwa pe la dmag 'khrug gi sprin nag 'khrigs shing dmag 'khrug langs la khad du gnas/1937lo'i zla 7pa'i tshes 7nyin gyi mtshan mor/ h+phin ther (46)sdod pardo (ja' dmag gis kho tsho'i dmag mi zhig dmag don sbyong brdar byed

cir ci sto la sto—tho gyi — — — — rig// /—— — —1— chol — — rin rtenasku ribaca ci sdusaX—3 zhi —3 krung go'i srung dmag gis lu'u ga'u zam thog tu 'ja' phan btsan 'dzul par 'gog rgol byed pa/skabs bor song bar kha g.yar nas wan phen (79)rdzong du yong nas sngogs bsher byed pa'i re ba bton/ krung go'i sdod dmag gis de la khas ma blangs pas/ 'ja' dmag gis wan phen rdzong dang lu'u gzhu zam par (7 77)me stogs brgyab par ma zad/ phen tan lcags lam zam pa dang de'i nye 'gram gyi klu rgyal lha khang btsan 'dzin byas/ krung go'i dmag dpung cun 29pa'i hri 37pas rgyal yongs 'ja' 'gog rgyal skyob las 'gul gyi shugs rkyen 'og go men tang srid gzhung gi 'gog rgol byed mi chog pa'i bka' la ma nyan par dpa' ngar zhum med kyis 'gog rgol byas/ de ni 6 bdun pa'i tshes bdun nyin gyi dus 'gyur yin/4 bdun pa'i tshes bdun nyin gyi dus 'gyur migyis krung go mi dmangs yongs la khong khro bslangs pa dang / 'ja' dmag gi rtsub spyod la rgol //ma

drag po btang nas/ rbad chod kyis 'ja' 'gog byed pa'i re ba bton/ dus 'gyur byung pa'i phyi nyin/ krung gung krung dbyang gis rgyal yongs la yongs khyab glog 'phrin btang ste 66phen cin (gatshok+ṣi)sa khul la nyen kha tshabs chen byung /hwa pe sa khul la nyen kha tshabs chen byung / krung hwa mi rigs la nyen kha tshabs chen byung / mi rigs yongs kyis 'gog rgol byed rgyu ni nga tsho'i 'gro lam nyag gcig yin/mi zhes 'bod skul btang / skabs 'dir cang ce hri'i rnam 'gyur la g.yo 'gul che la/ 'ja' dmag la phog thug btang pa de 6 zhi ba'i sgo nas thag gcod mipa'i stong bsam 'chang gi yod mod/ rgyal yongs mi dmangs kyi tsha 'den byas 'og zla 7pa'i tshes 17nyin lu'u hran nas gtam bshad de/'ja' phan la 'gog rgol byed dgos pa bsgrags/'ja' phan gyis 6 bdun pa'i tshes bdun nyin gyi dus 'gyur mibaslangs pa ni ltes dbang du byung pa zhig gtan nas min te/ kho tshos zla 3nas 6pa'i bar krung go khyur mid gtong ba mngon du 'gyur ba'i stong bsam bcangs/ zla 7pa'i tshes 30nyin pe phen dang then cin gnyis shor ba dang / zla 8pa'i tshes 13nyin 'ja' dmag gis glo bur tu hrang nyer tshur rgol byas/ krang kri krung (lko ṣ+ṭhañtsa)gis spyi'i dmag dpon 'khur ba'i ci thon cun dgu bas dpa' ngar bskyed nas 'gog rgol byas shing / de nas khreng khrin gyi cu thon cun 15ba yang bka' ltar myur tu hrang lhar dpung rogs la song /hrang te ni krung go'i ches che ba'i bzo tshong las rigs kyi grong khyer yin par ma zad/ tsa khyim chen bzhi'i mi dbang bsgyur lte gnas yang yin la/dbyin me rgyal khab gnyis kyi khe phan ches gcig bsdus yin sa yang grong khyer 'di yin/ 'ja' dmag gis hrang he la tshur rgol byas pas thad kur 6 khyim chen bzhi'i ’ dbang bsgyur go gnas la 'jigs snang bskur ba'i thog dbyin me /spyas kyi khe phan la thad kur phog thug btang ba red/ zla 8pa'i tshes

14nyin/ go men tang srid gzhung gis (rang srung 'gog rgol gsal brda 〉zhes pa zhig spel nas/ 6 krung gos mnga' khongs kyi khag gang zhig kyang gtan nas 'chor gi 'jug rgyu min te/ gal srid btsan 'dzul la 'phrad na nges par tu rang srung byed nges ’ shes khyab bsgrags byas/ tshes 15nyin cang ce hris spyi'i skul slong bka' khyab btang ste/ rgyal yongs 'thab g.yul bzhi la bgos shing /kho rang gis skam mtsho dmag gi dmag spyi khur/ de nas bzung krung gos 'dzam gling thog gi ches snga ba'i h+pha shi si la ngo rgol byed pa'i g.yul sa phyes nas mi rigs yongs kyis dgra 'gog byed pa'i lo rgyus dus rabs la slebs/(gnyis) krung go'i 'ja' 'gog mi rigs 'thab phyogs gcig gyur dngos su tshugs pa/sna bdun pa'i tshes bdun nyin gyi dus 'gyur mi gyi rjes nas/ krung gung krung dbyang gis dmangs yongs kyis dgra 'gog byed par skul 'ded byed pa dang / go gung mnyam 'brel mngon 'gyur byed ched/ 1937lo'i zla 7pa'i tshes 11nyin/ kro'u en le dang / chin pang zhan(r+sā77)/ linapo chi (tho/tshe༅)gsum 'thus tshab byas pa'i mi gsum po lu'u hran la song nas cang ce hri dang gros sol byas/ krung gung krung dbyang gi 'thus mis go gung mnyam 'brel byas te/ dmangs yongs kyis dgra 'gog byed ched/ gung khran tang gis dmar dmag rgyal dmangs gsar brje'i dmag tu bsgyur nas/ go men tang srid gzhung gi dmag don u yon lhan khang gi mgo khrid dang len byas te/dus thog tu 'ja' 'gog mdun g.yul du 'gro ba'i gra sgrig byed pa'i bsam tshul bstan/ zla 7pa'i tshes 15nyin/ cang ce hris dngos su krung go gung khran tang gi khrims mthun go gnas khas blangs pa khyab bsgrags byas/ /snar

dmag bsgyur ba'i bye brag gi gnad don la 'phrad dus/ cang ce hris bcos bsgyur byas pa'i dmar dmag hri gsum la go men tang gi tshan mu'u mngags rgyu rgyun 'khyongs byas pa dang / khos mngags 'dod pa ni khang tse (glo )yin/hri gsum po'i gong nas spyi'i bkod 'doms pu'u btsugs mi chog par/ chab srid sbyong brdar khru'u zer ba zhig btsugs nas bkod 'doms dang mi don la 'gan len dgos pa'i 'dod tshul bzung / krung gung krung dbyang gis spyi'i dmag spyi khang 'dzugs rgyu rgyun 'khyongs byas te/ kru'u tes spyi'i bkod 'doms pa'i 'gan 'khur ba dang / phen te hes spyi'i bkod 'doms pa gzhon pa 'khur ba/ go men tang gi mi snas (khang tse nang du tshud )gung khran tang gis mgo khrid byed pa'i dmag dpung nas tshan mu'u 'khur ba dang len mi byed pa'i 'dod blo bstan/ skabs der hwa pe mdun g.yul gyi gnas tshul la 'tshub cha che ba'i khar 6 brgyad pa'i tshes bcu gsum mi nyin 'ja' dmag gis hrang he la dpung 'jug byas pa sogs kyi gnas tshul byung rjes/ cang ce hris myur du dmar dmag song nas dmag 'khrug byed par bskul/ der brten/ zla 8pa'i tshes 22nyin dmar dmag rgyal dmangs gsar brje'i dmag skam dmag cun brgyad (palu'u cun )par bsgyur ba'i bka' phab cing / kru'u te spyi'i bkod 'doms pa dang / phen te he spyi'i bkod 'doms pa gzhon pa la bskos/cang ce hris pa lu'u cun la tshan mu'u mngags pa'i bka' de 'brel gtugs byed pa'i tshan mu'u mngags par bcos/pa lu'u cun gyi bkod 'doms pu'u la chab srid pu'u btsugs shing /rin pe hris (4120/ )kru'u rin dang tin zho phin (77)rig)gyis kru'u rin gzhon pa khur/ bkod 'doms pu'u yi gsham 'og tu hri 3btsugs te/ hri 115ba'i hri krang la lin pe'o (77)dang / hri kyang gzhon par nye rong krin (za~Xrdo0)bskos/ hri 120pa'i hri krang la ho lung (7༷/2)dang / hri krang

gzhon par zho khi(khrim)/ hri 129pa'i hri krang la le'u po khrin (smo144sgo)dang /hri krang gzhon par 'is zhang chan (ṣ+ṭhakhrim/ )sogs bskos/ de ltar pa lu'u cun la khyon sdom dmag dpung khri tsho 4 6yod/'ja' 'gog dmag 'khrug gi gnas tshul gsar bar gzhigs nas/1937lo'i zla 8pa'i tshes 22nas 25bar/ krung gung krung dbyang gis hran pe'i lo khron (lho)//)sa char chab srid cu'i tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs 'tshogs/zla 8pa'i tshes 25nyin/ krung go gung khron tang gis kru'u zhi ma'o tse tung gis bris pa'i 〈'ja' 'gog rgyal skyob kyi rtsa 'dzin chen po bcu 〉zhes pa khyab bsgrags byas pa ni krung go gung khran tang gis phyogs yongs nas 'ja' 'gog byed pa'i lam phyogs kyi mtshon tshul red/ de'i nang du 6 go gung tang gnyis mnyam las byed pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog rgyal yongs kyi tang khag dang / pha'e khagalas rigs khag dmag dpung khag bcas kyi 'ja' 'gog mi rigs 'thab phyogasagacig gyur btsugs nas 'ja' 'gog dmag 'khrug la mgo khrid dang /lhag bsam rnam dag gis mthun sgril byas nas mnyam du rgyal khab 'jig nyen lasaskyob thabs byed rgyu yin ’ zhes bstan/ zla 9pa'i tshes 22nyin/ go men tang gis nyin 'gar 'gor 'gyangs byas rjes/ mjug mthar kro'u en les khyab bsgrags byed pa'i re 'dun bzung ste sprad pa'i 〈krung gung krung dbyang gis go gung mnyam 'brel byed ched spel ba'i bsgrags yig 〉ces pa khyab bsgrags byas/ phyi nyin/ cang ce hris gung khran tang gi khrims mthun go gnas dang / mnyam du 'ja' 'gog byed rgyu yin pa'i gtam bshad byas/ de nas go gung mnyam 'brel thengs gnyis pa da gzod mngon 'gyur byung zhing / des /byi /'i 'ja' 'gog mi rigs 'thab phyogs gcig gyur dngos su tshugs pa dus yun ring bo ma 'gor ba'i 1937lo'i zla 10pa'i tshes 2nyin la9/9go
