lan grogs med khor rkyang du 'phud rgyu de yin/ grogs med kher rkyang du 'phud thub min la thag gcod rang bzhin gyi don snying yod/ de dang dus mnyam du nub phyogs rgyal khab la gtan nas gdong gtug byed mi rung / gal te don 'di sgrub ma thub tshe/ rab yin na phyogs gcig nas nub phyogs la phar rgol byed pa dang / phyogs gcig nas pho lan tshar gcod byed dgos shes bshad/ de'i don ni nyes thi lis pho lan la phar rgol byed pa'i dus mtshungs su dbyin h+pha gnyis dang dmag 'khrug langs ba g.yol thabs byed kyang / pho lan dang dbyin h+pha gnyis la mnyam du dmag 'khrug byed par yang gra sgrig byas zin pa red/ yin na'ang / dbyin h+pha gnyis dang pho lan la dus mnyam du dmag 'khrug byed skabs/ lhas thi lis gang ltar yang su'u len la dmag 'khrug byed mi phod de/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni su'u len gyi stobs shugs dbyin h+pha gnyis las ldab 'gyur gyis che bas stabs yin/ der brten/ zla 9ba'i tshes 1nyin gyi sngon la gnas skabs su'u len la grag 'gul byed du mi 'jug pa ni hes thi lis lha jus gzhi dkar po lag bstar byed thub min gyi gnad 'gag cig la thug yod/nyes thi li'i gcig las gcig lhag pa'i btsan 'dzul gyis/ dbyin h+pha gnyis kyi gleng phyogs la zing cha chen po langs su bcug cing / tshang mas krang po lun dang ta la ti'i 'grig thabs byed pa'i srid jus la rgol gtam drag po btang / dbyin h+pha gnyis kyi srid gzhung gis phyogs so so'i gnon shugs 'og pho lan la rgyab skyor byed pa dang / phyi 'brel thad nas yang rnam 'gyur bsgyur te/ 1939lo'i zla 3pa ras bzung su'u len la 'brel 'dris byed mgo brtsams shing / de la brten nas 'jar man la gnon shugs ster ba'i stong bsam bcangs/nyes thi lis bka' phab nas 'jar man dang pho lan gyi mtha' /rdosnas

su dmag dpung btang ste/ dmag 'khrug langs la khad kyi dus su/1938lo'i dbyar khar/ yo rob gling nas ha las dgosapa'i phyi 'brel gyi 'khrug rtsod cig langs/ de'i sne 'dzing zhing rnyog 'dzing che ba'i tshad ni lo rgyus thog mthong dkon pa zhig red/ dbyin h+pha gnyis kyis phyogs gcig nas su'u len la mngon gsal du gros mol byas nas 'jar man la gnon shugs byin pa dang / phyogs gcig nas lkog nas 'jar man dang 'grig thabs e yong dang/'jar man la shar phyogs su bskyod nas rang nyid srung skyob byed thabs e 'grig bltas/ 'jar man gyis nus pa ci yod bton nas dbyin h+pha gnyis dang su'u len bar nas mna' 'brel 'dzugs pa 'gog thabs byas pas/phyogs gcig nas lkog nas dbyin h+pha gnyis la cha rkyen gtam nas de tsho 'gog thabs byas pa dang / phyogs gcig nas hur brtson gyis su'u len la gnas skabs 'grig thabs byas nas rgyab nas dgra la mi khel bar byas pa red/ su'u len gyis hur brtson gyis thun mong nas bde 'jags yong ba'i dbyin h+pha su'u rgyal khab gsum phan gyi chings yig bzhag ste h+pha shi si'i stobs shugs dar du mi 'jug pa'i 'dod blo bcangs mod/ dbyin h+pha gnyis kyis su'u len gyi drang sems dang len ma byas pa red/ mu'u nyi he'i rgyal khab btsong ba'i bslab bya la gzhigs nas su'u len gyis nub phyogs rgyal khab kyis rang nyid gcig pu 'jar man la dmag 'khrug byed pa'i nang 'drud du 'jug mi 'dod pa red/der brten/ dbyin h+pha gnyis la mngon sum du gros mol byed pa'i dus mnyam 'jar man la yang thugs 'phrad byas/ de ltar gar stegs steng 'og tu zur gsum gyi phyi 'brel 'khrug rtsod blo ngor mi shong ba zhig byed mgo bcoms/dbyin h+pha gnyis kyis su'u len la dngos su gros mol byed pa ni zla 4ba'i tshes 15nas mgo brtsams pa red/ tshes 17nyin su'u len gyis dngos su rgyal khadi/snam gyis h+pha shi sir ngo rgol byed pa'i mna' 'brel btsugs te/ phan

tshun bar 'dra mnyam du 'os 'gan dang len byed pa'i re ba bton kyang/dbyin h+pha gnyis kyis blo gcig sems gcig gis su'u len 'jar man dang kher thug byed du 'jug 'dod yod pas/ bsam bzhin du gros sol gyi dus tshod zla gnyis lhag la 'gor 'gyangs byas nas 'bras bu ci yang ma byung / zla bdun pa'i nang slebs dus gnas bab nyin re bzhin dza drag tu gyur nas dmag 'khrug langs la nye skabs/ su'u len gyis gros mol la mjug 'bras yod ched/ chab srid gros mol byed pa'i dus mtshungs su dmag don gyi gros mol kyang byed rgyu thag bcad la/ de'i don du rgyal srung mi dmangs u yon h+phu lo zhi lo rmu (ṣ+ṭha༅lko/྅lko)gtso byas pa'i dbang cha tshang ma yod pa'i 'thus mi mngags pa red/ dbyin h+pha gnyis la gleng phyogs kyis gnon shugs thebs pas rgyal khab gsum gyis dmag don gros mol byed rgyu khas mi len ka med byung yang / mngags pa'i 'thus mi rnams ni dbang cha med pa'i mi phal ba kyang kyang yin par ma zad/ kho tshos ming rtags 'god par dbang cha yod pa'i 'dzin yig kyang khyer med pa red/ der ma zad dbyin h+pha gnyis kyi 'thus mi gnam grur yang ma bsdad par/ shin tu dal ba'i yig skyel gru gzings shig la bsdad nas lam skabs kho na nas gza' 'khor gcig 'gor 'byangs byas shing / zla 8pa'i tshes 11nyin da gzod ma'o si khor slebs/ dbyin ji srid gzhung gis da dung 'thus tshab tshogs par 6 ci yang khas len mi rung mib dang /6 gros mol byas pa shin tu dal dgos mi zhes bka' bgo byas/ gnas tshul 'di las kun gyis gros mol gyi mjug 'bras ci yin pa rtogs thub/hes thi li ni dran rig rgod pa'i wa mo zhig yin te/ skabs der dbugs yang 'byin rngub ma byas par gnas tshul 'gyur phyogs la bltas nas bsdad/dbyin ji'i 'jar man du sdod pa'i gzhung tshab chen mo han rdu zhun (tshoṣ+ṭha༅)gyis kho'i〈pham pa'i las dbang 〉zhes pa'i dpe deb nang du 6 ngas bltasdu sna'i

hes thi li ni/ mig mangs rgyag mkhan zhig dang mtshungs ste/ phyogs gcig nas mig mangs ji ltar rgyag par bsam gzhigs gtong pa dang / phyogs gcig nas pha rol bos kho la phan pa'i nor 'khrul can gyi mig mangs zhig rgyag par bsgug nas 'dug ’ ces bris/ nyes thi lis dbyin h+pha gnyis kyis su'u len la gros mol byed pa'i 'gal ba lag mthil gyi ri mo bzhin gsal bor rtogs pas/ khos dus tshod ma nor bar 'gal ba de bed spyod byas/ mi 'dis tshe gang bor su'u len dang gung khran tang la ngo rgol byas nas/ thog mtha' bar gsum du su'u len ni 'jar man gyis rgya bskyed yul du bzung yod na'ang / sngon la pho lan len pa dang / de nas dbyin ji la rdung deg byas rjes ma gtogs mig sngar su'u len la dmag 'khrug rgyag mi 'dod pa red/dbyin h+pha gnyis kyis bsam bzhin du su'u len la grol mol byed par dal 'gor byed skabs/ zla 8ba'i tshes 2nyin/ lis pin the lo phus su'u len la 6 'jar man gyis su'u len dang 'brel ba je legs su gtong 'dod yod/po lo ti rgya mtsho nas mtsho nag bar gyi gnad don gang zhig kyang thag gcod mi thub rgyu med mices khos myur bar su'u len gyi phyi 'brel pu'u krang mo lo tho tru la gros mol byed 'dun yod pa bshad/ 'jar man gyis zla 9ba'i tshes 1nyin pho lan la dpung 'jug ma byas gong su'u len dang chings yig cig bzhag nas/ rang gis gzhan la gnong mi dgos par pho lan gyi gnad don thag bcad na/ rgyab nas dgra bgegs 'byung bar skrag mi dgos pa'i re ba byas/ zla 8ba'i tshes 18nyin/ lis pin the lo phus 'jar man gyi ma'o si kho na yod pa'i gzhung tshab la myur tu mo lo tho h+phu la thug 'phrad byas nas / su'u len la 6 'jar man gyi phyi 'brel srid jus la de ring lo rgyus rang bzhin ldan pa'i 'gyur mtshams shig la slebs yod pa mi nan bshad byed pa'i re ba bton/khos1 pasang tshab chen mor lha khyod kyis nges par du su'u len srid gzhung la dzo

ma'o si khor 'tshams 'drir yong ba myur du 'thad par zhu dgos 'jar man dang pho lan bar dmag 'khrug mngon sum du 'byung srid/ der brten ngas myur du ma'o si khor 'tshams 'dri byed thub na nga tshor phan pa rgya chen po yod/ thag gcod rang bzhin gyi don 'di khyod kyi sems la dam por 'dzin dgos mi shes nan bshad byas/ lis pin the lo phu'i glog 'phrin 'di'i nang na tsha'i 'jar man gyis myur du su'u 'jar chings yig 'jog pa'i dmigs yul mthong thub/ yin na'ang su'u len gyi lan ma thon pas/ hes thi li la brel 'tshub chen po langs nas 'dug mi bzod par gyur/ der brten/ zla 8pa'i tshes 20nyin/ khos sku dngos su si ta len la glog 'phrin zhig btang nas 6 zla 8pa'i tshes 22nyin te gza' pa sangs dang / ches 'phyi na'ang tshes 23te gza' spen pa'i nyin nged rgyal khab gyi gzhung tshab chen mor thug 'phrad gnang bar zhu mi zhes re ba zhus/su'u len gyis na tsha'i 'jar man gyis su'u len dang gung khran tang la ngo rgol dang btsan 'dzul rgya bskyed byed par dogs zon byas yod pas/ yo rob gling gi rgyal khab so sos h+pha shi sir ngo rgol byed pa'i 'thab phyogs gcig gyur btsugs nas thun mong du bde 'jags yong ba'i 'dod blo bzung yod/ 'on kyang skabs de'i dbyin t+pa'i dbang bsgyur pa rnams 'grig rithabs ring lugs la kha phyogs pa dang / chag sgo shar phyogs su 'dren ci thub byed pas/ dbyin ji dang / h+pha ran si/ su'u len bcas rgyal khab gsum gyi gros mol de byed thabs ma 'grig pa red/ su'u len la skabs der nyen kha tshabs chen yod de/shar phyogs nas 1938lo dang 1939lo la 'ja' phan h+pha shi sis bsdud mar lha krang ko'u h+phin ( ṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭha)don rkyen ’ dang 66no meng khan ( 647)don rkyen ’ gyi dmag 'khrug dza drag can gnyis brgyab ste/ su'u len gyis dmag dpung 'bor chen shar phyogs su bskyod nas 'ja' dmag mi 'gog kā byed

byung pa dang / nub phyogs nas 'jar man h+pha shi si su'u len gyi nub sgor thon yod pas dmag 'khrug langs nyen yod/ de'i thog la dbyin h+pha gnyis kyis rgyun chad med par 'jar man gyis su'u len la rgol ba rgya yan du gtong bzhin yod pas/ gal srid 'jar man dang dmag rgyab na 'ja' phan dang 'jar man h+pha shi sis shar nub gnyis nas su'u len bar la btsir ba'i dka' khag 'byung srid/ gnas tshul tshabs chen de la gzhigs nas su'u len mgo khrid pas rgyal khab rang gi mi dmangs kyi yun ring gi khe phan la bsam blo gtong ba dang / rgyal khab kyi bde 'jags dang dmag 'khrug gra sgrig byed pa'i dus tshod brtson len byed ched/ 'jar man gyi re ba ltar lis pi the lo phu ma'o si khor yong nas 'tshams 'dri byed par 'thad pa byung /zla 8pa'i tshes 23nyin/ 'jar man gyi phyi 'brel pu'u krang lis pin the lo phu ma'o si khor yong ba dang / nyin der mo lo tho rmu dang mnyam du 〈su'u 'jar phan tshun btsan 'dzul mi byed pa'i chings yig 〉bzhag chings yig de'i nang du mna' gan la gnas pa'i phyogs gnyis gas khor kyang ngam rgyal khab gzhan la mnyam 'brel byas nas phan tshun bar drag chas gtan nas mi bkol pa dang /gal te mna' gan la gnas pa'i phyogs gcig rgyal khab gzhan pa'i dgrar 'dzin sar gyur na/ gcig shos kyis mna' gan la gnas pa'i phyogs kyi rgyal khab gzhan pa der gtan nas rogs skyor gang yang mi byed pa dang / gal te mna' gan la gnas pa'i phyogs gnyis ku'i bar 'gal ba byung na zhi bde'i rnam pa'i sgo nas thag gcod rgyu sogs gtan 'bebs byas yod pa dang /chings yig gis go chod pa'i dus yun lo bcu yin/〈su'u 'jar phan tshun btsan 'dzul mi byed pa'i chings yig 〉bzhag pa des dbyin h+pha dbang sgyur tshogs pas chag sgo shar phyogs su 'dren pa'i lkog gdi /6 stong du song pa dang / rjes su su'u len 'jar man h+pha shi si las rnam

par rgyal bar gser lta bu'i zla ba 22ring gi dus tshod brtson len byed thub pa byung / yin na'ang ches rnyog 'dzing che ba'i khyad par can gyi lo rgyus cha rkyen 'og bzhag pa'i chings yig 'di la zhan cha'i phyogs kyang yod de/ gtso bo ni hos thi lis phyogs gnyis nas dmag 'khrug byed mi dgos pa dang / rgyab nas dgra bo'i nyen kha 'byung bar skrag mi dgos par gyur nas/ khos 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa slong ba'i gom stabs je mgyogs su song / de min chings yig bzhag rjes kyi dus skabs shig gi nang / su'u len gyi mgo khrid pas 'jar man h+pha shi si ni ches nyen kha che ba'i dgra bor ma brtsis par/ de las ldog ste dbyin h+pha gnyis ni rdung deg byed pa'i dmigs 'ben la brtsis pa red/de las su'u len dang rgyal khab so po'i mi dmangs khrod bsam blor rnyog dra bzos pa dang / yo rob gling gi rgyal khab la la'i gung khran tang dang mang tshogs kyis h+pha shi si la ngo rgol byed pa'i kha phyogs mi gsal bar gyur/ de dang mnyam du su'u len gyi bya spyod 'dis pho lan mi dmangs kyi khe phan 'ga' zhig la gnod pa bskyal bas/ spyi tshogs ring lugs rgyal khab kyi phyi phyogs 'brel ba'i rtsa don dang yang mi mthun pa red/ 157

sa bcad lnga ba/ 'dzam gling 'khrag chen gnyis pa phyogs yongs nas lachos pa/(gcig) lha jus gzhi dkar po mi ste 'jar dmag gis pho lam la btsan 'dzul byas pa/lis pin the lo phu ma'o si kho nas chu tshod 24ma gtogs ma bsdad pa dang /zla 8pa'i tshes 24nyin phyir per lin du thon pa red/ skabs der lis pin the lo phu shin tu dga' spro skyes nas rang nyid 6 pis si me ’ (44lots+tsha)gnyis par rlom zhing / khos ma'o si kho nas khyer yong ba'i chod yig gis 6 pho lan la blo rgya bskyed nas rdung deg byas ’ te/ rgyal khab de 6 dus rabs phyed tsam la yar langs mi thub pa bzo thub ’ ces bshad/ nyes thi lis nyin der kho'i phyi 'brel pu'u krang gis ma'o si khor song ba'i gnas tshul yar zhu byas par nyan zhing /su'u len la gnas skabs 'grig thabs byas pa de las kho'i rdog khres lji mo zhig phab pa ltar sems lhod la bab/zla 8pa'i tshes 29nyin/ hes thi lis dbyin ji'i gzhung tshab chen mo han rdi zhun la thug 'phrad byas nas pho lan gyis dbang cha thams cad yod pa'i 'thus mi zhig per lin la mngags te gros mol byed dgos pa'i skad brda btang / khos o si khru ri ya dang je khe si lo wa kher btsan 'dzin byas pa ltar las sla ro/ byed 'dod cing / hes thi lis dbyin ji'i gzhung tshab chen mor che nga tshozhi )zlog mi rnams kyis nga la dmag 'khrug rgyag rgyu yin nam min zhes 'dri

ken yod pas/ da dus tshod chud zos la gtong rgyu med mices 'jigs snang bskur/ nyes thi li'i yid bzhin 'grub par snyam pa'i khog rtsis ni zla 8pa'i tshes 30nyin pho lan gyi mi per lin la yong ba dang / zla 8pa'i tshes 31nyin gros mol byed ma thub pa dang / zla 9pa'i tshes 1nyin dus bcad ltar kho bo'i 64jus gzhi dkar po mi lag bstar byas te/ pho lan la btsan 'dzul byed rgyu de red/ nang khul gyi gnon shugs thebs pas thengs 'dir dbyin h+pha rgyal khab gnyis kyis pho lan gyi 'thus mi btsan gyis per len la 'gro bar ma bskul pa red/ zla 8pa'i tshes 31gi nyin gung / nyes thi lis 6 dmag 'khrug byed pa'i bka' dang por ’ chog mchan bkod/don dngos thog 'jar dmag gi btsan 'dzul bkod sgrig gi nang 66'byung par nges pa'i bsam yul las 'das pa'i don rkyen :kyang gra sgrig byas tshar ba red/ de ni zla 8pa'i tshes 31nyin/ pho lan gyi mtha' mtshams la nye ba'i 'jar man gyi ki le we tshu (lkolko cho)rgyang bsgrags khang la pho lan gyi dmag lwa gon pa'i dmag khag cig gis 'jab rgol byas te/ 2 'jar man gyi dmag mi 910lhag bsad cing / pho lan gyi 6btsan 'dzul dmag ’ gis rgyang bsgrags las khungs btsan bzung byas te/ pho lan skad kyis skul slong rang bzhin gyi 'jar man la ngo rgol byed pa'i rgyang bsgrags btang / ma gzhir de ni ki pher dang / zhi mu'u les sems zhib mos bkod sgrig byas pa yin zhing /bya 'gul de'i ming la 6 krin blug ngang sha ’ zer/ 6 btsan 'dzul byed mkhan gyi pho lan gyi dmag mi yod tshad na tshas tang we ru khag gi khongs mis brdzus pa yin 'ing / 6 bas da pa'i ’ 'jar man gyi dmag mi 'ga' ni btson khang nas khrid yong ba'i btson ma yin te/ sngon la de dag la sbrid sman rgyab yod pa red/ki le we tshur 6 tshur rgol mi byed pa'i don rkyen byung rjes/ 'jar man gyis pho lan la 6 rgol lan sprod par mi tshul mthun gyi rgyu mtshan :yod pas/ / ༵༵'i

tshes 1nyin/ 'jar dmag khri tsho 150de 'jar pho mtha' mtshams nas brgal te/ pho lan gyi dkyil khul du chu log bzhin shor yong ba red// ci tho che — pa — 4 'jar dmag gis 'jar man dang pho lan sa mtshams gyi lcags khra bsheg pa/'jar dmag gis pho lan la phyogs yongs nas btsan 'dzul byas pa'i nyin de'i phyi dror/ hos thi li rgyal tshogs su song ste/ 6 nyi ma hril bo gnyis la nga dang nga'i srid gzhung gis pho lan srid gzhung gis dbang cha tshang ma yod pa'i 'thus mi zhig mngags e yong la sgug nas bsdad kyang / kha sang dgong mor pho lan gyi dngos gzhi'i dmag dpung gis nga tsho'i mnga' khongs su tshur rgol thengs dang po bslangs/ nga tshos de ring snga mo'i chu tshod 5dang skar ma 40thog rgol lan sprod mgo brtsams/ da nas bzung 'bar mdel gyis 'bar mdel la ya lan sprod rgyu yin ’ pa'i gtam bshad/'jar dmag gis pho lan la btsan 'dzul byas rjes/ dbyin h+pha srid gzhung gis da dung bar 'dum byed bsam zhing / zla 9pa'i tshes 1nyin/dbyin h+pha rgyal khab gnyis kyis snga gzhug tu 'jar man la yi ge bskur te/ pho 160

lan la dpung 'jug byed pa mtshams 'jog rgyu'i re ba bton pa dang / gal te mtshams mi 'jog na dbyin h+pha gnyis kyis pho lan la khas blangs yod pa'i 'os 'gan 'khur rgyu yin zhes bshad/ 'jar man gyis dbyin h+pha gnyis kyi yi ge la kha ya ma byas pa dang / zla 9pa'i tshes 3nyin/ dbyin h+pha gnyis kyis 'jar man la dmag brda mi gtong ka med byung / dbyin ji'i rang skyong mnga' khongs rgya gar dang / o si khru li ya/ lde'u tsi lan/ kha na ta/ a h+phe ri kha lho ma sogs kyis kyang dbyin ji'i rjes la mthud nas dmag brda btang / skabs der 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa de phyogs re ba'i dmag 'khrug nas khyon yongs kyi dmag 'khrug tu 'gyur/'jar man gyis pho lan la dpung 'jug byas pa dang / dbyin h+pha gnyis kyis 'jar man la dmag brda btang pa des/ 'grig thabs ring lugs ('os med zhod 'jags ring lugs )de pham par gyur ba mtshon yod/ 'grig thabs ring lugs kyi 'thus tshab pa krang po lun gyis gros khang 'og ma nas bya thabs med pa'i sgo nas 6 de ring ni nga tsho tshang ma yid skyo ba'i nyin zhig red/ de'i nang nas kyang nga las lhag pa'i yid skyo ba zhig med/ ngas gzhung gi las sne khur ba'i ring / ngas de'i ched du sgrub pa'i bya ba yod tshad dang / ngas bcangs pa'i re 'dun thams cad/ ngas dad pa byed pa'i yod tshad don stong du gyur mi zhes bshad/'jar man h+pha shi sis pho lan la btsan 'dzul byed par gra sgrig bzang po byas yod de/ des hri 62kyi mi khri tsho 150dang / gnam gru 2300/ than khe stong 6000dmag 'khrug la bkod sgrig byas/ pho lan la btsan 'dzul byed pa'i dmag 'khrug khrod/ thengs dang por na tsha'i dmag dpon ku'u te li an (lha tshoṣ+ṭha)gyi gnam gru dang / than khe/ ma'o tho'i 'phrul chas can gyi dmag dpung bcas mnyam du bsdus te/ myur bar pho lan rgyal nang nā sdur

rgol byed pa'i 6 glog 'khyug ’ 'thab jus bkol/ na tsha'i mkha' dmag gis pho lin gyi lcags lam ma lag gtor brlag byas par ma zad/ pho lan gyi mkha' dmag kyang tshar gcod byas/ 'jar dmag gi grong ca hri 6dang / yang ba'i krong ca hri 4/ ma'o tho can gyi hri 4bcas kyis myur bar dkyil gshags nas pho lan gyi nang la bskyod de/ nyin gnyis kyang ma 'gor bar pho lan gyi dngos ga'i'i dmag dpung kha thor ya bral du btang / pho lan gyi dmag dpung ni rtab rtab por dmag 'khrug la zhugs pa yin pas/ 'jar dmag gi 6 glog 'khyug dmag 'khrug gi sngon nas kho tsho'i 'grim 'grul dang / skud med glog gi 'brel gtug tshang ma gtor bas zing zing long long du gyur te/ dmag dpon gyis dmag mir 'brel gtugs byed mi thub pa dang / dmag mis dmag dpon gang du yod pa mi shes par gyur/ zla 9pa'i tshes 8nyin 'jar dmag gis war so (lha'i/ )(pho lan gyi rgyal sa )la dpung 'jug byed mgo brtsama~X /lan ma rtsa ring lugs srid gzhung gis rang gi bde 'jags de dbyin h+pha gnyis kyi 6 khag theg mi la bcol nas/ rgyal srung la snang chung byas pas/'jar man gyi 'phrul chas dmag dpung thogs med du shar bskyod byed thub pa dang / gang la bgrod par bkag 'gog med pa red/ phyi 'brel thad nas pho lan yun ring bor dbyin h+pha gnyis kyi rjes su 'brang nas/ su'u len dgra ru bcad pas/ rang nyid stobs chung nus med du gyur/ 'jar dmag gis btsan 'dzul byas rjes dpon rigs che chung dag gis mi rigs kyi khe phan rgyab tu g.yugs nas 'tshang kha shig shig gis ro ma ni ya (༅67༅)la bros/ zla 9pa'i tshes 24nyin/ pho lan srid gzhung gis 'gog rgol mtshams bzhag pa khyab bsgrags byas kyang / pho lan mi dmangs kyi dpa' ma zhum pa red/ war so/ spyazlog dmangs kyis tshad mtho ba'i rgyal gces ring lugs kyi snying stobs

bskyed de/ kho tshos dpa' ngar gyis rgyal sa srung skyob byed pa'i dmag 'khrug byas/ dmag 'khrug nyin 20lhag la rgyun 'khyongs byas nas/ zla 9pa'i tshes 28nyin da gzod 'jar dmag gis war so yongs rdzogs 'dzin thub pa byung /pho lan ni zla gcig ma 'gor ba tsam gyi nang h+pha shi si btsan 'dzul dmag gis rdog rdzis thebs pas/ o si khru ri ya dang / je khe si lo wa khe/ ar pa ni ya'i rjes nas btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi btsan 'dzul srid jus la 'grig thabs byed pa'i sris jus kyi glud rdzas su gyur/na tshas 'jar man gyis dmag shugs che ba phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas pho lan la dpung 'jug byed skabs/ nub phyogs nas hri 35tsam ba'ag nas 'gog srung byas/ pho lan gyi mna' mthun rgyal khab dbyin jis dmag brda btang nas zla gcig 'gor rjes da gzod yo rob gling gi skam sa chen po'i h+pha ran si dang per krim sa mtshams su dmag dpung btang ste/ 6 rgyab rogs byed khul tsam byas mi/ mna' mthun rgyal khab cig shos te h+pha ran si la skabs der dmag dpung hri 100lhag yod kyang / 6 ma chi no'i 'gog srung 'dzing rags ’ su skung ste ma 'gul bar pho lan pham par bltas nas bsdad/ dbyin h+pha mnyam 'brel dmag la nub phyogs nas stobs shugs chen po yod pas/rang 'gul gyis 'jar dmag la phar rgol byas na/ 'jar man la rgyab nas dgra la thug pa'i dka' khag byung ste/ pho lan skyob thub na 'ang thang mod/dbyin h+pha mnyam 'brel dmag gi dmag spyi chen mo kun mo lin (5lkolko)gyis 6 nges par dgra bos tshur rgol byed par sgug nas 'dug pa dang / rgol mi thub pa'i 'dzing rags brtsigs pa dang grog shur brkos nas dgra dmag 'gog dgos mi shes bka' phab/tes thi lis dmag shugs che ba phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas sngon la pho lan len pa dang / rmi dun rgyab gnyis nas dmag 'khrug rgyag pa se~X dzod/

bsam bzhin du dbyin h+pha gnyis la phu zhi bde'i dpung 'jug byas/ mi khos 66'jar man la nub phyogs nas mnga' khongs bdag 'dzin byed pa'i ham sems med ’ pas/ 'jar man gyis nub phyogs rgyal khab stobs chen la dmag 'khrug byed pa'i gnas lugs med ces bshad/ 'jar ca/na gyis pho lan btsan bzung byas rjes/ than khe dang krong ca 'khor lo phyed ka la zhig gso dang / mdel rdzas kha gsab/ dmag dpung gis ngal gso bcas byed par dus tshod dgos pa red/ nyes thi lis dmag dpung nub phyogs la 'dren pa'i gra sgrig byed pa dang mnyam du/ mu mthud nas 6 zhi bde'i glu dbyangs yang yang blangs te/ dbyin h+pha gnyis la mgo skor btang /der brten/ pho lan g.yul sa nas skyogs mdel gyi sgra zhi 'jags su song rjes/ dmag dpung phan tshun kha gtad du yod pa'i nub phyogs nas kyang shin du zhi 'jags yin/ 1939lo'i zla 9pa'i tshes 3nyin/ dbyin h+pha gnyis kyis 'jar man la dmag brda btang nas bzung ste 1940lo'i ston kha bar/dbyin h+pha mnyam 'brel dmag dpung dang 'jar dmag gis dmag 'khrug ngo ma zhig ma brgyab pa dang / dmag 'khrug langs nas zla gsum gyi rjes nas dbyinaji'i nyen rtog pan krang zhig bsad pa tsam las gnas tshul ci yang ma byung / ma chi no'i 'dzing rags su gab yod pa'i h+pha ran si'i dmag mi la las rgyu gzhan med pas/ 'dzing rags kyi phyi nas rtsed 'jor rol te nyi ma gtong thabs byas/ mu mthun nas 'grig thabs ring lugs lag bstar byed pa'i h+pha ran si'i dbang 'dzin pas tsa kha rog tu 'dug pa'i srid jus sakyi bzang cha 'ur sgrog byas/ kho tshos 6 srid jus 'di la brten nas dmag gcig kyang ma shi bar rgyal khab kyi mnga' khongs cha tshang bar srung thub pa byung ’ zhes bshad pa ni/'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa'i lo rgyus thog ming du grags pa'i 66'jam sdod1 ༵༵ga 'khrug gam/ 6 ya mtshan can gyi dmag 'khrug migam/ 2 dmag

'khrug rdzun ma ’ mam/ 6 mi gsal ba'i dmag 'khrug ’ zer ba de red/dbyin phos 'jar man la dmag brda btang kyang dmag 'khrug mi rgyag par/ dmag dpung khri tsho 100lhag gis mdun g.yul nas nyi ma gtong thabs byed skabs/ hes thi lis lkog nas dza drag gis dmag dpung skong sgrig byas te/mu mthud nas dmag dpung rgya bskyed dang dmag 'khrug gi gra sgrig byas pa dang /gnam gru dang / me phyogs/ than khe sogs bzo grwa nas mtshams mi chad par mdun g.yul la bskyal cing / dmag dpung 'bor chen yang bskyar nub phyogs su bkod sgrig byas/ 'jar dmag gi nub phyogs kyi dmag shugs de myur bar hri 35nas hri 136la rgya bskyed/ nyes thi lis nub phyogs nas lag 'gul mgo brtsams te/ dbyin phos bkyags pa'i rdo des rang gi rkang par brgyab pa'i mjug 'bras myur tu byung /(gnyis) su'u len rgyas 66shar phyogs kyi 'gog srung ma lag mi btsugs pa/su'u len dang 'jar man gyis 〈su'u 'jar phan tshun btsan 'dzul mi byed pa'i chings yig 〉bzhag kyang / na tshas dmag dpung gis pho lan la btsan 'dzul byas rjes/ su'u len gyi bde 'jags la nyen kha tshabs chen bzos/ 'thab jus thad nas bsam blo btang ste 1939lo'i zla 9pa nas 1940lo'i zla 8pa'i bar/ su'u len nub phyogs kyi mtha' mtshams la 'gyur ldog rab dang rim pa byung zhing / po lo ti rgya mtsho nas mtsho nag bar gyi smyo shar phyogs 'dzing rags ’ gsar ba zhig brtsigs te/ 'jar jag gi btsan 'dzul 'gog srung byed pa'i rgya che ru btang /1939lo'i zla 9pa'i tshes 17nyin/ 'jar dmag gis war so bstu/ te

pho lan srid gzhung gi dpon rigs rnams rtab rtab por phyi rgyal la 'bro ba'i skabs su/ su'u len gyis ma'o si kho na yod pa'i pho lan gyi gzhung tshab chen mo bos te/ 6 nub wu'u khi lan dang nub u ru su dkar po'i sdod dmangs kyi tshe srog dang rgyu nor gyi bde 'jags la mi srung skyob byed ched/ 6 pho lan gyi rgyal khab dang srid gzhung med pa'i gnas tshul 'og pho lan de su'u len la nyen kha 'byung ba dang bsam yul las 'das pa'i don rkyen 'byung sla sa 'ig tu 'gyur nyen yod pas mi su'u len gyi dmag dpung pho lan la bskyod rgyu yin zhes bshad/ nyin der su'u len gyi dmag dpung nub wu'u khi lan dang nub u ru su dkar po'i sa khul la btang ba dang / lo de'i zla 11pa'i nang / nub wu'u khi la na dang nub u ru su dkar po su'u len gyi khongs su bsdus shing / de'i spyi'i rgya khyon la spyi le gru ba'i ma khri tsho 20dang / sdod dmangs khri tsho 1300lhag yod/ nub wu'u khi lan dang nub u ru su dkar po'i gnad don thag bcad rjes/ su'u len gyis su'u h+phin 'brel ba'i gnad don thag gcod pa'i sems thag bcad/su'u h+phin bar gyi 'brel ba sngar nas de 'dra bzang rgyu med pas/ su'u len gyis na chos 'jar man gyis su'u h+phin gnyis kyi 'brel ba mi bzang ba de bed spyad nas su'u len la btsan 'dzul byed par dogs mi bde ba byung / r+ṣanyin ki li (sto//rtswatsha4lha'i)nas h+phin lan (195)gyi rgyal mtshams bar la spyi le 32yod pa dang / byang phyogs dang khyad pa/ le nyin ki li'i 'gog srung nusapar shugs snon ched/ su'u len gyis sngar nas h+phin lan srid gzhung la gros mol byed thabs 'tshol ba'in yod/ 1939lo'i zla 11par/ su'u h+phin rgyalakhab phyogs gnyis kyi 'thus mis gros mol byas/ su'u len gyis 6 su'u h+phin rogs res spyi chings 'jog pa'i re ba bton mod/ h+phin lan phyogs kyisadang1 byis ma byas/ de dang mthun nas su'u len gyis h+phin lan gyis han khi

phyed gling (tshos༈cha)lo 30g.yar nas mtsho dmag gi gzhi sa byed pa dang /h+phin lan gyis le nyin ki li dang 'brel sa'i mtha' mtshams byang phyogs su spyi le 20nas 30phyir 'then na/ su'u len gyis de'i skyin par shar kha li le a (lkordo lko/lo)nas gong gi ldab gnyis kyi mnga' khongs h+phin lan la ster bar bshad kyang / h+phin lan gyis de yang khas ma blangs bar gros mol byed ma thub/zla 11pa'i tshes 30nyin/ susgru len gyis h+phin lan la dmag dpung btang nas su'u h+phin dmag 'khrug langs/zla gsum la drag 'thab byas rjes/ su'u len gyis h+phin lan gyi 2 man na lin 'dzing rags ’ gtor te/ h+phin lan srid gzhung la btsan gyis gros mol byed du bcug 1940zla 3pa'i tshes 12nyin/ su'u h+phin gnyis kyis smyo zhi bde'i chings yig bzhag zhi chings de'i nang su'u len gyis kha li lis a sa khul nas h+phin lan la spyi le 150bcad nas ster rgyu dang / su'u len la h+phin lan nas mnga' khongs spyi le gru bzhi ma khri tsho 4 1stor ba dang / de dang mnyam du h+phin lan gyis han khe phyed gling dang de'i 'gram gyi mtsho khul su'u len la lo sum cur g.yar te mtsho dmag gi gzhi sa byed pa dang / su'u len gyis lo rer h+phin lan la g.yar dngul h+phin lan ma khi khri tsho 800sprod pa bcas thag bcad yod/ de ltar su'u len gyi le nyin ki li sa khul gyi 'gog srung la shugs ches cher snon thub pa byung /su'u len gyis le nyin ki li sa khul gyi 'gog srung gnad don thag bcad rjes/ sa khul de dag la 'brel yod pa'i li thi wan (2 7)dang / la the wi ya(khrim ༅)/ e so ni ya (tsho'i/ ༅༅)bcas po lo ti rgya mtsho'i mtha' khul gyi rgyal khab gsum gyi 'gog srung gi gnad don de lhag par 'bur tu thon yod pa red/ su'u len gyis rgyal khab de dag la su'u len gyi le nyin ki li dang po lo ti rgya mtsho'i sa khul gyi bde 'jags kyi 'thab jus kyi don snying gastu shān

yod par bsam/ 1939lo'i zla 9par/ su'u len gyis e so ni ya dang / la snro wi ya/ li thi wan ni ya bcas rgyal khab gsum la ra phan tshun rogs res spyi ngas rdo ༵/kā'i dpyid ka dang dbyar khar/ na tshas 'jar man gyis yo rob byang phyogs kyi tan meg (94)dang / no we (77)sogs btsan bzung byas te nub phyogs nas rgyal kha bstud mar thob rjes/ nyes thi lis po lo ti mtsho 'gram gyi rgyal khab rnams khyur mid byas te/ 'jar dmag shar phyogs su su'u len la bskyod skabs kyi byang lam dmag dpung gi bgrod lam byed pa'i ham sems bcangs/ gnas tshul 'di 'dra'i 'og gom gang mdun spos kyis 6 shar phyogs kyi 'dzing rags 'grub par byas te/ su'u len gyi 'thab jus go gnas je legs su gtong ba ni/ su'u len la mtshon na shin tu gal che bar 'dug 1940lo'i zla 6pa'i tshes 14nyin/ su'u len srid gzhung gas po lo ti rgya mtsho'i 'gram rgyud kyi rgyal khab gsum gyis su'u len la ngo rgol byed pa'i dmag don mna' 'brel btsugs par tshig mtshon btab/ zla 6pa'i tshes 15nyin/ su'u len gyis li thi wan ni ya dang / la the wi ya/ e so ni ya bcas rgyal khab gsum la dmag dpung btang / rgyal khab de gsum gyi gung khran tang gi rtsa 'dzugs kyis su'u len gyi rogs skyor 'og myur bar h+pha shi si la ngo rgol byed pa'i 'thab phyogs btsugs par ma zad/ rgyal khab rang rang gi ma rtsa ring lugs kyi srid gzhung mgo rting slog zla 7par/ rgyal khab gsum gyis dus mnyam du su'u we chad srid dbang btsugs pa khyab bsgrags byas shing / su'u len gyi ches mtho'i su'u we ed kyis myur tu tshogs 'du 'tshogs nas li thi wan ni ya dang / la the wi ya/ e so ni ya bcas rgyal khab gsum po su'u len la zhugs pa khyab bsgrags byas/167940lo'i zla 6pa'i zla smad la/ su'u len srid gzhung gis myur du ro ma

ni ya srid gzhung la brda brgyab ste/ myur bar pis sa la pis ya 2 phyir su'u len la ster dgos pa dang / de dang mnyam du byang phyogs kyi pu'u khi we na (46lo14 po)yang su'u len la byin nas pis sa la pis ya 6 btsan bzung mi byas pa'i 66skyin tshab mibyed dgos par bshad/ zla 6pa'i tshes 28nyin ro ma ni ya srid gzhung gis su'u len gyi gong gsal re 'dod dang len byed par bshad/nyin der su'u dmag sa khul de bdag 'dzin byed du 'gro mgo brtsams pa dang /zla 6pa'i tshes 30nyin/ su'u len gyi dmag dpung gis ro ma ni ya'i pis sa la pis ya dang byang phyogs kyi pu'u khi we na bdag 'dzin byas/ de'i spyi'i rgya khyon la spyi le gru bzhi ma khri tsho 5 1yod pa dang / mi grangs khri tsho 400yod/ su'u len ches mtho'i su'u we ed tshogs 'dus pis sa pis ya mor ta we ya su'u we chad spyi tshogs ring lugs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi khongs su bsdu pa dang / byang pu'u khe we na wu'u khe lan su'u we ed spyi tshogs ring lugs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi khongs su bsdu ba thag bcad/skabs de nas po lo ti rgya mtsho nas mtsho nag bar gyi su'u len gyi 6 shar phyogs 'dzing rags ’ grub cing / su'u len nub phyogs kyi rgyal mtshams byang phyogs su spyi le sum brgya nas bzhi brgya'i bar rgya bskyed/ mo lo tho spus smyo su'u we ed rgyal phran mnyam 'brel gyi bde 'jags khag theg byed pa'i lta ba bzung na/ don 'di shin du gal che mi bar bsam/(gsum) jus gzhi ser po mi ste/ nyes thi lis yo rab gling gi nub phyogs su 66drag rgol mi byas/hes thi lis 6 jus gzhi dkar po ’ lag bstar byas te/ pho lan btsan bzung byas rjes/ sngon gyi 'char gzhi ltar na myur bar nub phyogs la 1hā/ga

dpung btang ste/ 6 jus gzhi ser po mi lag bstar byas nas yo rob nub phyogs su drag rgol byed rgyu de yin/ 1939lo'i zla 10pa'i tshes 9nyin/ nyes thi lis 6 jus gzhi ser po'i ’ dmag 'thab bka' khyab spel skabs/ 'jar dmag gi dmigs yul ni gang thub sgos h+pha ran si'i dmag dpung dang / de dang dpung ba mnyam gshib kyis dmag 'khrug byed pa'i mna' 'brel rgyal khab kyi dmag dpung tshar gcod byed pa dang mnyam du/ ho lan dang / per krem/ h+pha ran si bcas kyi byang phyogs nas sa khul che tsam bzung ste/ dbyin ji la mkha' 'thab byed pa'i gzhi sa byed bsam pa red/ na tshas dmag dpung gi nang khul gyi rgyu rkyen gyis lhas thi lis 6 jus gzhi ser po dus tshon ring tsam la lag bstar ma byas pa red/yo rob nub phyogs la dpung 'jug byed pa'i 'char gzhi'i nang /dbyin h+pha rgyal khab gnyis kyis mtsho thog nas 'jar man bkag sdom dang su'e tan nas nor we'i gru kha brgyud de 'jar man la lcags kyi gter rdo 'dren pa'i gru lam bkag sdom byed pa 'gog ched/ nyes thi lis 6 jus gzhi ser bo ’ lag bstar ma byas gong yo rob byang phyogs kyi tan meg dang / nor we 'phrog rtsa'i thag bcad/ 1940lo'i zla 4pa'i tshes 9nyin/ 'jar man gyi mkha' 'bab dmagadapung dang mtsho dmag gis glog ltar myur ba'i sgo nas kho pen ha ken ( rnye77)dang / o so lo ( molo)gnyis dang gru kha gal chen 'ga' btsan 'dzin byas/ tan meg gis nyin der 'gog rgol mtshams bzhag pa dang / nor we'i rgyal po dang srid gzhung gis rgyal sa btang nas byang phyogs su song ste/ 'jar man h+pha shi si'i btsan 'dzul la 'gog rgol byas/ 'jar man gyis bslus pa'i nor we'i rgyal srung pu'u krang ce si lin (tshimatho)gyis 'jar jag la gzhogs 'degs byas te/ phyi nang 'brel nas phyogs phyogs su sod // rgyal tshong srid gzhung rtsa 'dzugs byas/ de nas bzung ce si lin ni

tsa nang rul ba dang 6 rgyal tshong chom rkun mi gyi don gcig ming gi rnam grangs su gyur/ 'jar dmag gis nor we la btsan 'dzul byas rjes/ dbyin h+pha gnyis kyis dmag dpung btang nas rgyab rogs byas/ re zhig la 'jar dmag gi rdzog nyams kyi mgo mnan mod/ phyis su h+pha ran si'i mdun g.yul nas dmag 'khrug dza drag che bas/ nor we nas dmag dpung phyir mi 'then ka med byung /de nas nor we'i rgyal po dang srid gzhung lun ton tu 'khyar/1940lo'i zla 5pa'i tshes 10nyin/ 'jar man h+pha shi sis 6 jus gzhi ser po milag bstar byed mgo brtsams te yo rob nub mar glo bur du drag rgol byas/ hes thi lis cu thon cun 3dang / hri 136/ krong ca 'khor lo 3000/gnam gru 3800lhag rtsa 'dzugs byas shing / dmag khag gsum la bgos te dus mnyam du ho lan dang / per krem/ h+pha ran si gsum la drag rgol byas/de nas kha khu sim pa'i nub g.yul de mur khrag gi rgya mtsho lta bur bsgyur/lhas thi lis yo rob nub mar glo bur du drag rgol byas pa des 'grig thabs byed pa'i srid jus lag bstar byas par mjug 'bras bzang po med pa yang dag mtshon/ 'jar dmag gis yo rab nub mar rgol rdung byas pa'i nyin de zla 5ba'i tshes 10nyin/ krang po lun go gnas las bab pa dang / lo 65yin pa'i win si tun chig cer (7lo11 2tshipo)gyis nyen kha dang dka' ngal che ba'i dus skabs su dbyin ji'i dbu bzhugs blon chen khur/ zla 5pa'i tshes 13nyin/ khos gros tshogs kyi khongs mi la smyo nga la gzhan pa ci yang med/ yod pa ni zung khrag dron mo dang / dka' spyad/ mig chu dang rngul chu bcas kun la 'bul myu de yin zhes gtam bshad/ chig cer gyis dbu bzhugs blon chen khur rjes/ krang po lun gyi 'grig thabs byed pa'i srid jus bcos bsgyur byas te/ h+pha shi si la ngo rgol byed pa'i dmag 'khrug rgyun 'khyongs byas/ khos 6 dbyin ji la bsam rgyu gcig yod/ de ni nyes thi'i ring1 sta/sa

tshar gcod byed rgyu de yin ’ zhes bshad/ nyes thi lis kyang ra chig cer srid 'dzin khang la thon rjes/ dmag 'khrug dngos su mgo brtsams pa red mices khas za~X/ /na'ang h+pha ran sis da dung 'grig thabs byed pa'i ring lugs rtsa ba nas ma dor bar ma zad/ dmag don bsam blo yang shin tu rnying zhen yin/kho tshos srol rgyun gyi dmag don bsam blo ltar/ dmag dpung 'bor chen h+pha ran si dang 'jar man mtha' mtshams kyi 6 ma chi no 'gog srung lam thig ril bkod sgrig byas/ 'jar dmag gis bsam bzhin du zu ma chi no 'gog srung lam thig la drag rgol ma byas par/ spyi le 350yod pa'i lam thig 'dir hri 19tsam bkod sgrig byas shing / zil shugs che mdog gis phar rgol byas te/gang thub sgos h+pha ran si'i gtso dmag gi shugs skyil thabs byas/ 'jar dmag gi gtso rgol 'gan khur ni g.yon rus khur yod de/ de la hri 45dang /thanasa'i hri 7bcas kyis myur tu h+pha ran si'i nang khul la dpung 'jug byas/nyin gsum gyi nang 'jar dmag gi than khe hris (ku'u te li an gyi krong ca hri 3dang ro mer gyi hri gcig )bsam dbang dran dbang med par 'gro lam kyag kyog yin pa'i 6 rang grub btsan 'gag a tin ri khul brgyud cing / zla 5pa'i tshes 14nyin/ ma si chu bo brgal te/ bad kur ti nan ( 7tshe)dang / si tang (2zo)sogs btsan 'gag la slebs/ tshes 15nyin/ h+pha ran si'i srid blon li nos (07)chig cer la 6 nga tsho pham thal/ dmag 'khrug 'di las nga tsho rgyal mi thub pa thag gis chod ces skrag snang gis bshad/ tshes 18nyin li no srid gzhung bskyar sgrig byas te/ rang nyid kyis rgyal srung pu'u krang zhor tu khur ba dang / 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa'i skabs kyi ming du grags pa'i dmag dpon per ting (khra zo)gis srid blon gzhon pa khur zhing / we gang (ma /1)spyi rdo12 zi lin la bskos/

'jar dmag gi g.yas ru'i cu thon cun la khyon bsdoms hri 29yod pa dang / des ho lan dang per krem sogs brgyud nas thad kur h+pha ran sir bskyod de/ dbyin h+pha mnyam 'brel dmag dpung gi gtso shugs bkag skyil byas/ ho lan dang / per krem ni 6 bar sdod ’ byed rgyu khyab bsgrags byas pa'i rgyal khab yin zhing / hes thi lis kyang thengs mang por smyo rgyal khab gnyis kyi mnga' khongs la btsan 'dzul byas mi chog pa'i bar sdod kyi go gnas khas len pa dang khag theg byed rgyu mi zhes mngon gsal du bshad kyang / la 'og nas mi la 8 per krim dang / ho lan gyi bar sdod la gtor brlag byas pas gnad don ci yang mi 'byung / nga tsho rnam par rgyal rjes/ sus kyang gnad don 'di gling mi srid mi ces bshad/ nyin lnga tsam gyi nang ho lan btsan bzung byas pa dang /zla 5pa'i tshes 28nyin/ per krem gyi rgyal bo li o po te sku phreng gsum pas kyang cha rkyen med par 'jar dmag la mgo sgur ba khyab bsgrags byas/zla 5pa'i tshes 19nyin/ 'jar dmag gis ya men (sgro bla)bzung pa dang / tshes 20nyin a pu'u wer bzung / tshes 26nyin ca le (20lko)bcas snga gzhug tu btsan bzung byas te/ thad kur dbyin ji li mtsho 'gag la bsnyegs/de ltar 'jar dmag gis dbyin h+pha mnyam 'brel dmag dpung dum bu gnyis la gcod pa'i 'char gzhi 'grub song ba dang / byang phyogs kyi dbyin h+pha mnyam 'brel dmag dpung khri tsho 36de tung kher khe'i (77/lkom)mtha' 'khor gyi sa zur gsum chung chung zhig gi thog bkag dbyin tha'i dmag dpung gi mdun du mtha' yas pa'i rgya mtsho yod pa dang / rjes na stobs ldan pa'i rjes 'ded dgra dmag yod gas/ dmag dpung la nyen kha shin tu che ste/ gson lam nyag gcig ni mtsho thog nas 'bro thabs byed rgyu de yin/bltas bltas rig rig la dbyin ji'i dmag dpung khri tsho bcu phrag 'ga' rtsa med du gtong nyen pa mthong nas/ chig cer gyis stobs shuga~X snang

nyar byed ched/ dbyin dmag rtsa 'dzugs byas nas phyir 'then byed pa'i bka' phab/ dbyin dmag gis dmag gru che chung sna tshogs te mcho skor dmag gru dang / 'drud gu nywa gru dang the wu'u hri'i (656/ )gtsang po'i thog gi sprog seng gru gzings la sogs 850lhag bsdus te/ zla 5ba'i tshes 26nyin gyi dgong mo nas skyog mdel gang sar gas pa'i khrod skor skor byas nas phyir 'then byas/ nyin 8dang zhag 8ring la drag 'thab byas pa brgyud nas/ khyon bsdoms dbyin t+pa'i dpon dmag 338226'jar man gyi kha rtsa nas thar thub pa byang / tung kher khe nas phyir 'then byed thub pa byang pa des/ dbyin ji'i rigi ri pa skam dmag gi stobs shugs lhag thub pa byang /:go te khe ra /ji /// (11 //tsa sheto'ajar dmag sa tung ra bzung chis bas shugs da da ba na nas lho phyogs su dmag chen btang / we gang gis dmag dpung khri tsho 100bsdusanasasanama'ushi(7577)dang sananamabo'i(ṣ+ṭhapo1)sari pa zi pa 7pag tsho/chi / riring ༈sna ga 'ang ji lke rje 'jar dmag gis pha ri si btsan bzung byas pa/174

khul nas chu log ltar yong ba'i 'jar dmag bkag 'gog byas/ yin na'ang we kung gi 'dzing rags de nyin gsum gyi rjes nas thor zhig du gyur/ zla 6pa'i tshes 14nyin/ pha ri si srung ba'i dmag dpon gyis 'grog rgol ma byas par dgra bor mgo sgur te/ rgyal sa 'jar man la sprad/ rgyal sa nas gnas spar ba'i li no srid gzhung de tshes 16nyin rtsa thor tu song ba dang / pe tang gis srid blon khur/ khos snye rang gi ming la brten nas h+pha ran sir zhi bde'i chings yig micig len e thub bsam/ tshes 17nyin/ pe tang gis h+pha ran sir 4 dmag 'khrug mtshams 'jog pa las bya thabs gzhan med ces bshad cing /tshes 20nyin/ pe tang srid gzhung gis dngos su 'jar man srid gzhung la dmag 'khrug mtshams 'jog par gros mol byed pa'i re ba bton/ lhas thi lis h+pha ran si'i mtsho dmag dbyin ji'i lag la shor 'gro ba dang / h+pha ran si'i srid gzhung phyi rgyal gyi mnga' khongs la song nas mu mthud du 'jar 'gog 'thab 'khrug byed par skrag pas/ gros mol byed par 'thad pa byung /dmag mtshams 'jog pa'i chod yig la ming rtags 'khod sa de bsam bzhin du 1918lo'i zla 11pa'i tshes 11nyin 'jar man gyis h+pha ran si dang mna' 'brel rgyal khab la mgo sgur ba'i ming rtags 'god sa ste/ kung pi nye nags tshal khrod kyi dmag spyi chen mo rmu zhu'i (70)me 'khor gyi 'khor sgrom nang la byas/ 1940lo'i zla 6pa'i tshes 21nyin gyi nyin gung / nyes thi lis drag chas spras te/ brang khar lcags kyi rgya gram gyi dmag thob btags shing /ki lin dang / khe ther/ hi si/ lis pin the lo phu/ lis ter sogs kyis bskor 'og dzig rngam dang bcas kung pi nye la yong / kho rdo ka ma ri zhig gi 'gram du song nas bsdad cing skad cha gcig kyang mi bshad par bltas nas bsdad/ de'i thog h+pha ran si'i yi ges 661918lo'i zla 11pa'i tshes 11nyin/'jar man btsan rgyal de kho chos bran g.yog la 'god bsam pa'i rang1 /snang

mi dmangs kyis pham par btang ste/ pus mo sa la btsugs nas mgo sgur ’zhes brkos yod pa red/ nyes thi lis bltas rjes shin tu mthong chung byed pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan/ h+pha ran si'i 'thus mi der thon rjes/ lhas thi lis 'khor sgrom nas kho tshor mjal 'phral gnang / kho sa de nas gyes skabs rol mo tshogs pas 〈rte dbyi kri kun las khyad du 'phags 〉zhes pa'i 'jar man gyi rgyal glu sgra chen pos dkrol/ skabs der nyes thi li'i las don yang rtser slebs pa dang / khos 1918lo'i zla 11pa'i lha brnyas bcos la 66skyin pa len len pa'i khas len mngon du gyur bar bsam/ zla 6pa'i tshes 22nyin/ pe tang srid gzhung gis mgo sgur ba khyab bsgrags byas/ yo rob gling gi skam dmag gi stobs shugs ches che bor brtsi ba'i dmag dpung khri tsho 300yod pa'i h+pha ran si spyi mthun rgyal khab gsum pa de nyin 42tsam gyi nang la pham pa red/ de ni h+pha ran si dbang bsgyur tshogs khag gis rgyal khab btsong ba'i 'grig thabs srid jus lag bstar byas pa'i mjug 'bras red/zla 6pa'i tshes 17nyin/ pe tang gis 6 h+pha ran sis dmag mtshams 'jog pa las thabs gzhan med mices bshad rjes kyi phyi nyin/ h+pha ran si mi dmangs kyis sgra sdud 'phrul 'khor las 6 nga ni dmag spyi te ko lo yin/ nga da lta lun ton na yod/ gnas tshul ci zhig byung rung h+pha ran si'i 'gog rgol gyi me lce zhi mi srid la/ gtan nas zhi mi thub pa zhig red ces khyab bsgrags byas/ zla 6pa'i tshes 22nyin la pe tang srid gzhung gis mgo sgur ba'i ming rtags bkod pa'i nyin gnyis pa ste/ zla 6pa'i tshes 23nyin/ te ko los lun ton du yang bskyar ra dmag 'khrug ma pham pa dang / rgyal khab da dung rtsa med du ma gyur/ re ba stong zad du mi 'gro hā ran si khri lor brtan par shog ’ces 'bod skul btang / rgyal khab nyams nyes su song ba dang / mi dmangs la sdo nā si'i rdog rdzis thebs te mi rigs kyi la rgya shor yod pa'i skabs su/ te

ko lo'i 'bod skul ni mun nag 'thib pa'i sa gzhir re ltos kyi dpal 'bar 'ig sgron pa dang mtshungs/skabs der te ko lo ni h+pha ran si'i srid stegs thog gi mi gsar ba zhig yin zhing / nyin bcu'i sngon la hri krang nas kron cang dang / de nas rgyal srung pu'i tshi krang la go gnas 'phar/ kho dang pe tang gi 'brel ba ni 'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang po'i skabs su 'ded rgyu yod/ 1912lor/ kho dmag dpung gi slob grwa nas mthar phyin rjes/ pe tang gi thon nang nas hro we dmag dpon nga d+ngham 4 — — ru na/ — — du rna la ) lhaX — hā sna /4 cing r+shar+sha ༄— ri/ stu bye sdusachos —)snro ༵—— —— sa/dru— sgo 'oyi/na pro rne r+ṣa ri pa sne ga sa thu ri 6reshā ji ri dzijotshogyu lun ton nasathengasadang por rgyang sgrog we 'i srid gzhung gi 'go ba pe tang/gtam bshad spel rjesakyi te ko lo/ 177

khur/ pe tang ni 'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang po'i skabs su h+phan er tin (lonya12)dmag chen la bkod 'doms byas nas ming du grags pa dang / de dus te ko lo ni pe tang lag 'og gi dmag dpon chung chung jig yin/ 'on kyang 'jar man la 'gog rgol byed pa'i gnad don thad nas gnyis gas lta ba so sor bzung yod/ pe tang gis 'jar man la mgo sgur ba khyab bsgrags byas pa'i nyin der/ te ko lo glo bur tu lun ton la bros te/ 66rang dbang h+pha ran si mi(rjes su ming de bsgyur nas 2 'thab rtsod h+pha ran si ’ zer )zhes pa'i tshogs pa rtsa 'dzugs byas te/ 'gog rgol rgyun 'khyongs byas/ der brten pe tang srid gzhung gis te ko lo med pa'i gnas tshul 'og kho la srog khrims bcad/ gnas tshul des mi rnams kyis kho la gdung sems skye ba dang brtsi bkur thob ste/'tshang kha shig shig gis gser gyi sor gdub sogs dngos po rtsa chen byin nas 6 rang dbang h+pha ran si rilas 'gul la rgyab skyor byas/ sngon chad 6 mtshan snyan dang go gnas med pa'i te ko lo de ma thag du mi rnams kyis brtsi bkur byed sa zhig tu gyur/(bzhi) ma'o so li nyis 6 khag 'jog mibyas nas bros pa dang go skabs dang bstun nas h+pha ran sir skog rgol byas pa/nyes thi lis pho lan la btsan 'dzul byas par rkyen byas nas 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa langs shing / rang che rang mtho byed pa'i dbyi tha li'i sger sdem pa'i rnam 'gyur ci 'dra red zer na/ pho lan la btsan 'dzul ma byas gong / ma'o si li nyi 'jar man gyi 6 gtso bdag migis kho rang da dung gra sgrig byas med pa'i dmag 'khrug cig gi nang du 'drud par skrag pa red/19/༷༵'i zla 8pa'i tshes 6nyin/ khos chi ya no la gnas bab skor gleng mol

byed skabs kho'i sems khur de gsal bor mtshon yod pa red/ khos bltas na 6'jar man mi'i rjes su ded na nga chos dmag 'khrug byed dgos kyang nga tsho'i gser dang rno lcags tshang ma tshar la nye bas/ sger sdem gyi chab srid dang dmag don thad kyi gra sgrig gtan nas byed thub med mide/ gnas tshul 'di 'dra'i 'og dmag 'khrug la zhugs na 6 rgyal kha thob thub pa'i re ba brgya cha'i lnga bcu las med mices bshad/de las ldog ste nyes thi lis nus shugs gang yod kyis ma'o so li nyi 'then nas dmag 'khrug la zhugs par 'jug 'dod yod/ khos dmag 'khrug gi bkod sgrig nang la ma'o so li nyi len 'dod yod pa ni/ pho lan la btsan 'dzal ma byas pa'i sngon gyi gza' 'khor gcig la dmag dpung gsum gyi mgo bar skul slong byed skabs kyi gtam bshad nang du'ang gsal bor yod de/khos 6 thog mar ma'o so li nyi nged gnyis kyi rgyu rkyen yin te/ yod tshad nga la thug yod/ rgyu mtshan ni nga'i chab srid kyi 'jon thang la rag las 'on kyang / dus gang yin med par nyes can zhig gam smyon pa zhig gis nga gsod pa ra nges/ rgyu rkyen gnyis pa ni dbyi tha li'i gtso 'dzin yin te/ kho sanas pa la'ang thag gcod rang bzhin ldan/ gal srid kho la stabs mi legs pa zhig byang na/ dbyi tha lis mna' 'brel 'di la blo dkar byed min mi shes pa red/ sto der brten/ rab yin na da lta nyid du nga tsho'i phyogs su 'then na bzang mi zhes bshad/h+pha shi si'i sger sdem pa yod tshad la rgyal 'jog mkhan gyi bsam blo yod pa ltar ma'o so li nyi yang de bzhin yin/ khos 'jar man gyis myur tu pho lan la btsan 'dzul byed rgyu yin pa shes dus sems la som nyis khengs shing / phyogs gcig nas 6 gtso bdag mi gi rjes su hol rgyugs byas na/ dbyin h+pha gnyis la thad kur thug nas dbyi tha lir mi 'phrod pa dang / phyogs gcig nas1 lha/ra

man mi'i lag la rin gong dma' ba'i tshong rdzas shig yong srid par blo mi bde ste/ rgyu mtshan ni dbyin h+pha gnyis kyis su'u the te'i gnad don thad bzung ba'i lta tshul ltar/ pho lan yang nyes thi li'i lag la 'chor du 'jug rgyu yin srid/de las gzhan da dung sems khur cig yod pa ni/ 'jar man gyi mi la rgyab 'gal byas na/ kho'i 6 gzugs brnyan brjid po mi mog por 'gro bar zhed cing / rgyu mtshan ni 'jar dbyi gnyis kyi bar 〈sna lcags mna' 'brel 〉chings yig bzhag nas ring bo ma lon pa'i skabs su/ gal srid kho rang dmag 'khrug la skrag nas sngon la bskyod ma thub na/ snying stobs chung ba'i rang mtshang brdol ba ma yin nam/ 6 spyi khru stong tsho gnyis kyi yan la 'phags na'ang phan pa med de/ nga tsho nam mkha'i lha'i bar thag dang je nyer song rung / 'jig rten gyi mi phal ba'i bar thag dang je ring du song zhes bshad pa las skabs de'i sdu'o shā li nyi gang la bstun dgos pa mi shes pa'i gnas su gyar ba'i bsam dul ༵ sgri shā li/ nyis bsam blo btang mthar khos chi ya no la 66dmangs gtso'i rgyal khab (dbyin h+pha gnyis bstan )kyis khas len pa cung dka' na'ang / da dung khas mi len pa'i nges pa yang med/ gnas tshul de 'dra'i 'og nga tshos 'jar man la srung skyob byed mi rung / rgyu mtshan ni nga tsho rang la'ang rting ma re thob srid/ der brten/ nga tshos rngarme par du gsham gsal gyi cha rkyen la mthun pa'i thag gcod byed thabs shig 'tshol dgos/ (1)gal srid dmangs gtso'i rgyal khab kyis tshur rgol byed na/ nga tsho 6ngo so yod pa'i sgo nas 'jar man mi la kha bral ba dang / (2)gal te dmangs gtso'i rgyal khab kyis rgya yan du btang nas rgol lan mi sprod na/ nga tshos go skabs de dang bstun nas per ki le te (༅lolkolko )la rgol dgos zhes per ki le te la btsan 'ardokāḥd pa'i bsam tshul bshad/ ma'o so li nyi'i skad cha 'di las btsan

'dzul pa'i btsan por skrag cing nyams chung la brnyas pa dang / mgo bde skabs 'tshol gyi phyi dzig nang stong gi ngo bo de ji ma ji bzhin du mtshon yod/ru jus gzhi dkar po ’ lag bstar byed la nye dus/ nyes thi lis dbyi tha li'i 66gtso 'dzin mi gyis blo nyis 'dzin byas pa shes nas 'tshub cha chen po langs yang / de sngar ltar rgya yan du btang nas thabs brgya jus stong gis kho'iphyogs la 'then/ zla 8pa'i tshes 26nyin/ ma'o so li nyis nyes thi li la 'phrin yig cig bskur te/ 6 'jar man gyis pho lan la dpung 'jug byas pa'i skabs 'dir/ nga tshor stobs shugs med pa la rkyen byas nas khyed la sdigs skyo/ rdo ma byed ma thub par/ sku ngo khyed kyis bzod gsol gnang gas phyi nyipa tes zla/ 8pa'i tshes 27nyin/ hes thi lis yig lan bris te 6 sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen ni ma mtha' yang dmag 'khrug ma langs pa'i yar sngon/ dbyi tha li'i rnam 'gyur de phyi mir shes su 'jug mi rung / der brten/ ngas sems rnam dag gis khyed la zhu rgyur khyed kyis gsar 'gyur dang byed thabs gzhan pa'i thog nas nga tsho'i 'thab rtsod la rgyab rogs byed dgos/ gtso 'dzin khyed la da dung re ba zhig zhu rgyu yod pa ni dmag don thad nas rngam ston rang bzhin gyi bya thabs spyad de/ ma mtha' yang dbyin pho'i dmag dpung khag cig bkag skyil byed dgos/ de ltar byed mi thub na'ang kho tshor dogs snang chen po zhig langs su 'jug dgos shes re ba nan gyis bshad/ nyes thi li'i re ba don yod du ma song yang / khos kyang ma'o so li nyis yang bskyar bar 'dum pa byed 'dod pa'i re ba yang 'grub tu ma bcugan tshas dmag dpung gis phyogs yongs nas pho lan la btsan 'dzul byas pa'i zhin de'i snga mor/ ma'o so li nyis dbyi tha li'i per lin du sdod pa'i gzhung tshab chen mor kha par btang ste/ kho myur du nyes thi li la thugaci /sa

'jar man gyi ‘ gtso bdag gis ro mar kha par zhig brgyab nas 〈sna lcags mna' 'brel 〉la 'khur ba'i 'os 'gan dbyi tha lis mi 'khur ba bshad dgos/ de ltar ma byas na dbyi tha li la dbyin h+pha dpung chen gyis rtsol ba'i nyen kha yod mi ces bshad/dbyi tha li'i phyi 'brel pu'u krang chi ya nos don der smyo ma'o so li nyis 'jar man gyi mi dang dbyi tha li'i mi la kho ni khag bzhag nas 'bro mkhan zhig yi/ pa'i lta tshul 'dzin du mi 'jug pa'i ched du red ces dpyad gtam ba da/nyes thi li la bya thabs bral te blo mi dkar ba'i dbyi tha li'i mna' grogs de'i re 'dun mi skong ka med byung ste/ 'jar man la 6 dbyi tha li'i phyogs nas dmag don gyi rgyab rogs mi dgos shes lan btab/ nyin de'i sngon ma'i dgong mor ma'o so li nyis dbyin h+pha gnyis la tsha dbyi tha li srid gzhung gis dbyin h+pha gnyis la dmag 'khrug mi rgyag pa thag bcad zin mi zhes gsang gtam bshad/ lhas thi lis dmag 'khrug bslangs pa'i gnad 'gag gi skabs su ma'o so li nyi de ltar phyir byol byas/ khos dbyi tha lis ra dmag 'khrug mi byed mi pa'i rnam 'gyur 'dzin pa'i byed thabs lag bstar byas pa khyab bsgrags byas nas phyogs gnyis kur mthun thabs byed na 'dod/ yin na'ang nyes thi lis dbyi tha lis 6 dmag 'khrug mi byed mi pa'i rnam 'gyur de rgyun 'khyongs byed mi thub dang / mjug mthar 6 grogs po chung chung mi 'di rang dang mnyam du yong ba shes yod/dmag 'khrug langs rung gi skabs su ma'o so li nyi'i 6 dmag 'khrug mi byed pa'i mi rnam 'gyur bzung ba des/ re zhig la dbyi tha lir 2 grub 'bras g.yur tu za ba ’ thob/ rgyu mtshan ni dbyin h+pha gnyis dga' nas 'tshang kha shig shiki ༵༵ dbyi tha li'i bzo grwa dang tshong ba'i lag nas tshong rdzas mang po nyos te/

dpal 'byor thad nas 6 bslu brid mi byas/ hes thi li kho'i mna' grogs kyis skabs 'tshol byed par khong khro chen po langs na'ang / khos yo rob gling yongs rdzogs bdag du 'dzin pa'i spyi'i 'thab jus thad nas bltas na/ 2 grogs po chung ba 'di la da dung dgos mkho che bas/ mkho gal byung tshe da dung bzod bsran byed dgos pa red/ 1940lo'i zla 3pa'i tshes 8nyin/ hes thi lis ma'o so li nyi la yi ge ring po zhig bris te/ kho la 'jar man gyis myar bar yo rob gling gi nub phyogs la rgol rgyu yin pas/ dbyi tha li dmargo 'khrug la zhugs dgos zhes skul ma btang / yi ge de'i nang 66gtso 'dzin lags/ ngas bltas na thengs 'di'i dmag 'khrug gi 'bras bus dbyi tha li'i las dbang yang thag gcod byed srid pas/ khyed nam zhig gi tshe da skabs 'jar man la dmag 'khrug byed bzhin pa'i dgra bo 'di dag la 'phrad nges yin/ ngas kyang nga tsho rgyal khab gnyis dang / rgyal khab gnyis kyi mi dmangs/ nga tsho'i gsar brje dang nga tsho'i lam lugs kyi las dbang de dang mnyam du 'brel nas 'bral thabs med par shes ’ zhes bris yod pa'i yi ge mthong nas bsam blor 'gyur ldog 'byung mgo tshugs na'ang / khos da dung gnas tshul la re zhig blta snyam/ nyin bcu'i rjes nas lhas thi lis yang dbyi tha li'i mtha' mtshams kyi me 'khor 'bab tshugs nas ma'o so li nyi la thugs 'phrad byas nas mu mthud du go skon blo 'gug gi slob gso btang bas/ mjug mthar ma'o so li nyis hes thi lir rgyab skyor byed rgyu khas blangs/ rgyu mtshan ni kho da dung som nyir bsdad na/ dbyi tha li ni yo rob gling gi chab srid stegs bu'i thog nas ngo so med pa zhig tu 'gyur srid pa red/zla 6pa'i tshes 6nyin/ 'jar man gyis hri 143gyi dmag shugs bkol nas h+pha ran si'i byang phyogs kyi dbyin li 400'thab phyogs nas chu log brdol ba bzhin h+pha ran si'i dkyil khul la dpung 'jug byas shing / pha ri sistu sbyan

la khyad du yod/ dbyi tha lis go skabs de dang bstun nas rang don re e 'grub bltas/ zla 6pa'i tshes 10nyin/ chi ya nos h+pha ran si'i gzhung tshab chen mo h+pho ling so ba phang ze bos(7707 7 lko)/ kho gnyis ngo 'phrad ma thag 6 ngas khyod 'bod don khyod kyis shes yod shas mche mizhes bshad pa la/phang zes 66nga mi rnam rig can zhig min rung / ngas khyod chos ci byed pa shes yod/ khyod tshos nga tshor dpung 'jug byas pa ni rmas phog nas thang la 'gyel ba'i mi zhig la gris gtsags pa dang khyad par med mi ces bshad/ nyin der ma'o li nyis we nyi chi ya (〉krishā1modakrokhru)pho brang gi nyin stegs nas dmag brda gtong ba'i gtam bshad skabs/ mgo yar dgyes nas dzig nyams ches cher bstan yod mod/ mi tshogs kyis ma go ba ltar grags 'gul ci yang med/ chi ya nos tshul de mthong rjes 6 sems sdug pa zhig rang red mices bshad/mtho so li nyis h+pha ran sir btsan 'dzul byed par dmag dpung hri 32kyi dmag shugs bkol/ pham nas phyir 'bro ba'i h+pha ran si'i dmag dpung la ltag rgyab nas brgyab pa de ma gzhi nas dpa' bor rtsi rgyu med pa phar zhog pho ran si'i dmag dpung hri 6gis ngo ya byas pa de yang pham par byed ma thub pa red/ der ma zad skabs der pe tang srid gzhung gis 'jar man la dmag mtshams 'jog par zhus pas/ nyes thi lis ma'o so li nyi myur du h+pha ran sis mgo sgur ba'i cha rkyen gros mol byed du 'gro ru bcug pas/ ma'o so li nyis zu rting ma mi zhig blangs rjes da gzod gros mol byed bsam pa stong log tu gyur/ma'o so li nyir 6 ma rtsa mi ci yang med kyang / ham pa shin tu che ste/ h+pha ran si yongs rdzogs btsan bzung byed 'dod par ma zad/ h+pha ran si'i mtsho dmag gis kho la mgo sgur dgos par bshad/ hes thi li la yang rang nyid kyi bsam tshul zhig yod de/ h+pha ran si la btsir gnon byas drags na/ h+pha ran sizhi ༵༵ dmag dbyin ji'i phyogs la 'khor srid pa dang / mtsho thog gi stobs

shugs ni 'jar man gyi ches zhan sa yin/ der brten/ h+pha ran si'i dmag mtshams 'jog par cung zad lhod g.yeng byin te/ pe tang gis we zhis khul nas rgyal tshong srid gzhung zhig gnyer bar 'thad pa byung ba dang / lhag par du h+pha ran si'i mtsho dmag la gzab gzab byed dgos par bsam/ dmag 'khrug gi rgyal kha ni nyes thi li la thob pa yin pas/ skad cha thams cad kyang hes thi li la nyan dgos pa red/ ma'o so li nyis thengs 'di'i 6 rgyal kha thob mkhan migyi ming ni hes thi lis byin pa yin pas/ 8 gtso bdag mi gi 'dod blo ltar sgrub pa las/ rang nyid la cha rkyen gtam pa'i ma rtsa med par rtogs/h+pha ran si la bzhag pa'i chings yig gi nang dbyi tha li'i sger sdem pas rang gi 'dod blo don tshan gcig kyang snon ma thub kyang / phyi 'brel rnam pa'i thad ngo so cung zad len bsam nas/ nyes thi lis dbyi tha li kho tsho dang mnyam du h+pha ran sir chings yig bzhag ste/ 6 rgyal kha thob mkhan ’ gyi gzi brjid mnyam rol byed bsam pa khas ma blangs/ don der ma'o si li nyi shin du ma 'thad kyang bya thabs zad/1940lo'i zla 6pa'i tshes 22nyin/ nyes thi li dzig nyams dang bcas te kung pes nyer yong nas skor ba zhig brgyab pa des bltas tshod la 1918lo'i skyin pa blangs pa mtshon/ de dang mthud nas 'jar h+pha gnyis kyis 66dmag mtshams 'jog pa'i chings yig mi bzhag zla 6pa'i tshes 23nyin/ h+pha ran si'i 'thus tshab tshogs pa ro mar yong nas phyi nyin 6 pho dbyi gnyis kyi dmag mtshams 'jog pa'i chings yig bzhag ma'o so li nyis rang nyid kyis ngo tsha nyos par ma dga' bad chings yig 'jog pa'i tshogs 'dur yang ma zhugs/khos hes thi li'i mdun nas khong khro langs yang bzod bsran byas pa de mnga' 'og gi thog phud de/ h+pha shi'i dmag dpung la la rgya med ces gshe gshe btang /chos 6 nga la mkho ba ni rgyu cha yin te/ mes khe ling ci lo (sgomatsho67)sbyo snar

yang rdo ka ma ru yod na da gzod snang brnyan rko thub ste/ gal te rdo ka ma ru med tshe kho rab yin na'ang rdza bzo ba zhig las mi 'khyongs/ dus rabs 16gi nang la lcags lta bu'i mi rigs des da lta zha nye'i go yang ma chod mi ces bshad/ma'o so li nyis dbyi tha li'i h+pha shi si'i dmag dpung la 'thab rtsod nus pa med ༵ trī sdo rkyen shes mi thub ste/ kho'i ngo tsha nyo ba'i gnas tshul da dung rjes na yod (lnga) mcho seng gi jus gzhi mi dang pu'u le ten /po7kyi /dmag 'khrug1936lor le dbyin dmag don 5 med pa'i sa khul bzung ba'i rjes nas/lhas thi lis dbyin h+pha dbang bsgyur gral rim dmag 'khrug la skrag pa'i zhan cha bed spyod gang legs byas te/ phyi 'brel lag thabs spyad nas/ 'jam rtsub gnyis kyis tsa gri so'i 'gram nas nyen kha che ba'i lam phyogs lag bstar byas ’ te/ 2 rgyal —1 be+e rā kha gcig thog la nyis brtsegs blangs/’ gasto ༷ ci —blo ṭa/ngas rtsermob/sa/ 95 66drab/ thesko95 comab/ pa:re 05 sa —— —4 mtshar ba'i rgyal kha des lhas thi li la nga rgyalaskye du bcug khos 'jar dmag nichig cer thang nyin srang lam sgo rtags rgyal kha mi thob pa med pa'i dmag dpung 18༷nga 10pa'inang bzhugs pa/

zhig yin zhing / h+pha ran si pham rjes dbyin jir ma brgyab na'ang rang bzhin gyis mgo sgur bar 'dod kyang / de las ldog ste dbyin ji ni rgol dka' ba'i 'thab rdzong zhig red/ h+pha ran si'i spyi mthun rgyal khab gsum pa rtsa thor song rjes dbyin ji'i dbu bzhugs blon chen khur ba'i chig cer gyis kho go sar bud ma thag nas 'jar man la 'gog rgol byed rgyu yin pa khyab bsgrags byas shing /dbyin ji'i phugs bsam ni ra hes thi li ring lugs rtsa med gtong rgyu de yin ’zhes bshad/ khos srid 'dzin las khungs gsar 'dzugs byas pa'i nyin gsum par/ yang 2 nga tsho'i srid jus ci yin zhe na/ nga tsho'i srid jus ni gong ma lhas nga tshor gnang pa'i stobs dang nus pa yod tshad bkol nas mtsho thog dang / skam sa/ nam mkha' bcas nas 'thab 'dzing byas te/ ya nga ba'i mi'i rigs kyi nyes spyod lo rgyus thog sngar nas mthong ma myong ba'i ngan dgu tshang ba'i gdug rtsub can gyi srid thabs shig la 'thab rtsod byed dgos mishes bshad/ pham kha nyo 'dod med pa'i do zla 'di la mu mthun du dmag 'khrug brgyab nas kho'i rgyal khab rtsa med du gtong rgyu yin nam/ kha phyir 'khor nas su'u len la phar rgol byed rgyu yin pa'i thad nas nyes thi lis gdam ka zhig byed dgos 'dugah+pha ran si'i pe tang srid gzhung mgo sgur rjes/ 194)lo'i zla 7pa'i tshes 16nyin/ lhas thi lis dbyin ji la btsan 'dzul byed pa'i bka' khyab ang 16pa bsgrags shing / de'i tshab rtags la lha mtsho seng jus gzhi :zer/de'i nang ru dbyin jis dmag don thad kyi pham nges pa la mi blta bar/ da dung mgo sgur mi 'dod pa la gzhigs nas/ nga tshos dbyin ji'i skam sar 'bud pa'i dmag 'khrug slong pa thag bcad zin/ gal la thug na nga chos don de lag bstar byed rgyu yin mizhes bris yod/ nyes thi lis 6 gal la thug na mizhes gdam nga'i tshig cig bkol ba 'dis/ kho'i sems gting na zhed snazlo /ga

yod pa mtshon zhing / zla 8pa'i tshes 1nyin/ khos yang dmag 'khrug gi bka' 17pa phab pa'i nang 6 dgos nges kyi cha rkyen bskrun nas mjug mthar dbyin ji dbang du bsdu ched/ ngas dbyin ji la mu mthud du mtsho thog dang nam mkha' nas dmag 'khrug drag po byed rgyu yin ’ zhes lha skam sar 'bud pa'i dmag ces kha nas ma gling pas/ sngar dang bsdur na skad mgo je dmar song yod pa shes thub/ nyes thi li'i 6 mtsho seng gi jus gzhi mil than 'brug stong sgra che ba'i rnam pa zhig yod cing / de la rgyu mtshan gnyis yod de/ thog mar 'jar man gyis mtsho thog nas dbyin ji'i gling phran gsum la btsan 'dzul byed rgyu ni las sla bo zhig min/ dbyin ji ni gling phran gyi rgyal khab cig yin pas/ mtsho dmag gi stobs shugs shin tu che/ der chig cer la yang gdeng tshod yod de/khos 6 nga tshor zhan cha ci zhig yod kyang / mtsho thog gi don dag la nga tshor cha rgyusagating zab mo yod ces pa dang / tsa 'jar dmag gi pu'u le ten la btsan 'dzul byed pa 'gog pa'i thabs shes ches bzang po ni/ lam skabs nasakho tsho mtsho chur lhung du 'jug pa'am/ mtsho ru lhung nas ma shi pa rnams mtsho mthar bud ma thag mgo la rdung nas gsod dgos mishes bshad/ btsan 'dzul byed pa'i 'jar dmag rnams mtsho chur ma shi ba'am/ mtsho mthar bud nas gsod ma thub na/ 'jar man la nges par rgya mtsho dang mkha' dbyings kyi stobs shugs chen po zhig dgos/ stobs shugs chen po de su'i phyogs su yod pa la/ chig cer gyis lan btab pa ni 6 mtsho dmag gi stobs shugs che ba ni nga tsho yin la/ nam mkha'i bdag dbang bzung yod pa'ang nga tsho yin ’ zhes bshad pa dang / na tsha'i dmag spyi chen mo khe ther gyis kyang 6 dbyin ji'i gong ma tshang gi mkha' dmag dang stobs shugs ches che ba'i mtsho dmag ni mthong chung byed mi rung ba'i rgyu rkyen zhig red mi ces khas blangs/ lhas thi lis kyang skadi sdus thog nas kho rang la stobs shugs cung che rung / mtsho thog nas shar

bskyod byed par dka' ngal shin tu che ba shes yod de/ khos la 'og nas mi la 66skam sa'i thog nga ni dpa' bo zhig yin rung / mtsho thog nas snar ma zhig yin :zhes bshad/ der brten/ nyes thi lis 66mtsho seng jus gzhi lag bstar byed skabs yang nas yang du bsam blo btang zhing / thengs gcig min du mar phyir 'gyangs byas te gang byung du dmag rgyag ma phod pa red/ khos skam sar 'bud thub kyang / dbyin ji srid gzhung ni kha na ta'am phyi rgyal gyi mnga' khongs gzhan zhig tu gnas spor te/ dbyin ji btsan rgyal de sngar bzhin gnas rgyu red bsam/ yang gcig bshad na dbyin ji btsan rgyal pham na'ang / shul bzhag dngos zog de 'dra mang po'i rgyun 'dzin byed mkhan ni a me ri ka dang 'ja' phan nam rgyal khab gzhan pa gang rung zhig yin pa las 6 kho rang nyid dang 'jar man yin mi srid/mi nyes thi lis dbyin ji btsan rgyal da lta nyid du pham na ru 'jar man la phan pa med la/ 'jar man mi'i khrag dron la brjes pa'i dngos po rnams ni 'ja' phan dang a me ri ga'am rgyal khab gzhan pa dag kho nar dbang bar 'gyur mi zhes bshad/ stobs shugs kyis mi lcogs pa'i pa'i gnas tshul la gzhigs nas/ drag gtug byed pa las dbyin jir btsan gyis 'grig thabs byed du bcug na bzang bar sems/ lhas thi lis gnas tshul 'di 'dra'i 'og chen po dbyin ji btsan rgyal gnas pa ni rdo'adzam gling gi stobs shugs do mnyam pa'i khrod kyi rgyu rkyen zhig yin ’ par mas/de las gzhan/ nyes thi li'i btsan 'dzul rgya bskyed pa'i 'thab jus bkod sgrig ni/ gom pa dang po ni 6 shar dkrog nub deg mibyas te sngon la yo rob gling gi nub phyogs kyi skam sa chen po bdag tu 'dzin pa dang / gom pa gnyis pa ni smyo nub dkrog shar rdeg ’ byas te/ dmag dpung gi kha phyir 'khor nas su'u len 6 rtsa med du btang mi ste/ yo rob gling gi skam sa chen po yonā /da

gtsang phyags byed pa dang / gom pa gsum pa ni stobs shugs yod dgu bton nas dbyin ji btul te/ sa'i go la hril bo bdag tu 'dzin pa'i bkag rdo sel nas mjug mthar a me ri ka la 66gling chen bar gyi glo rgol mibyed rgyu de red/gong gi 'thab jus bkod sgrig la dmigs nas h+pha ran si pham par btang rjes/ hes thi li'i dmigs yul ngo ma ni dmag dpung shar phyogs su 'khor te su'u len la btsan 'dzul byed rgyu de yin zhing / 2 mtsho seng jus gzhi mini don ngo ma'i thog mi rnams la mgo rmongs thebs su 'jug thabs shig yin/ 6 mtsho seng jus gzhi'i ’ bka' phab rjes kyi gza' 'khor gnyis te/zla 7pa'i tshes 31nyin/ hes thi lis gsang ba'i dmag don gros tshogs thog 461941lo'i dpyid ga'i sngon la u ru su nges par tu tshar gcod byed pa dang /u ru su tshar gcod byas pa ji ltar mgyogs na de ltar bzang ’ zhes bshad/nyes thi lis smyo yun ring gi gnas tshul la bltas na/ 'jar man gyis yo rob gling gi nub phyogs dang dkyil khul la tshod 'dzin byed par dbyin ji'i 'jigs snang de 'dra che rgyu med la/ 'jigs snang ches che ba ni 'dzam gling gi rgyal khab stobs ldan gzhan dag ste/ u ru su dang a me ri ka dmag 'khrug nang zhugs rgyu de ’ yin par sems/ khos yang 6 pho ran si pham rjes dbyin ji la lam gnyis las med de/ gcig ni a me ri ka la rgyab brten byed pa dang/cig shos ni su'u len rgyab rten la 'tshol rgyu de yin mi zhing / sna u ru su ni dbyin ji gnas thub min gyi rgyu rkyen ches gal che ba zhig yin gal srid u ru su tshar gcod byed thub na/ dbyin ji'i mjug mtha'i re ba yang stong zad du 'gyur/ skabs der 'jar man ni yo rob gling dang par kun gyi bdag po 7yin zhes bshad/ bsam blo de ltar btang yod pas/ nyes thi lis mngon sum du 66mtsho seng jus gzhi mi lag bstar byed rgyu yin zhes cher sgrog byed pa dang cha sdu /ga dbyin ji la zhi bde'i ngang nas mgo sgur ba'i brda btang ste/

6 sku zhabs chig cer lags/ da thengs khyed nged kyi ma 'ongs sngon dpag la yid ches yod shas che/ rlabs chen gyi btsan rgyal zhig ste/ ngas sngon nas rtsa med dang gnod 'tshe gtong 'dod med pa'i btsan rgyal zhig da lta rtsa med du 'gro grabs yod/ skabs 'dir nga'i sems la chen po pu'u le ten dang rgyal khab gzhan par blos zin pa dang rgyun shes la bsam gzhigs byed pa'i 'bod skul btang pa yin/ ngas dmag 'khrug 'di nges par rgyag dgos pa'i gnas lugs gang yang mi mthong mi zhes mdzes mtshon gyi skad cha bshad/skabs der dbyin ji bas lhas thi li'i lha blos zin pa dang rgyun shes ’ zhes pa'i ngo bor ngos zin byung yod pas/ kho'i smyo bslu brid byas nas mgo sgur du 'jug pa mi khas ma blangs/ de nas nyes thi lis drag thabs kyis chig cer la 2 dran slong mi zhig byed dgos par bsam pas/ pu'u le ten dmag 'khrug gam (dbyin lun dmag 'khrug )bslangs/ pu'u le ten dmag 'khrug gi dmigs yul ni gcig nas nam mkhar chod 'dzin pa'i dbang cha brtson len byed pa dang / gcig nas dbyin ji'i dmag 'khrug gi dpal 'byor gyi nus pa rtsa med du gtong bar ma zad/ dbyin ji mi dmangs kyi h+pha shi si la 'gog rgol byed pa'i blo stobs nyams su 'jug 'dod yin/ mjug mtha'i dmigs yul ni dbyin ji la btsan gyis mgo sgur tu bcug nas stobs shugs yod tshad kyis shar phyogs la dpung 'jug byed skabs rjes na sems khur byed sa med par byed 'dod yin/'jar man gyi mkha' dmag la ched du bdag byed pa'i 6 btsan rgyal gyi dmag dpon chen mo mi gi len ni dbyi tha li'i dmag don pa kru'u lis o tu'u lha'i (lkolko/ma /tsho ste nam mkhar tshod 'dzin pa'i dbang cha'i gzhung lugs la dad mkhan zhig yin la/ khos rnam pa rgya che ba'i 'thab jus kyi gnam grus 'bar mdel dbyug pas dmag 'khrug khrod thag gcod rang 1sdusan
98)ḍa r+sha 9 5 4thu //98〉spra3smro pa stetsa dzo cherat+na rgashāshā 9 4 4 rdoX94 47 86mo dzapho

shing / thengs rer gnam gru 108lhag 'phur te nyin mtshan ltos med du 'gas gtor byas/ lun ton (77)ni 'jar man gyi gnam grus 'gas gtor thebs pa ches tshabs che ba'i grong khyer gyi gras yin/ zla 9pa'i tshes 7nyin gyi dgong mo gcig por 'gas gtor gnam gru 30)la 'thab 'dzing gnam gru 648gyis srung skyob byas 'og lun ton la lkog rgol byas te/ grong khyer yongs rjogs me klong gi nang du thim/ skabs sheg la lun ton la dgong mo rer cha snyoms gnam gru nyis brgyas lkog rgol thebs/ de las skabs de'i 'jar dmag gi gnam grus lkog rgol byas pa ci 'dra'i rgya che tshul shes/yin na'ang / dbyin ji mi dmangs ni h+pha shi sis gtor bcom rgya chen po byas pas skrag gi 'jug ma thub par ma zad/ de las ldog ste dmag 'khrug khrod nas yar langs pa red/ mang tshogs khri stong mang po rgyal dmangs nyen srung ru khag la zhugs shing / kho tshos nam yang lag la me mda' dang dbyug pa bzung ste btsan 'dzul byed du yong ba'i dgra bor dmar 'dzing byed pa'i gra sgrig byas/ mkha' zon byed pa'i dra ba de dbyin lun gling phran gsum gyi thog khyab yod de/ mi rnams kyis lag tu rgyang mthong dang glog skad bzung ste phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas bkod 'doms lte gnas la dgra bo'i gnam gru'i gnas tshul yar zhu byas te/ mkha' zon dmag dpung dang gong ma tshang gi mkha' dmag la gzhogs 'degs byas nas dmag 'khrug la rgyab skyor byas/zla 9pa'i tshes 15yi bar mkha' zon byed par zhugs pa'i na gzhon skyes pho mo khri tsho 5lhag yod/dbyin ji'i gong mya tshang gi mkha' dmag gis grangs 'bor ldab 'gyur gyis mang pa'i 'jar man gyi mkha' dmag la dpa' ngar gyis 'gog rgol byas/skabs der dbyin jis bzos pa'i rlung 'tshub rtags can dang me 'phyur rtags can gyi gnam gru rigs de gnyis kyi nus pa dang zil shugs gardo mi/ cha

nas kyang 'jar man gyi gnam gru las khyad par tu 'phags/ der ma zad skabs der dbyin jis le ta'i lag rtsal gsar ba 'di yang shes yod/ lag rtsal gsar ba 'di skabs der tshod bzo byas rung yin kyang / dbyin jis 1936lo nas bzung lho phyogs dang shar phyogs mtsho 'gram sa khul du mkha' zon byed pa'i le ta'i sa tshigs mang po btsugs/ 'jar man gyi mkha' dmag hrang cang dmag dpon zhig gis smyo le tas dbyin jis 'thab 'dzing gnam gru'i 'thab 'dzing stobs shugs ma mtha' yang ldab gcig gis je mthor btang mizhes bshad/ yin na'ang gtso bo ni dbyin ji'i dmag dmangs kyis kho tshos sgrub bzhin pa ni shi gson chags 'jig dang dbyin ji'i las dbang thag gcod pa'i dmag 'khrug cig yin pa'i go rtogs yod pas/ dpa' ngar che ba'i sgo nas thengs mang por dgra bo'i gnam gru la gtor brlag tshabs chen byas/ pu'u le ten dmag 'khrug khrod 'jar man gyi gnam gru 1733lhag brlag pa dang / dbyin ji'i gnam gru 915las gyong gud du ma song / 'jar man gyi gnam gru'i kha lo bshi pa ni de bas kyang dbyin ji las mang/ dbyin ji'i mkha' dmag gis dmag 'khrug rgyag sa ni rang gi mnga' khongs yin pas gnam gru gtor na mchongs gdugs las rang gi sa thog la 'bab thub pas/mu mthud du 'thab 'dzing la zhugs thub pa dang / 'jar man phyogs nas de dang mi mtshungs par btsan 'dzul gnam gru gtor na/ gnam gru'i kha lo ba ma shi na yang thang nas 'dzin bzung byed pas/ 'di yang 'jar dmag gi dpa' snying la gnod pa zhig tu gyur/1940lo'i zla 11pa'i tshes 14nyin gyi dgong mor 'jar man gyi gnam grus dbyin ki lan di'i dkyil khul na yod pa'i kho blun khre ( yor+sā)la (skabasader kho lin khre ni dbyin ji'i mkha' skyod bzo las kyi lte ba yin )gnam grus chu tshod bstasbya /nga la gtor bcom drag po btang zhing / grong khyer yongs rdzogs me

klong du gyur/ rtsig dngos mang po thal bar btang zhing / grong khyer gyi dkyil la gtor bcom btang ste sa mal rdo mal du btang / 'jar man gyi gnam grus sngon la rang 'bab chu 'dren bzo grwa gtor nas gnam grus 'bar mdel 'phangs pa las me 'bar tu bcug pa gsod mi thub par btang / skabs der dbyinaji'i dbu bzhugs blon chen chig cer gyis sngon la kho blun khre gtor rgyu yin pa'i gnas tshul shes na'ang / khos mi tshogs kha mi 'grem par thag bcad/rgyu mtshan ni dbyin ji'i gsang 'phrin sde khag gi lag la na tshas mtho rim pa'i gsang ba'i ang yig thob pas/ lhas thi li dang kho'i mtho rim dmag dpon dgagi bar gyi 'phrin yig mang che ba lag la yong thub pa red/ gsang ba'i ang yig gal chen 'di la srung skyob byed ched dang / zhi thi ler mtho rim gyi gsang ba'i ang yig dbyin dmag gis shes yod pa tshor du mi 'jug pa/ rjes phyogs dbyin h+pha gnyis kyi dmag 'khrug dus skabs hril bo'i khe phan la bsam blo btang nas chig cer gyis mjug mthar kho blun khre gtor tu 'jug par thag bcad/kho cin khre la lkog rgol byas rjes pu'u le ten dmag 'khrug je stod du song ba dang / 'jar man gyi mkha' dmag gi stobs shugs kyang rim bzhin shar phyogs la 'khor ba red/ nyes thi lis mkha' dmag gi stobs shugs kho nar brten nas dbyin ji'i dmag don gyi 'gog rgol gtor ba dang / de las btsan gyis mgo sgur tu 'jug pa'i ham sems 'grub ma thub pa red/ khos yang nas yang du 6 mtsho seng jus gzhi phyir 'gyangs byas pa khyab bsgrags byas shing / rjes su yang tsa dus bcad med par phyir 'gyangs byed pa ni don dngos thog jus gzhi de 'grub ma thub pa red/ pu'u le ten dmag 'khrug ni 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa'i nang dus yun ches ring shos dang / rnam pa ches che ba'i mkha' 'khrug cig yin te/ rjes su nyes thi li pham pa nas1 sdu/ga

sgril/ pu'u le ten dmag 'khrug khrod tshig cer gyi 'os 'gan gtso bo ni gnas tshul tshabs chen gyi sna brtan pa dang / dbyin ji btsan rgyal gnas thabs byed pa de yin/ der brten dbyin jis skabs 'dir lag len byed pa'i phyi 'brel gyi ming la mi rnams kyis zu gnas thabs phyi 'brel ’ zer/ chi cer gyis dbyin jilta na'i stobs shugs kyis hes thi li pham par byed mi thub pa rtogs shing /khos a me ri ka la rgyab brten nas a me ri ku'i rogs skyor brtson len byed par 'dod/ a me ri ka skabs der da dung kher rkyang ring lugs kyi bcings ba las thar med kyang / dza drag che ba'i gnas tshul las srid 'dzin ru'u si bel this (7lo )rim bzhin na tshas 'jar man ni a me ri ga'i dgra bo gtso bo yin zhing / gal te 'jar man gyis yo rob gling yongs rdzogs la tshod 'dzin byas pa yin na/ a me ri ka cis kyang dmag 'khrug gi nang zhugs dgos pa shes rtogs byung / 1940lo'i zla 6par tshig cer gyis ru'u si bel thi srid gzhung la rgyab skyor byed par zhus par/ a ris dus thos tu mtshon cha'i mdzod nas me mda' khri tsho 50dang / ci kon me mda' 800/ me phyogs 900/phyogs mdel khri tsho 100bcas myur bar dbyin ji la bskyal/ zla 9ba'i nang tshome ri gas yang mthar skyod gtong byed dmag gru rnying ba 50bkol nas nyig h+phin lan (70༅)dang / pe mu'u ta (tho lko)sogs dmag don gzhi sa 8nyos pas/ dbyin ji'i mtsho dmag gi kha tsha dgos gtug gi gnad don thag bcad/1940lo'i zla 12pa'i tshes 8nyin/ chig cer gyis ru'u si bel thi la 'phrin yig bris te/ dbyin ji'i dka' ngal gsal bor bshad cing / sgor mo byinanas a ri'i mtshon cha nyo ba'i byed thabs bsgyur dgos pa'i re ba bton/zla 11/sdu'i tshes 29nyin/ ru'u si bel this lha me thab 'gram gyi kha brda mizhes pa

spel te/ 6 gal srid chen po pu'u le ten rtsa thor tu song na/ nga tsho me gling gi mi tshang ma hes thi li'i me mda'i kha nas 'tsho ba rol dgos pas/ nga tsho nges par du dmangs gtso'i rgyal khab kyi mtshon cha'i bzo grwa che bar 'gyur dgos mi shes bshad/ 1941lo'i lo stod du rulu si bel this rgyal tshogs la 6 g.yar ba'i khrims gzhi zhes pa bton zhing / lo de'i zla 3pa'i nang rgyal tshogs kyis khrims gzhi de la chog mchan bkod/ 6 g.yar ba'i khrims gzhis sngon chad thag bcad pa'i a ri'i mtshon cha nges par du 6 sngon la nyos nas rang gis skyel 'dren byed pa'i rtsa don med par bzos pa dang / srid 'dzin la a ri'i bde 'jags la don snying gal chen yod pa'i rgyal khab la a ri'i mtshon cha dang dmag bkol dngos zog btsong ba dang / ster ba/ brje ba sogs dang / a ris mtsho grus rgyal khab gzhan par btsong ba'i dngos zog skyel 'dren byed chog pa'i dbang cha sprad/ a ris rgyal tshogs kyis de ma thag tu a sgor dung phyur 70de tsa g.yar ba'i khrims gzhi'i 9phyogs su bkol te/ h+pha shi si la ngo rgol byed pa'i rgyal khab la rgyab skyor byas/6 g.yar ba'i khrims gzhis ’ a ri'i bar sdod kyi srid jus mjug sgril ba dang / dbyin me gnyis gas h+pha shi si 'jar man la ngo rgol byed pa'i dmag 'khrug khrod mna' 'brel btsugs pa'i mtshon rtags kyang yin/ de nas cung ma 'gor bar dbyin me gnyis kyis gsang ba'i sgo nas rgyun par ming la sa86/sgomang dang po'i 6 mnyam 'brel dmag 'khrug 'char gzhi zhes pa'i chings yig bzhag 'char gzhi'i de'i nang du yo rob gling dang nub phyogs rgya mtsho chen po'i sa khul ni zag gcod rang bzhin gyi g.yul sa yin pa thag bcad/rgol rdung byed ba'i dmigs yul thog ma ni 'jar man yin pa dang / a me ri kha'i dmag dpung gi stobs shugs gco bo g.yul sa 'dir mngags rgyu yin pa sogs thag bcad/ de ni tsa sngon la yo rob gling dang rjes nas e spyami sna'i

gling ’ / 6 sngon la 'jar man dang de nas 'ja' phan ’ byed pa'i jus 'char gzhi'i thag bcad yin/ a ri dmag 'khrug nang zhugadangos thog 'thab jus kyi bkod sgrig de gzhi rtsa'i thog 426wa ang dang po ltar lag bstar byas/

sa bcad drug pa/ 'jar dbyi h+pha shi sis a h+phe ri kha dang par gan la btsan 'dzul byas pa/(gcig) ma'o so li nyis a h+phe ri kha dang ke ri se nas pham kha nyos pa/1940lo'i dbyar khar/ nyes tha lis yo rob gling gi skam sa chen po thal ba rlung gis ded pa ltar tshar gcod byas shing / 6 mtsho seng jus gzhi mi lag bstar byed pa 'ur sgrog byas par ma zad/ pu'u le rten gyi mkha' 'khrug byed skabs der bstun nas/ nyes thi li'i h+pha shi si'i mna' grogs ma'o so li nyis 'jar man dang mnyam du dbyin jir btsan 'dzul byas te/ chen po dbyin ji btsan rgyal gyi 6 nang nom bgo bar bsam kyang / dbyi tha li'i 6 gtso 'dzin gyi re ba de 'jar man gyi lhe gtso bdag ’ gis skad cha 'jam po bshad nas khas ma blangasdu'o/ so li nyi'i ham sems ni hes thi li las chung ba ma yin te/ khos hos thi li la nub phyogs nas ha las pa'i rgyal kha thob pa mthong ste ham pa langs nas 'dug mi bzod par gyur/ khos sa'i go la'i dpe dbyibs kyi thog nas ti krung ha'e rgya mtsho k+ṣa bltas te/ da ni khos 6 ti krung ha'e rgya mtsho ni dbyi tha li'i mnga' khongs nang khul gyi rgya mtsho yin pa'i tsa ro ma btsan rgyal gsar ba mi'adzugs pa'i go skabs bzang po yin par 'dod pas/ gom gang mdun spos kyis a h+phe ri kha'i shar phyogs dang byang phyogs kyi mi ser spel ༵༵ rgya

bskyed pa'i thag bcad/a h+phe ri kha byang ma'i li pe ri ya (lko1dzekrokhru)dang thi ri pho li ya nyi ya(tshilhaji797452krokhru)/ a h+phe ri kha shar phyogs dang byang phyogs kyi dbyi tha li la gtogs pa'i ig li the lis ya (22dzā〉lko12)dngaye tse o phi ya (yojuts+tsha357༅)tshang ma dbyi tha li h+pha shi si'i btsan gnon 'og tu shor/ ma'o so li nyis a h+phe ri kha'i byang phyogs su dmag dpung khri tsho 21 5btang zhing / par po (3lo )dmag dpon du bskos te e cib (ṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭha)la btsan 'dzul byed grabs byas pa dang / a h+phe ri kha byang shar gyi dbyi gtogs mi ser spel yul sa khul la dbyi dmag khri tsho 22bsdad pa dang / dmag spyir sku drag o si tha ( 46sha:)bskos shing / des dbyin gtogs so ma li (r+sā64)dang / khen ni ya (zlo༅༅)/ su'u tan (77)bcas la btsan 'dzul byed grabs byas/ a h+phe ri kha'ibyang shar dang byang phyogs gnyis kyi bar du btsir yod pa ni dbyin ji'i dkyil shar krung cang dmag spyi chen mo we wer (rdo 7)gyis bkod 'doms byed pa'i dbyin dmag yin pa dang / spyi'i dmag shugs la dmag dpung khri tsho 6lhag las med pas/ dbyin ji'i dmag dpung de dbyi tha li'i dmag dpung las ldab 'gyur gyis nyung pa red/ skabs der dbyin ji'i rgyal nang du 'jar man gyis btsan 'dzul byed pa'i don rkyen la 'phrad pas/ dmag dpung mang po dkyil shar la rgyab rogs byed du yong mi thub pa red/gnas tshul de la gzhigs nas ma'o so li nyis 'chor du 'jug mi rung pa'i go skabs shig yin par bsam ste mnga' 'og gi mi la myur bar dmag rgyag pa'i bka' bab/ yin na'ang a h+phe ri khar sdod pa'i dbyi tha li'i dmag dpon gnyis 'gul kha ma nyan pa red/ kho gnyis kyis dbyi dmag la 6 bye thang sa nges par du mgyogs shing phyogs yongs kyi gnod 'tshe thengs shig thebs rgyu red snyadi/00rgyu mtshan ni dbyi tha li'i mtshon cha ni dbyin dmag las shin du rjes

lus yin pas pham kha reg rgyu las 'os med snyam/ dbyi dmag la than khor rgol byed mtshon cha 'ga' las med spro dang / than khe'i thog na'ang me mda' sbag sbag las me skyogs med pa red/ ma'o tho can gyi 'grim 'grul 'phrul chas shin du nyung pa dang / rdo snam gsog nyar byas pa'ang cung zad las med/de'i thog la dbyi tha li'i 6 gnam gru ni dngos mang bshams ston khang gi bshamasangos su gyur yod/ mi ma'o so li nyis de dag la mi blta bar/ mnga' 'og gi mi la lha sdar ma mirgyal kha las pham kha reg mi 'dod pa khyu gcig red ces gshe gshe btang / khros da dung dmag 'khrug brgyab tshar rjes/ 6 mi nyams chung rnams gtsang dag byas te dbyi tha li'i mi rgyud je bzang du gtong dgos mishes bshad/ 1940lo'i zla 6pa'i tshes 29nyin/ par pos ma'o so li nyi'i mdun nas e cib la btsan 'dzul byed pa'i bka' dang len byas te phyir a h+phe ri kha byang ma la yong / lam bar nas kho'i gnam gru thob lu'u khi (cha'i ma)sa cha'i nam mkha' brgyud skabs/ sa khul de nas 'gog srung byed pa'i dbyi tha li'i mkha' dmag gis dbyin ji'i mkha' dmag gis btsan 'dzul byas par bsam nas me phyogs kyis gnam gru thang la 'phangs te par po bsad/ ma'o so li nyis myur bar ki la chi ya nyi (lkoṣ+ṭha74khu)mngags nas par po'i dmag spyi'i go gnas la bskos/ma'o so li nyis tsha 'ded byas 'og 1940lo'i zla 7pa'i zla mgor/dbyi tha li'i dmag dpung e tse o phi ya dang yig li the li ya nas lam la chas te/su'u tan dang / khen ni ya la btsan 'dzul byas/ su'u tan dang khen ni ya'i dmag dpung gis dpa' ngar ngang 'gog rgol byas rung / stobs shugs la che chung yod pas 'gog ma thub par nges med rgol rdung la mi bsgyur ka med byung /zla 8par dbyi dmag gis dbyin jir gtogs pa'i so ma li la dpung 'jug byas pas/ dbyin dmag gis kyang mang kha nyung gis ma lon par mtsho lhahā/ga
