yod mi ces sngar gyi kha dan gleng slong byas/ don dngos thog kho la slobatsan 'dzul pa rgya mtshor phyir 'ded pa'i 'char gzhi zhes pa zhig gtan nas med pa dang / kho'i h+pha shi si'i slob phrug rnams kyis kyang ‘ gtso 'dzin gyi don du 'chi thub pa'i chod sems snga mo nas rgyab la g.yug ste/ rang nyid thar thabs byed pa las ci yang mi bsam pa red/ nyes thi lis dbyi tha li'i dmag dpung thor la nye ba shes nas myur bar ma'o so li nyi bos nas kha gtad 'jal thabs la gros bsdur byas/zla 7pa'i tshes 19nyin/ h+pha shi si'i sger sdem pa de gnyis kyis dbyi tha li'ibyang phyogs h+pher the (r+sālo7)zhes pa'i nye 'gram gyi zhing grong zhig nas gros bsdur byas/ skabs der lo tsā byed mkhan hri mes thes 6 nyes thi lis dbyi tha li'i dmag dpon mang po zhig gi sngon nas ma'o so li nyi la gshe gshe tsha nan zhig btang na'ang / khos mgo sgur nas nyan 'dug pa las ji yang smra ma thub ces bshad/ mtho so li nyis kyang dbyi tha li pham pa las 'os med pa shes shing /thengs 'di'i tshogs 'du yang nyes thi li la gnas tshul de shes su 'jug pa'i go skabs rjes ma yin srid bsam kyang / lhas thi li'i mdun nas gnas tshul dngos bshad ma phod pa red/ma'o so li nyi dang nyes thi li gnyis kyis gros bsdur byed skabs tag tag la mna' 'brel dmag dpung gi mkha' dmag gis nyin dkar la grong khyer ro mar gtor bcom rgya chen po byas pa'i gnas tshul thos/ thengs de'i gros mol la mjug 'bras ci yang ma byung bar ma'o so li nyis sems khong du chud nas phyir ro mar yong / kho phyir slebs dus rgyal sa'i chab srid kyi gnas tshul rgyun ldan min par 'dug kho'i chung ma lā khe lis (77༅)mi skor zhig gis lha gtso 'dzin rimago rting slog pa'i lkog g.yo sgrub bzhin yod cing / de'i nang gi khong mi gtso bo dag ni ki lan tis (ṣ+ṭha༅7)dang / po tha ye ( rdo:)/

pa to ki lis o (༅lkotshe mcho)sogs yin pa kho la bshad/ lā khe lis da du kho tshos smyo gtso 'dzin ’ khrid nas mna' 'brel rgyal khab kyi phyogs su 'khor ba dang / gal srid ma'o so li nyis 6 'gog rgol lam bros byol byas na/ gsod rgyu yin mi pa'i gnas tshul bshad/lā khe li'i bshad pa'i gsang 'phrin der khungs med pa min te/ ki lagatis sogs h+pha shi si'i rkang 'dzin rgan pa skor zhig gis ngo ma skog g.yo zhig sgrub bzhin yod pa red/ kho tshos h+pha shi si chen po'i u yon lhan khang gi grosatshogs shig 'tshogs te nyams nyen las thar ba'i bya thabs 'tshol ba'i re ba bton/ 1939lo nas bzung gros tshogs 'di 'tshogs ma myong pa red/ ma'o so li nyis kho rang la blo dkar ba'i smyo mdza' gcugs 'thab grogs de dag blo log pa bsam pa'i rgyu dag la'ang shar med/ skabs der kho'i lus sems thams cad rgud yod pas kho tshos bshad pa ltar h+pha shi si'i u yon lhan khang gi gros tshogs bsdu bar 'thad pa ma byung ka med byung / khos ra 'thab grogs 7/dris kyi 'dri tshig la lan 'debs par gra sgrig byed ched yig cha mang po btsal ga : /ba ṭ+wā bas/ 24nyin ma'o so li nyi snga mo nas mal las langs shing /kho'i chung ma nam gang bor gnyid ma khug pa red/ mal las langs ma thag khyo bo la 6 de ring dgong mo'i gros tshogs de ngo ma 'tshogs dgos sam zhes dris pan/ mtho so li nyis 6 ci phyir dgos pa med dam/ blo mthun bar nas bsam tshul brje res sheg byed pa'i don yin pas/ ngas bltas na gros tshogs 'tshogs mi rung ba'i rgyu rkyen zhig mi mthong zhes mo la lan btab/ phyi dro'i chu tshod 4dang skar ma 40thog ma'o so li nyis kho'i yig khug chen po de khyer nas myur bar tshogs 'dur song /30rdogs 'du de we nyi chi ya pho brang ( ༅7༅lha)gi ne tso tshoms chen

nas 'tshogs pa red/ ma'o so li nyi'i tshogs mgo brtsams pa'i gtam bshad la mgo mjug med cing / nus med stobs zhan du gyur yod pas/ mi la las khos go gnas las 'bab pa'i gtam bshad pa min nam bsams/ kho'i sngun na bsdad yod pa'i sngon chad kyi 66mdza' gcugs 'thab grogs dang / blo dkar ba'i g.yog po de dag las mang che bas kho la 'dri tshig 'dri bsam yod mod/ don gal la thug tshe sus kyang ci yang bshad ma phod par re zhig la kha khu sim por bsdad/ de nas bgres shing 'khogs pa'i dmag spyi chen mo te po nos sngon la kha grags te/ khos thog mar dbyi tha li'i dmag dpung la dag sel cig byas/ de nas mi 'ga' yar langs nas 6 kho tsho gtso 'dzin la blo dkar ba dang / h+pha shi si'i ring lugs la blo dkar bar ma zad/ dmag 'khrug gi rgyal kha brtson len byed thub na kho tshos mu mthud nas dmag 'khrug byed pa'i bsam tshul bstan/mi yin na'ang rjes nas mi 'ga' zhig gis gtam bshad pa ni mngon gsal du sngon ma'i ldog phyogs su song yod pa red/ dper na/ h+pha shi si'i tang gi sngon gyi hru'u ci h+pha li na chis (ṣ+ṭha༅ar+sha)ma'o so li nyi la 6 h+pha shi si'i sngon gyi gzi brjid kyi bsam blor 'khyog bshad dang jog rdzis btang song mizhes skyon 'dzugs byas pa dang / slob gso'i blon chen po tha yes ( stsa7)de dang mthud nas tsa ma'o so li nyis rang nyid h+pha shi si'i mgo khrid gzhan pa tsho'ikhrod nas kher rkyang du bud pas/ dmag 'khrug pham song ba red ces bshad ma thag tshang mas de lta bu'i skyon 'dzugs kyi skad cha gcig rjes gnyis mthud du bshad/ h+pha shi si'i mgo gte rgan pa ki lin nyis bshad don/ 2 sger sdom byed thabs pham song ba red/ ma'o so li nyi mang tshogs kyi bsam 'char dang bar thag je ring du song bar ma zad/ dbyi tha li nyams nyen 'byung ba'i lam la khrid khrid tshul sogs bshad/ de'i rjes nas rgyal bo we khi to ye man nyer gyi h+pha shi si ring lugs kyis 'phrog pa'i pa'i dbang cha sko/ /ga

slar gso byed 'os mi shes bshad/ rjes su khos brtse dung yod pa'i sgo nas lha gtso 'dzin lags/ nga tsho tshang ma skyid sdug mnyam myong gi grogs po red/khyod kyis blo sems dkar ba'i grogs po tsho'i sems gtam la nyon dang / nga tshor khyod dang mnyam du 'gan khur tshang ma 'khur ba'i go skabs shig gnong dang / nga tsho 'chi na mnyam 'chi dang gson na mnyam gson byed chog mices bshad/ de bas kyang ma'o so li nyi sems pham pa zhig ni kho'i bu mo'i mag pa ste phyi 'brel blon chen chi ya no yang kho mgo rting slog pa'i lkog g.yo sgrub mkhan gyi nang du tshud yod pa red/ chi ya nos 6 las ma legs pa ni 1940lor nga tsho h+pha ran ser btsan 'dzul byed par zhugs rjes/ lhas thi li'i mnga' 'og la shor so~X / 'di ni 'chi bdag gi lag la lhung ba dang khyad par med mices skyon 'duga~X zlo ༵ /li nyis kho la skyon 'dzugs byed par nyan nas mi 'dug ka med byung / tshogs 'du phyi nyin snga mo'i chu tshod gnyis bar gyi chu tshod dgu la 'tshogs pa red/ rjes nas ma'o so li nyi gnyid las sad pa ltar 6 tshogs 'du 'tshogs yun shin du ring song / tshang ma yang thang chad yod/ tshogs 'du'i thog gros chod gsum bton pa red/ sngon la ki lan ti'i jus gzhi la tshang mas bsam 'char thon zhes bshad/ ki lan ti'i jus gzhi zhes pa ni ma'o so li nyis dmag dpung gsum la mgo khrid byed pa'i dbang cha rgyal bor sprod dgos shes pa de yin/ ma'o so li nyi'i sems la kho rang gi 66gtso 'dzin ’ gyi gzi rngam gcig pus kyang dbang cha 'phrog pa'i gros gzhir gros 'cham 'byung mi thub snyam kyang / kho'i bsam yul las 'das pa ni tshang ma'i 'dems shog gi mjug 'bras ni mi bcu dgu de la 'thad pa dang / mi brgyad mi 'thad pa/mi gcig gis 'dems shog ma 'phangs pa red/ skabs der ma'o so li nyi'i gardordo lhanag por gyur zhing har gyis yar langs nas 6 khyod tshos nyams nyen

bzos song / khyod tshos h+pha shi si'i ring lugs rtsa med bzos/ da tshogs 'du grol ’ zhes gzhung yig khug mar bdag byed zhor du de ltar bshad/ h+pha shi si'i tang gi mjug mtha'i hru'u ci si kho gras (molko/6)lobs phyogs ltar/ tsa gtso 'dzin la gus 'dud zhus ’ shes bsgrags pa dang / ma'o so li nyis nyams med pa'i ngang lag pa g.yas pa g.yug tsam byas nas gus lan zhus/ skabs der tshoms chen de dur sa zhig dang 'dra bar grags 'gul cung zad kyang med par gyur/ ma'o so li nyi thang chad yid mug gis yul la thon zhing / bred bred por gyur/ skabs der tshes nyer lnga'i snga mor slebs yod pa red/ chung mas myur bar lag sngon la 'gul nas ki lan tis sogs 'dzin bzung byed dgos par bshad/ ma'o so li nyis h+pha shi si'i u yon lhan khang gi gros tshogs la khrims kyi nus pa med pas de la brel mi dgos pa dang / sang nyin de tsho 'dzin bzung byed chog ces bshad/ khos rgyal bo'i pho brang la kha par zhig brgyab nas/myur du rgyal bor mjal 'phrad byed pa'i re ba bton kyang / rgyal bos snga mo nas bkod sgrig byas yod pa kho'i blo yul la'ang ma shar/zla 7pa'i tshes 25nyin gyi phyi dror/ ye man nyig ler rgyal bos rgyal tshang gi skyel tshal sa rmu dbyi (96 ṣ+ṭha)nas ma'o so li nyi la thug 'phrad gnang / kho der bsdad ma thag rgyal bos 6 mdza' brtse ldan pa'i gtso 'dzin lags/ dbyi tha li nyams nyen la 'phrad pas da 'di ltar song na 'grig rgyu ma red/ dmag dpung rbad de pham song pa dang / dmag mis kyang khyod kyi don la dmag 'khrugakhyed mi 'dod/ khyod ni da lta dbyi tha li na mi rnams ches sdang ba'i mi zhig yin/ gtso 'dzin lags/ da lta khyod la grogs po gcig kyang lus med/ mi gcig da dung khyod kyi grogs po yin pa de ni nga red/ der brten khyod kyis rang gi bde 'jags la sems khur byed byed dgos/30)sa

dmags pa to ki lis o (khaza tsho )gdan drangs nas srid gzhung gi gtso bdag la bskos zin/ khos rang gi srid 'dzin las khung rtsa 'dzugs byas nas rgyal khab skyong pa dang dmag 'khrug byed ces bka' bab ma thag ma'o so li nyis 6 rgyal bo lags/ khyod kyis thag gcod tshabs chen zhig byas song /de'i mjug 'bras la chig cer dang si ta lin la rgyal kha byin pa'i chag sgo de bzos song zhes bshad/kho gnyis skar ma 2khril ma gtogs kha brda ma byas pa dang / rgyal bos kho la mu mthud du bshad 'dod med pas/ yar langs nas 'grul ba phyir skyel ba'i brda bstan/ rgyal bo phyir song rjes ma'o so li nyi rang gi rlangs 'khor gyi gam du thon pa na/ de ru lag la me mda' bzung ba'i krung we zhig yod pa des kho la kho ni rgyal bo'i bka' ltar sku srung byed du yong ba yin zer/ ma'o so li nyis che nga la rang gi srung dmag yod pas srung dmag gzhan pa mi dgos mi shes lan btab pa na/ krung we des kho la bshad dbang ma byin par nyen srung rlangs 'khor zhig tu btsan gyis bcug nas/ dmag mi bcu lhag gis bskor te mi shes sa zhig tu song / ma'o so li nyi sngon la ti krung ha'e rgya mtsho'i phin tsha (zos)zhes pa'i gling phran zhig gi thog tu bkag nas btson 'dzin byas nas bsdad kyang / 'jar man gyi mis 'phrog 'gro bar zhed nas/ cang ma 'gor bar mi med sa stong yin pa'i ma ta le na gling phran (za 7776)du btson 'jug ༵ lha /ki li yos srid 'dzin las khungs btsugs rjes/ h+pha shi si'i tang gtor ba khyab bsgrags byas/ zla 9ba'i zla mgor/ mna' 'brel dmag dpung mo zhi na mcho 'gag brgal nas/ dbyi tha li'i rgyal nang du bskyod/ pa to ki lis o'i 'thus mi dang mna' 'brel dmag dpung gis gsang ba'i sgo nadī nāmag 'khrug mtshams 'jog pa'i cha rkyen la mos mthun byung / zla 9pa'i

tshes 6nyin/ e sin ho ber gyis rgyang bsgrags las dmag mtshams 'jog pa'i bsgrags gtam khyab bsgrags byas pa dang / pa to ki lis os kyang dmag mtshams 'jog pa khyab bsgrags byas/ zla 10ba'i tshes 13nyin/ pa to ki los o srid gzhung gis 'jar man la dmag brda brgyab/ a me ri ka dang /dbyin ji/ su'u len bcas rgyal khab gsum gyis mnyam gcig tu dbyi tha li dmag 'khrug byed rogs yin pa khyab bsgrags byas/ma'o so li nyi'i h+pha shi si'i srid gzhung nyams nyes su gyur pa dang / dbyi tha lis 'jar man la dmag brda brgyab pa des h+pha shi si'i 'khor lte'i rgyal khab thor zhig tu 'gro ba yongs su mtshon/(bzhi) a me ri ga'i dmag dpung gis zhi bde rgya mcho sa khul nas rang 'gul gyi dbang cha blangs/1942lo'i lo smad nas bzung / a me ri ku'i dmag dpung gis zhi bde rgya mtsho'i g.yul sa'i thog rang 'gul gyi dbang cha blangs/ de'i mtshon tshul ni g.yul 'gyel gsum ste/ byur mtsho'i dmag 'khrug dang / krung thu'u (lta )gling phran gyi dmag 'khrug kwa tar kha nar (lo77677)gling phran gyi g.yul 'gyel bcas yin la/ de'i nang gi kyang krung thu'u gling phran gyi mtsho 'khrug ni de bas kyang gal che/'ja' dmag gis mu tig gru khar lkog rgol byas pa dang e sha ya'i lho phyogs kyi rgyab khab khag btsan bzung byas pa 'grub rjes/ ham sems je cher song ba dang / 'ja' phan mtsho dmag gis a ri'i phyir rgol 'gog pa dang /gomagang mdun spos kyis a ri pham par byed dgos na/ nges par shā 0rdo ri

dang o si khru li ya gnyis bar gyi skyel 'dren lam thig gcod dgos/ de ltar kho tshos sa mo ya (ṭhaṣ+ṭha༅)dang / khi lis to nyi ya gsar ba (sgoṣ+ṭha༅77༅)dang ci ne ya gsar ba'i (sgo skesgro)shar lho'i sa khul gyi mor tshi pis gru kha (r+sā1cho 76khutsho)len pa/ de dang mnyam du krung thu'u gling phran 'phrog nas/yang bskyar mu tig gru kha gtor ba'i rmi lam rmis te/ rgyag thengs gcig gis a ri'i mtsho dmag rtsa gtor gtong ba'i stong bsam bcangs/ de'i thad dmag dpon a tha mes ro ya ma mo do'i rnam 'gyur lhag tu rbad chod yin/a ri'i zhi bde rgya mtsho'i 'thab jus bsam blo ni/ thog mar a lig hrin gling tshom (amadzes6)nas krung thu'u to dang / sa mo ya gling tshom(ṭhaṣ+ṭha༅9lo)/ de nas khi lis to nyi ya gsar ba dang / ci ne ya gsar ba'i bar gyi sa khul de dag srung pa dang / de rjes hur brtson gyis gra sgrig byas te/ o si khru li ya tshugs mal byas nas phar rgol byed pa'i sta gon byas/ mna' 'brel dmag dpung la mtshon na/ mor tshi pis gru kha srung rgyu ni don gal chen zhig tu lhag yod/ zhi bde rgya mtsho'i 'thab jus 'char gzhi lag bstar byed ched/ a ris zhi bde rgya mtsho lho nub sa khul gyi mna' 'brel dmag dpung gi dmag spyi khang so sor btsugs te hrang cang dmag dpon me khi a sug gis dmag spyi khur ba dang / 'i bde rgya mtsho'i sa khul (de'i nang du zhi bde rgya mtsho lho nub tshud med )gyi mna' 'brel dmag dpung gi dmag spyi ni zhi bde rgya mtsho'i dmag gru ru khag gi dmag spyi nyis mes tshus khur/ dmag spyi khang gnyis kyi bya 'gul la a ri'i dmag don blo 'don tshogs 'dus mgo khrid byed/ de'i dmigs yul ni // ༵ sdo gār+sha dmag dpung gi zhi bde rgya mtsho spyi'i dmag don nus par shugs skabs 'di nas bzung 'ja' me gnyis bar gyi 'thab jus bkod sgrig la ༵༵༵ na/ phyogs gnyis mdung rtse kha sprod du gnas yod/ der brtem

byur mtsho'i dmag 'khrug dang / krung thu'u gling phran gyi dmag 'khrug de min gyi dmag 'khrug rab dang rim pa rnams gcig rjes gnyis mthud du byung /byur mtsho ni o si khru li ya dang ci ne+e ya gsar ba'i shar phyogs dang / so lo mon gling tshom gyi lho phyogs/ khi lis to nyi ya gsar ba'i byang phyogs na yod/so lo mon gling tshom gyi thu'u la ce gru kha (༅ṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭha)dang / ci ne ya gsar ba'i le khrin(mchogro )/ mor tshi pis gru kha bcas blangs nas/ a ri dang o si khru li ya'i bar gyi 'grim 'grul gcod rgyu ni/ 'ja' dmag gi gom pa dang po'i 'char ga'i yin pa dang / 1942lo'i zla 4ba'i nang / cin hrang khrin mes (lko 1 lor+sā)mgo khrid byed pa'i 'ja' dmag gi dmag gru ru khag bzhi ba la gnam gru 'bab sa'i dmag gru gsum ( ros hi rtags can dang / 6 zhang hi rtags can ’6 'ang h+phin rtags can gsum )gyis dmag rogs byas pas/ stobs shugs je cher song / zla 5ba'i tshes 3nyin/ 'ja' dmag gis las sla mo'i sgo nas thus la ce gru kha btsan bzung byas te/ byur mtsho'i dmag 'khrug gi mgo brtsams/a ri'i byur mtsho na yod pa'i dmag dpung ni spro le khres (lkolkom)bkod 'doms byas pa'i sna 'dzoms dmag gru ru khag cig red/ de la 6 yo khi tun ’ rtags can dang / 66le khi zhin tun rtags can gyi gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings gnyis dang / gnam gru 141yod/ 'ja' dmag gis thu'u la ce btsan bzung byas rjes kyi zla 5ba'i tshes 4nyin/ a ri'i mkha' dmag gis thu'u la ce'i mtsho khul nas 'ja' dmag gi dmag gru chung ba 4mtsho la bsnub/zla 5ba'i tshes 4nyin/ 'ja' phan gyi dmag skyel dmag gru zhig lā por (77nya ri)nas lam la chas te/ mor tshi pis gru khar rgol du bskyod/ bya 'gul de srung skyob byed ched/ cin hreng khrin mes kyi dmag gru ru khag bzhi bas byur mtsho'i mtsho ngos su a ri'i dmag gru 'tshol zhib byas/ a ri'i sna 'dzoms dmag gru ru khag gis mor tshi pes gru khar bgrod pa'i 'ja' sdu/ gyi

dmag gru 'tshol zhib dang sngon 'gog byas/zla 5ba'i tshes 7nyin/ 'ja' me gnyis kyi mkha' bskyod dmag dpung gis ci ne ya gsar ba'i shar phyogs kyi mkha' lam nas mkha' 'khrug thengs gcig byas/ a ri'i gnam grus 'ja' phan gyi gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings 66zhang h+phin rtags can mtsho nang du bsnub/ zla 5ba'i tshes brgyad kyi skya rengs skabs su/ 'ja' me gnyis kyi mtsho dmag byur mtsho nas gdong thug ste mtsho 'khrug thengs gcig byas/ a ri'i mkha' dmag gis 'ja' phan gyi dmag gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings 66zhang hi ’ rtags can la gtor skyon tshabs chen btang ste/ dmag 'khrug gi nus pa med par btang / yin na'ang a ri'i 6 le khi zhin mi rtags can gyi dmag gru mtsho la bsnub pa dang / 6 yo khi rtags can la chag skyon byung du bcugabyur mtsho'i dmag 'khrug khrod 'ja' phan gyi gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings gcig dang gnam gru 105gtor ba dang / dmag mi 1000lhag bsad cing / a ri'i gnam gru 'bab sa'i dmag gru gcig dang gnam gru 81gtor ba dang / dmag mi 500lhag shi rmas su btang ste/ phar tshur gnyis kyi gyong gud phal cher 'dra mnyam yin rung / 'thab jus thad nas bltas na/thengs 'di'i mtsho 'khrug ni 'ja' phan gyis zhi bde rgya mtsho'i dmag 'khrug bslangs pa nas bzung ba'i pham kha thengs dang po yin pa dang / mor tshi pesagrusar btsan 'dzul byed pa'i 'char gzhi dus bcad med par je ring du mi gtong ka med byung / de dang bstun nas 'ja' phan gyi gnam gru 'bab sa'i dmag gru che ba 66zhang hi mirtags can la gtor skyon thebs pa de'i thog la gnam gru snon dgos pas/ cang ma 'gor bar langs ba'i krung thu'u gling phran gyi mtsho 'khrug la zhugs ma thub pa las/ 'ja' dmag gi stobs shugs je zhan du 'gro ba shes thub/308

byur mtsho'i mtsho 'khrug gi rjes nas zla gcig ma 'gor bar/ 'ja' me'i mtsho dmag bar yang krung thu'u gling phran gyi dmag 'khrug langs/krung thu'u to gling phran ni ha wa dbyi'i nub byang gi phyogs su yod de/ de gnyis kyi bar thag la mtsho le 1130ma gtogs med/ ya ma mo dos bltas na krung thu'u to gling phran 'dzin thub na a ri'i dmag dpung gis ma zor gling tshom (67796)dang / la por( thupo)/ we khi gling phran/(tsho lo) de min lho phyogs bya gling sogs dang 'ja' phan rgyal nang la 'jab rgol byed pa 'gog thub la/ de dang mnyam du a ri'i zhi bde rgya mtsho'i dmag spu ru khag tshur drangs pa dang bstun nas dmag stobs chen por brten nas de rtsa med du gtong thub par 'dod/ der brten ya ma mo dos sems zhib mos 'char gzhi bkod/ khos gru gzings sna tshogs 350lhag dang / gnam gru 1000gra sgrig byas shing / phar rgol byed pa'i dus tshod ni 1942lo'i zla 6pa'i 5nyin la gtan phab byas/ dmag gru ru chen de ya ma mo dos 'thab jus ru khag drug du bgos shing / de'i nang ya ma mo do rang nyid kyis dngos su bkod 'doms byed pa'i gtso shugs dmag gru ru khag la 'thab rtsal dmag gru chen po 3dang /yang ba'i gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings 1bcas yod pa de a ri'i dmag gru ru khag gi gdong la 'bud grabs byas/ nan yon krung dbyis khrid pa'i gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings ru khag dang po la smyo khri khrin ’ rtags can dang / 6 ca hi rtags can/ 6 h+phel lung mirtags can/ tsa tshang lung rtags can bcas gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings che ba 4yod pa dang / de dag gi thog na gnamagru 261yod pa des phar rgol gyi gtso shugs byed cing / btsan 'dzul byed mkhan dmag gru ru khag gzhan gcig gis dpon dmag 5800bskyal yod pa des krung thu'u to gling phran nas skam sar 'bud pa'i gra sgrig byas yod/ da dung ru khag gsum yod pa'i gcig gis nyen zon byed pa dang / gci/0 nis

a lig hrin gling tshom la phar rgol byas te a ri'i dmag dpung la mgo skor gtong ba/ gcig ni mtsho 'gram ga'i sa'i mkha' dmag yin pa dang / des mtsho kāmag la gzhog 'degs byas nas dmag 'khrug byed pa'i gra sgrig bcas byas /ba/ sa der a ri'i 'i bde rgya mtsho'i dmag gru ru khag gis mnyam du bsdu thub pa ni 66chi ye ’ rtags can dang / 66ta hong h+phin mirtags can/ 6 yo khi mi rtags can bcas gnam gru 'bab sa'i dmag gru 3dang / mtsho skor dmag gru 8/ 'ded bcom dmag gru 15bcas yod/ rdzog rngam che ba'i 'ja' phan gyi dmag gru ru khag la bsdur na a ri'i mtsho dmag gi stobs shugs 'an kyang /a ris 'ja' phan mtsho dmag gi gsang ba'i glog 'phrin ang yig sngon la shes pas/ ya ma mo do'i 'thab jus dang / dmag gru khag gi stobs shugs mi sna bkong sgrig sogs lag mthil gyi ri mo bzhin du gsal/ 'ja' phan gyi dmag gru ru khag gis krung thu'u to gling phran la 'jab rgol byed skabs/ a ri'i dmag gru ru khag gis h+pho le khre'i bkod 'doms 'og sngon la krung thu'u gling phran byang shar gyi mtsho ngos su bskung nas bsdad yod kyang / ya ma mo dos a ri'i mtsho dmag sa thag ring ba'i so lo mon gling tshom na yod pa'i tshod dpag nor 'khrul can byas/1942lo'i zla 6pa'i tshes 4nyin gyi zhogs par/ nan yon gyis mgo khrid byed pa'i gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru 4yi thog nas 'phur ba'i gnam gru 108kung thu'u to gling phran la gtor bcom byed du 'phur te/ gling phran thog na yod pa'i a ri'i dmag dpung gi gnam gru dang dmag don sgrig chas gzhan rnams gtor bcom byed pa'i stong bsam bcangs/ a ri'i dmag dpung gis sngon nas 'ja' dmag gis 'jab rgol byed rgyu yin pa shes yod pas/ gling phran thoX /snyo gnam gru 100yod pa gnam la 'phur nas 'ja' phan gyi gnam gru

mkha' nas bkag pas/ 'ja' phan gyi gnam grus dmigs 'ben gtor ma thub par thengs gnyis par gtor bcom byed du 'gro dgos pa byung / gnam gru skor dang po phyir gru gzings thog babs ma thag nan yon gyis thengs gnyis par gtor bcom byed par sgug yod pa'i gnam gru'i thog gi yes lis 'bar mdel tshang ma phyir blangs nas kra tan la brje dgos pa'i bka' bab ste/ krung thu'u gling phran la thengs gnyis par gtor bcom byed du 'gro grabs byas/cang ma 'gor bar 'ja' dmag gi myul zhib gnam grus 'ja' phan dmag gru ru lag gi byang shar phyogs kyi dbyin le nyis brgya'i mtshams na a ri'i dmag gru ru khag yod tshul yar zhu byas rjes/ nan yon hon 'thor nas slar yang myur tu kra tan phyir blangs nas yes le 'bar mdel phyir 'dogs pa'i bka' bab ste/ a ri'i dmag gru ru khag gi gdong la 'bud grabs byas/ 'ja' phan gyi dmag gru'i thog 'bar mdel len pa dang phyir 'dogs pa'i brel zing langs te 'tshub 'tshub lang lang du gyur/ gnam gru'i thog nas blangs pa'i 'bar mdel phyir mdzod khang du 'jog khom ma byung par gru thog tu spungs nas bzhagaskabs der (snga dro'i chu tshod 10tsam gyi thog )a ri'i gnam gru skor gnyis thon nas 'ja' dmag gi dmag gru la 'jab rgol byas par/ 'ja' dmag gi gnam gru 50gnam la 'phur nas gdong bkag ste a ri'i gnam gru 30sar 'phang ba dang / de'i lhag ma rnams phyir bros pa red/ 'ja' dmag gi gnam gru phyir log nas snum snon pa dang / mtsho dmag rnams kyis rgyal khar dga' 'bod byed pa'i sgang la smyo chi ye rtags can gyi gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings thog nas 'phur ba'i gtor bcom gnam gnam gru 37de glo bur tu thon nas che khri khrin mi rtags can dang / 6 ca ho rtags can gnyis kyi thog la 'bar mdel g.yugs par slebs shing / 'bar mdel ldir ldir tu gru gzings gnyis kyi thog nas gad/ de dang mnyam du tsa yo khi ’ rtags sdu/ gyi

gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings thog nas 'phur ba'i gnam gru 17de thad kur 66tshang lung rtags can gyi gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings thog la 'phur nas 'bar mdel 'phangs/ nan yon gyis ci yin 'di yin ma shes pa'i bar der 'ja' phan gyi gnam gru 'bab sa'i dmag gru gsum la snga gzhug tu gtor skyon thebs pa dang / gru thog na spungs yod pa'i 'bar mdel gad de myur bar me klong zhig tu gyur pa red/ cang ma 'gor gnam gru 'bab sa'i dmag gru gsum po mtsho zhabs la nub pa red/nan yon gyi gnam gru 'bab sa'i dmag gru bzhi bo'i nang 6 gles lung rtags can gcig po ma gtogs ma lhag pa red/ skabs der kho ni rgyan shor ba'i sho rgyag mkhan zhig dang 'dra bar/ sems thag rbad chod kyis dgra skyin len par bsam/ nyin de'i nyin gung 6 gles lung rtags can gyi thog nas 'phur ba'i 'ja' phan gyi gnam grus thengs gnyis la a ri'i 66yo khi rtags can la 'jab rgol byas/ gtor bcom thengs gnyis la thebs pa des smyo yo khi ’ rtags can la gtor skyon tshabs chen thebs nas phyi nyin mtsho la nub pa red/ 'on kyang a ri'i mkha' dmag gis myur bar 'ja' phan gyi 66ཿsa lung rtags can yang mtsho la bsnub nas dgra sha blangs pas/ nan yon gyi gnam gru 'bab sa'i dmag gru yod tshad rtsa med du btang pa red/ya ma mo dos 'ja' dmag pham pa'i gnas tshul de thos rjes ha las shing hon 'thor nas ci yang smra rgyu med par ri mo'i gzugs bzhin gyur/ pham pa kho thag yin pa shes pas krung thu'u to gling phran la dpung 'jug byed mtshams bzhag yin na'ang khos 'ja' phan gyi dmag sems brtan ched 6 dgra bo'i dmag gru ru khag ha lam rtsa gtor btang zin pas lhag lus rnams shar phyogs la 'bro ba'i sgang red mi ces rdzun gtam bshad/31snang thu'u gling phran gyi g.yul 'gyel ni a ri'i dmag dpung nyung ba mang

ba las rgyal de/ 'ja' dmag gi gnam gru 'bab sa'i dmag gru chenapo 4dang /mtsho skor dmag gru 1/ gnam gru 400lhag bcas gtor ba dang / dmag mi 3500lhag bsad pa red/ a ri'i dmag dpung la gnam gru 'bab sa'i dmag gru 1dang / mtsho skor dmag gru 1gnam gru 147bcas gtor ba dang /dmag mi 307shi rmas su gyur ba'i gyong gud reg de nas 'ja' phan mtsho dmagagi zhi bde'i rgya mtsho'i stobs shugs nyams dmas su 'gyur mgo tshugs shing / kho tshos kyang lha zhi bde rgya mtsho'i rang 'gul dbang cha de nas bzung dgra bo'i lag tu shor song zhes pham pa khas blangs/krung thu'u to mtsho 'khrug gi rjes nas bstud mar 'ja' me gnyis kyis lo phyedatsam la kwa dar kha nar (lo 77677)gling phran rtsod pa'i dmag 'khrug //shā/kha nar (gsham nas kwa gling zer )gling phran ni so lo mon gling tshom gyi lho phyogs na yod cing de'i rgya khyon la dbyin le gru bzhi ma 2500yod pa dang /de'i thog na nags tshal stug po tshing tshing du skyes shing sa dbyibs btsan pa zhig yin/ 1942lo'i zla 5bar 'ja' dmag gis so lo mon gling tshom gyi thu'u la ce gling phran bzung rjes/ kwa gling nas gnam gru 'bab thang las chog pa dang dmag don gzhi sa bzang po zhig yin pa shes/ skabs 'di'i 'ja' dmag gi 'thab jus dmigs yul ni sngar ltar mor tshi pes gru kha 'phrog ste/ o si khru li ya dang a ri bar gyi 'grim 'grul gcod pa dang / o si khru li yar 'jigs snang bskul rgyu de yin/ kwa gling bzung nas de ru dmag don gzhi sa btsugs na ral gri rnon po zhig byur mtsho la btsugs pa dang mtshungs/ der brten 'ja' dmag gis kwa gling bzung pa dang / de ru bzo skrun dmag dpung mngags te myur bar gnam gru 'bab thang bzos/ zla 8pa'i zla mgor/gnam gru 'bab thang ha lam las tshar ba red/ 313

skabs der/ a ri'i spyi'i 'thab jus ni 6 sngon la yo rob gling dang de nas e she ya gling mi / 2 sngon la nub kyi rgya mtsho chen po dang phyis su zhi bde rgya mtsho ’ yin/ a ri'i dmag dpung gi zhi bde rgya mtsho sa khul gyi nye ba'i 'thab jus dmigs 'ben ni a ri dang o si khru li ya bar gyi 'grim 'grul khag theg dang / o si khru li ya'i gzhi sa srung rgyu de yin/ der brten/ a ri'i dmag dpung gis o si khru li ya'i byang shar phyogs kyi mkha' mtsho'i ga'i sa dag len dgos pa'i nang gi kwa gling ni dmigs 'ben gtso bo zhig yin/ 'ja' phan gyi dmag gru kwa gling la ma thon gong gzhi sa de 'dzin ched/ zla 8pa'i tshes 7nyin/a ri'i mtsho dmag skam 'thab ru khag gi dmag mi khri 1 9yis/ ro po thi gi mu'u lis (7567 4yospyolko/)kyis mgo khrid byas 'og kwa gling dang thu'u la ce gling phran la dus mnyam du phar rgol byas/ gling phran de gnyis na 'ja' dmag nyung tsam las med pas/ a ri'i dmag dpung 'gog mkhan cher med par gling phran gnyis bdag du 'dzin thub/a ri'i dmag dpung gis kwa gling 'dzin pa ni rbad de 'ja' dmag gi blo yul las 'das/ 'ja' dmag gis a ris tshur rgol slong dus ma mtha' yang 1943lo'i lo smad du ma gtogs mgo rtsom mi thub pa'i tshod dpags byas pa dang / thengs 'di ni a ri'i dmag dpung gis 6 myul zhib rang bzhin gyi tshur sol bslangs pa mi yin pas/ phar rgol byed pa thag bcad/ 'ja' dmag gis / yang bskyar kwa dar kha nar gling phran 'phrog thub min ni dgra bo las rgyal thub min gyi 'gag rtsar thug yod par snyam/mi zla 8pa'i tshes 16nyin/'ja' dmag gi rgyab rogs dmag dpung kwa gling nas skam sar bud/ tshes 21nyin/ 'ja' dmag stong gnyis kyis gling phran thog tu yod pa'i a ri'i dmag dpung la phar rgol bslangs kyang / mjug mthar pham kha chen po regaskaXdi /ra dzig rngam che ba'i 'ja' dmag gi ham sems shin du che ste/ khron

khug (1//gre)gis mgo khrid byed pa'i 'ja' dmag stong drug gis yang bskyar kwa gling la rgol du phyin de dmar 'dzing drag po byas/ gling phran thog a ri'i dmag mi khri 2lhag gis 'dzing rags la brten nas srung yod par ma zad/than khe yang yod pa red/ mjug mthar khron khug gis khrid pa'i le'u de'i go hrag dmag mi stong tsho gsum bsad de gang sar ro yis khyab cing khrag rgyun chu ltar bzhur/ a ri'i dmag dpung gis srung ba'i sgang kha 'di la phyis su 6 khrag sgang ’ zhes pa'i ming thogs/'ja' dmag kwa gling nas yang yang pham kyang / rgyan 'dzugs mkhan dang 'dra bar rgyan shor ken shor ken mtshams 'jog mi 'dod pa dang mtshungs/ zla 10ba'i tshes 24nyin/ 'ja' dmag gis dmag shugs khri tsho 2lhag btang nas yang bskyar kwa gling la tshur rgol bslangs/ yin na'ang a ri'i dmag dpung gi mtshon cha bzang bas dgra bo stong phrag 'ga' shi rmas btang 'a/ ja' me gnyis kyis kwa gling nas dza drag che ba'i 'phrog rtsod dmag 'khrug byas par ma zad/ kwa gling nye 'gram gyi mtsho thog nas kyang dmag 'khrug rme nga po brgyab/ phyogs gnyis ga'i kwa gling la rogs skyor byed pa'i dmag dpung dang / dmag chas tshang ma mtsho thog nas 'dren dgos pas/ phyogs gnyis gas dmag gru ru khag chen po btang nas skyel 'dren la srung skyob byas/'ja' phan gyis skyel 'dren dmag gru srung ba bed spyad nas a ri'i dmag gru ru khag bslu brid byas nas/ krung thu'u to gling phran gyi dgra len par bsam ste/6 lung zhang mirtags can dang / 6 ros hi ’ rtags can/ 66'ang hi mi rtags can sogs gnam gru 'bab sa'i dmag gru mngags/ a ris btang pa'i gnam gru 'bab sa'i dmag gru la tsu tshi ye ’ rtags can dang / 66ta hong h+phin ’ rtags can/ 66sa la tho ca mi rtags can bcas yod/ 'ja' me'i bsdu snatsho

'khrug cung che ba bzhi brgyab cing / thog mar 'ja' dmag gis khe spogs cung tsam blangs na'ang / rjes su mtsho thog dang mkha' lam la tshod 'dzin byed pa'i dbang thams cad a ri'i lag la shor ba red/ cang ma 'gor bar kwa gling gi 'ja' dmag gi dmag chas skyel 'dren mtshams chad pas/ dmag mis sdong lo dang rtswa ldum sogs mi za ka med byung pa'i khar/ nad yams kyis zin pas/bkres ltogs dang nad yams kyis shi ba'i dmag mi bgrang gis mi lang pas/kwa gling ni 6 'chi bdag gi gling phran dang /’ 6 bkres ltogs kyi gling phran mizhig du gyurazla/ 12pa'i zla smad la/ 'ja' phan dmag spyi khang gis kwa gling nas 'ja' dmag phyir 'then pa'i thag bcad/ 1943lo'i zla 2pa'i tshes 1nyin/kwa gling gi pham pa'i dmag dpung de gnam gru 300dang / mtsho skor dmag gru nyi shus srung skyob byas 'og phyir 'then byas/ zla 2pa'i tshes 7nyin mtha' maḥg gi phyir 'then byed skabs/ khyon bsdoms dmag mi khro tsho 1 089phyir 'a na / sna/ra kha nar gyi dmag 'khrug nang 'ja' dmag gi dmag gru 30lhag gyong gud du song (de'i nang gnam gru 'bab sa'i dmag gru 1yod )ba dang / gnam gru 1900/ dpon dmag khri tsho 2 46bcas gyong gud du song / de nas bzung 'ja' dmag gis phar rgol byed pa de 'gog srung byed par gyur ba dang / ari'i dmag dpung ni 'gog srung byed pa nas phar rgol byed par gyur bas/'ja' phan btsan 'dzul pa'i dka' khag je che nas je cher gyur/316

sa bcad bcu ba/ 'dzam gling rgyal khab so so'i mi dmangs kyis h+pha shi si la ngo rgol byed pa'i 'thab rtsod/(gcig) krung go'i mi dmas kyis dka' chegs ha cang che ba'i cha rkyen 'og 'ja' 'gog byas pa/ 'ja' phan gyis krung gor phyogs yongs nas btsan 'dzul byas te lo lnga 'gor rjes/ rang nyid krung gor btsan btsan 'dzul byed pa'i 'dam rdzab nangagating du byings ba shes pas/ dka' ngal las thar thabs su srog dang bsdos nas zhi bde rgya mtsho'i dmag 'khrug bslangs pa red/ de'i 'bras bur rgyalakhab nyer bzhis 'ja' phan la dmag brda brgyab pas/ kho tsho sngar las kyang grogs med kher rkyang du lus/ skabs der 'ja' phan gyi ches mtho'i dmag spyi khang gis kho tshor dmag shugs kyis mi 'dang bar gzas nas krung gor btsan 'dzul byed pa'i dmag dpung skor zhig phyir 'then byas te zhi bde rgya mtsho dang lho phyogs kyi g.yul sar rogs skyor byed bsam kyang / krung gos go skabs de dang bstun nas phyir rgol byed par skrag pas/ kho tsho ci bya gtol med du gyur/ yin na'ang / 'ja' phan dmag shed can gyis 6 krung go'i dus 'gyur mi myur bar thag gcod pa'i stong bsam sngar bzhin bcangs yod/'ja' phan gyi ches mtho'i dmag spyi khang gis krung gor mngags pa'i dmag dpung la bka' phab pa'i nang don la 6 ye she ya shar ma chen po'i sgrig lam gsar ba 'dzugs skrun byed ched/ lho phyogs kyi g.yul sa gal che sar 37snang

'jug byed pa dang chabs cig myur du krung go'i dus 'gyur thag gcod dgos ’ shes bris yod/ der brten 'ja' phan gyis cang ce hrir chab srid kyi bslu brid byed pa dang dus mtshungs/ gom gang mdun spos sgos krung go'i bcings 'grol sa khul la gdug rtsub che ba'i 6 grong rdal sngogs 'don byed pa dang smyo tshar gcod byed pa mi khyur mid gtong ba mi bcas kyi srid jus lag bstar byas/ skabs der/ 'ja' phan btsan 'dzul pas krung go'i gung khran tangagis mgo khrid byed pa'i mi dmangs kyi drag chas stobs shugs de kho tsho'i nyen kha gtso bo yin pa rtogs yod cing / gang tshun nying tshis (tham sgem/kho'i mnga' 'og gi mi rnams la smyo e she ya shar ma chen po'i dmag 'khrug la rgyal pham rtsod pa'i dgos mkho dang bstun ched/ thog mar nges par du krung gung gi stobs shugs tshar gcod btang nas med par bzo dgos mi shes tshogs gtam btang 1/942lo'i sngon la/ 'ja' dmag gis bcings 'grol sa khul bcom ba de phal cher 'grim 'grul gzhung lam dang de'i 'gram gnyis la byed pa dang /1942lo'i rjes nas bzung / 6 tshar gcod ’ byed pa'i sa khul gyi rgya je cher btang pa dang / rnam pa dang dus yun kyang je ring du btang zhing / gtso gnad hwa pe sa khul la ba'ag pa red/ 6 tshar gcod cung che ba la la'i dus yun zla gnyis nas gsum bar byas pa dang / dmag shugs mi khri tsho lnga nas bcu bar btang pa red/ 1942lo'i zla dang por/ 'ja' dmag gis bcings 'grol sa khul la 6 tshar gcod ’ thengs 1600dang / nyin rer cha snyoms rgol thengs lnga bcu nas drug cu'i bar byas pa red/ 1942lo'i zla 5ba nas bzung / 'ja' dmag gis dmag shugs mi khri tsho 5lhag rtsa 'dzugs byas nas/ hwa pe'i gi ci krung (1smyu7)bde thang la zla gnyis lhag gi sna phyogs yongs kyi rdo/ci gcod byas pa red/ thengs 'di'i 6 tshar gcod ril 'ja' jag gi

6 hwa byang h+phang men cun migyi spyi khyab dmag spyi gang tshun nying tshi rang nyid sku dngos kyis bkod 'doms byas te/ pa lu'u cun gyi gtso shugs rgyag thengs gcig gis rtsa med gtong ba'i stong bsam bcangs/ 'ja' dmag gis 66gtsang gsum mi byed skabs ya nga ba'i bsad nas tshar ba dang / bsregs nas tshar ba/ 'phrog nas tshar bcas tsa tshar ba gsum ’ gyi srid jus lag bstar byas/ dper na/ dgra bos ci krung gi 6 tshar gcod thengs gcig gi nang du mang tshogs khri tsho lnga lhag bsad pa dang 'dzin bzung byas te/ dus skabs shig la sa gnas de'i 4 sde ba yod tshad kyi nang 'dun byas med pa med la/gang sa gang du ngu 'bod byed pa'i ya nga ba'i snang tshul byung /'ja' phan h+pha shi si btsan 'dzul pa'i smyo ham che ba'i gdug rtsub kyis krung go'i mi dmangs 'jigs par byed ma thub par ma zad/ de las ldo ga ste sngar las lhag par krung go'i mi dmangs kyis 'ja' dmag la snang sems skye ba dang 'gog rgol byed pa je drag du gyur/ bcings 'grol sa khul gyi dmag dmangs kyis 6 tshar gcod mi la ngo sol dang / grong sdes sngogs bsher byed par ngo rgol byed pa'i 'thab rtsod khrod/ dka' sdug ha cang che ba'i tshod bgam dang sbyong brdar thob/ kho tshos ma'o tse tung gi mi dmangs kyi dmag 'khrug rgyag pa dang / gang la gang 'tshams kyi 'thab jus 'thab rtsal/ spyang grung 'dzoms pa bcas kyi dgongs don ltar dgra bor rdung deg byas pa dang / 'thab rtsod khrod nas rang nyid kyi stobs shugs je cher btang / 1941lo nas 1942lo'i bar gyi ches dka' tshegs che ba'i lo zla'i nang bcings 'grol sa khul gyi mi grangs je nyung du song na'ang / 1943lo nas bzung 'phel rgyas byung nas stobs shugs che ru gyur/ 1943lor/ pa lu'u cun gyis 'ja' dmag dang rdzun dmag la dmag 'khrug khri tsho 2dang stong tsho 4brgyab nas/ 'ja' dmag dang rdzun dmag khri tsho 13dang stong tsho 6tshar gcod byas/ lo der zhin ༵ /na

gyis 'ja' dmag dang rdzun dmag la dmag 'khrug stong tsho 5lhag byas pa dang /dgra bo khri 6dang stong 6lhag tshar bcad/ bcings 'grol sa khul de smyo tshar gcod ’ la ngo rgol dang / 6 grong sdes sngogs bsher mi byed par ngo rgol/ che khyur mid gtong bar ngo rgol byed pa'i 'thab rtsod khrod gom gang mdun spos sgos sra brtan dang rgya che ru song /'ja' dmag gis bcings 'grol sa khul la rnam pa rgya che ba'i sgo nas ra tshar gcod mibyed pa dang chabs cig cang ce hri la chab srid kyi bsru brid byed pa'ang mtshams ma bzhag pa red/ tung the'o dbyin cis yang nas yang du khrong chin la 'grig 'dod yod pa bstan zhing / 6 khrong chin srid gzhung gis da dung don snying med pa'i 'gog rgol byed 'dug par 6 yi chad byung zhes bshad/ cang ce hri la btsan gyis 'grig thabs yong ched/ 'ja' dmag gis 1942lor go min tang gi g.yul sar dmag 'khrug 'ga' re brgyab/1941lo'i zla 12pa nas 1942lo'i zla dang po'i bar/ 'ja' dmag gis hri gsum gyi dmag shugs bsdus nas khrang hrar tshur rgol thengs gsum pa bslangs/ go min tang gi g.yul sa dgu ba'i dmag dpon drwa yos (tshekhya1)dgra bo nang la khrid nas mtha' nas skor ba'i 'thab jus bkol bas/ 'ja' dmag gis khrang hra len thub pa phar zhog de las ldog ste pham kha chen po nyos/khrang tra'i g.yul 'gyel thengs gsum pa de 'ja' dmag phyir 'then byas pa las mjug sgril ba red/ 1942lo'i zla 5ba nas zla 6pa'i bar/ 'ja' dmag gis kre cang nas rmu jan bar gyi gzhung lam 'brel bar byed ched/ kre kun (om)g.yul 'gyel bslangs pa red/ cin hwa ( lha)lanazhi(༅tsho)chus kru'o ( 7)hrang ra'o (24)bcas snga bzhug tu dgra lag tu shor gedang / zla 7pa'i zla stod bar kre kun (glo )g.yul sa yang dgra bos gtor spore//20de nas 1943lo'i bar/ go min tang gi g.yul sa nas 'ja' jag la

'gog rgol nus ldan zhig byed ma thub pa red/'ja' phan btsan 'dzul pas chab srid kyi bsru brid dang dmag don gyi 'jigs snang bskur 'og go min tang gi zhi drag dpon rigs mi nyung pa zhig gis sna lam kyog brgyud nas rgyal khab skyob pa mizhes pa'i dar cha phyar te/gcig rjes gnyis mthud du dgra bor mgo btags/ de'i nang go min tang gi krung dbyang u yon dang rjes snon mu yon mi 20yod pa dang / le'u yan chad kyi dmag dpon mtho shos 58/ dgra bor mgo btags pa'i dmag dpung khri tsho 50bcas yod pa red/ skabs der cang ce hri wang cin we'i rjes su 'brang mi phod de/ rgyu mtshan ni dgra zlar langs pa'i phyogs gnyis kyi stobs shugs bsdur na/ mna' 'brel rgyal khab la nges par du rgyal kha thob thub pa'i dmag 'khrug gi 'khor phyogs la bsam blo thongs song ba'i stabs kyis yin/ zhi bde rgya mtsho'i dmag 'khrug langs rjes/ dbyin me gnyis la krung go'i g.yul sa nas 'ja' phan bkag ste kho tsho'i gnon shugs je yang du gtong ba'i dgos gal ha cang che bas/ krung gor rogs skyor byed pa gong du 'phar/ cang ce hris gnas bab de kho la shin du 'phrod par snyam ste/ 'byung 'gyur gyi 'ja' 'gog gi grub 'bras kho rang gcig pur dbang bar gra sgrig byas/ der brten khos gung rgol mtho rlabs thengs gsum pa bslangs shing / 1943lo'i zla 3par/ cang ce hris (lkolko'o)kho rang gi ming thog nas (krung go'i las dbang 〉zhes pa'i dpe deb cig spel/ don dngos su dpe deb de ni tho zhi hrin (tshoskocha)gyis cang ce hri'i tshab byas nas bris pa zhig red/ de'i nang du cang ce hris 6 krung go'i sngon chad kyi las dbang ni phyi 'brel thad na yod pa dang /'byung 'gyur las dbang ni yod tshad nang srid la rag las pa red mices bshad pa dang / khos pa lu'u cun dang zhin si cun ni 6 dmag shenā /na

gsar ba red ces pa dang / ri 'gog gnas gzhi'i sa khul ni 6 bcad bzung gsar ba red ’ ces dma' 'bebs byas pa dang / lo gnyis kyi ring krung go'i 6 nang srid mthag gcod pa ste/ gung khron tang tshar gcod rgyu dang /gnas gzhi'i sa khul tshar gcod pa bcas byas nas/ go min tang gcig pus 6 srid dbang sger 'dzin byed rgyu yin mi pa sogs kyi dkrog gtam spel/ 〈krung go'i las dbang 〉phyir thon ma thag go min tang gi gleng phyogs kyis 2 gung khran tang 'thor du 'jug rgyu ’ dang / 6 mtha' khul sprod dgos pa sogs mi bshad dgu bshad byas/ cang ce hris hu'u tsung nan (loṭhatshe)la bka' phab nas dmag dpung khri bcu phrag 'ga' bsdu rub byas nas mtha' khul la bkag sdom dang / glags btsal/ gnas tshul tshabs che ba de'i sngon nas/ ma'o tse tung gtso byas pa'i krung go gung khran tang gis hran kun nyin (ṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭhatso)mtha' khul gyi dmag dmangs kyi mgo khrid nas g.yul sa brtan por srung ste/ go min tang dmag dpung gi tshur rgol 'gog pa'i gra sgrig byas/ de dang mnyam du/rgyal yongs la yongs khyab kyi glog 'phrin btang ste/ tsa mthun sgril byed pa dang nang 'khrug la ngo rgol byed pa'i ’ 'bod skul btang bas/ rgyal yongs las rigs so so'i mi dmangs kyis rgyab skyor byas te/ mjug mthar cang ce hris lag 'gul ma thub par mi skyur ka med byung /1941lo nas1942lo'i bar/ hran kun nyin gsum gyi sa mtshamasamatha' khul dang 'ja' 'gog gnas gzhi'i sa khul so sor 'ja' dmag gis rnam pa rgya che ba'i sgo nas tsa tshar gcod byed pa dang go min tang dmag dpungagis bkag sdom byas pas/ nor srid dpal 'byor thad dka' ngal chen po byung / 'bru rigs dang / ras/ rgyun bkol dngos rdzas/ dmag cha yongs khyab du shin du dkon/ tshabs che ba'i dka' ngal la thug dus/ tang krur+sha ༵༵nga dang ma'o tse tung kru'u zhis mtha' khul gyi dmag dmangs la ma

khrid nas thon skyed chen po'i las 'gul tsha tsha 'ur 'ur du langs/ ma'o tse tung gis 2 thon skyed rang 'dang dang / 6 rang gi lag pa 'gul nas lto gos 'dzoms par byed pa'i mi 'bod skul btang / tang krung dbyang gi yang dag pa'i mgo khrid 'og mtha' khul mi dmangs kyi thon skyed chen po'i las 'gul la grub 'bras g.yur du za ba thob nas/ bcings 'grol sa khul gyi dmag dmangs bde blag ngang dka' tshegs che ba'i lo zla las brgal thub pa byung /de dang mnyam du/ 1942lor krung gung krung dbyang gis yan an (༅ṣ+ṭha)nas kun spyod dag ther byed pa'i las 'gul zhig bslangs/ rgyu rkyen sna tshogs kyi dbang gis tang nang du 'byor med gral rim gyi bsam blo min pa'i phyogs lhung mi nyung ba zhig yod de/ skabs de'i mtshon tshul gtso bo ni/ rang snang ring lugs dang / phyogs ris ring lugs/ tang nang gi yan lag brgyad ldan gyi rtsom tshul sogs phyogs lhung mi legs pa de dag red/ yan an gyi kun spyod dag ther ni yongs khyab kyi mar khe si le nyin ring lugs kyi slob gso'i las 'gul zhig red/ kun spyod dag ther byed pa'i bar skabs der blo mthun ma'o tse tung gis 〈tang gi kun spyod dag ther byed dgos 〉zhes pa dang /〈tang nang gi yan lag brgyad ldan gyi rtsom tshul la ngo rgol byed dgos 〉pa sogs kyi snyan zhu spel te/ mar khe si ring lugs kyi tang 'dzugs bsam blo'i gzhung lugs kyi 'phel rgyas la mdzad rjes chen po bzhag thengs 'di'i kun spyodadag ther las 'gul brgyud nas tang yongs kyi mar le ring lugs kyi chu tshad mthor 'degs byung ste/ tang yongs rdzogs kyi bsam blo la snga na med pa'i gcig gyur dang / tang gi 'thab rtsod stobs shugs je drag du gyur pas/tangagis sngar las lhag par mi dmangs kyi sne khrid de dka' ngal mtha' dag las rnam par rgyal ba dang / mjug mtha'i rgyal kha thob reg bar 'ja' 'gog rgyun 'khyongs byed thub par gyur/ 323

(gnyis) ye she ya rgyal khab so so'i mi dmangs kyi 'ja' 'gog 'thab rtsod/khro zhan(77)/ khro zhan mi dmangs rmi 'ja' phan gyis bran g.yog tu bkol ba ches snga zhing dus yun ches ring shos red/ 'ja' krung gnyis kyi shing rta lo'i dmag 'khrug gi rjes su/ 'ja' phan gyis khro zhan kho tshos bsrung bya'i rgyal khab du bsgyur zhing / 'ja' u rgyal khab gnyis kyi dmag 'khrug gi rjes su/ 'ja' phan gyis gom gang mdun spos sgos u ru su'i stobs shugs khro zhan nas phyir phud de/ thad kur khro zhan la dbang bsgyur/ 191)lor/ 'ja' phan gyis yang btsan gyis khro zhan la smyo 'ja' khro rgyal khab mnyam bsre chings yig bzhag nas/ thad kur du khro zhan khyur mid btang pa red/ 'ja' phan btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis khro zhan btsan bzung byas rjes/ khro zhan mi dmangs kyis mi rigs sger tshugs byed pa'i 'thab rtsod byed mgo brtsams/1931lo'i dgu ba'i tshes bco brgyad nyin gyi dus 'gyur langs pa'i rjes su/khro zhan mi dmangs kyi 'ja' 'gog 'thab rtsod de drag chas 'thab rtsod byed pa'i dus rabs gsar bar slebs/ 1932lo'i zla 4ba'i tshes 25nyin/dmag spyi cin ri khrin (457)gyis mgo khrid byed pa'i khro zhan mi dmangs mi drag chas stobs shugs ang dang po ste/ 'ja' 'gog nges med rgol rdung ru khag dbu brnyes pa red/ ru khag des krung go dang khro zhan gyi mtha' mtshams sa khul du 'ja' dmag la 'jab rgol byas/ 1934lo'i zla 3par/ cin ri khrin gyis yang nyin re bzhin yar rgyas su 'gro ba'i nges med rgol rdung ru khag gi /zlo gzhi'i stong / khro zhan gyi mi dmangs gsar brje'i dmag dpung

btsugs shing / krung go'i gung khran tang gis mgo khrid byed pa'i byang shar 'ja' 'gog mna' 'brel dmag dpung la gom gang mdun spos sgos mnyam 'brel byas te/ dpung ba mnyam gshib kyis dmag 'thab byas nas shi na mnyam shi dang gson na mnyam gson byas/khro zhan gyi rim pa so so'i mi dmangs 'ja' 'gog la zhugs par skul slong byed ched/ 1936lo'i zla 5bar/ khro zhan gyi 'ja' 'gog mi rigs 'thab phyogs gcig sgril gyi rtsa 'dzugs tsa mes rgyal bskyar gso tshogs pa zhes pa btsugs shing cin ri khrin hos krang la 'dems/ 6 mes rgyal bskyar gso tshogs pas mi 'ja' 'gog rgyal skyob kyi rtsa tshig chen po bcu mi zhes pa spel nas/khro zhan mi dmangs kyi khyon yongs kyi 'ja' 'gog 'thab phyogs gcig sgril mngon 'gyur byas te/ mi rigs sger tshugs kyi ched du 'thab rtsod byed pa'i skul slong byas/ 66mes rgyal bskyar gso tshogs pa ’ btsugs ma thag rgya che'i khro zhan mi dmangs kyis dang len byas shing / de ma thag mi khri tsho nyi shu lhag rtsa 'dzugs de'i nang du zhugs/ yongs khyab tu nges med rgol rdung bya 'gul spel ba dang mang tshogs khrod mes rgyal slar gso tshogs pa gsar 'dzugs byed pa'i brgyud rim khrod/ cin ri khrin gyis mgo khrid de khrang pe ri bo'i gnas gzhi'i (ṣ+ṭhatsheg chatho'i)sa khul gsar ba btsugs/1937lo'i zla 6pa'i tshes 4nyin/ cin ri khrin gyis khro zhan mi dmangs gsar brje'i dmag gi mgo khrid nas khrang pe ri bo nas lam la chas de/ ya lu'u gtsang po ( lha yo)brgal nas zhan cin nan to na yod pa'i 'ja' dmagagi 'thab jus gnad sa phu'u then po (0(6)la 'jab rgol byas te/dgra bo'i las khungs rdzun ma gtor zhing / grong khyer bzung rjes dgra bo skrag nas bros byol byas/ mi dmangs gsar brje'i dmag gi 'thab mo bas yongs khyab du smyo mes rgyal bskyar gso tshogs pa'i rtsa tshig chen po bcu mi dang /32bye khro

zhan mi dmangs la bsgrags pa'i yi ge zhes pa sogs kyi bsgrags yig bkram/cin ri khrin gyis da dung sa de ga'i mang tshogs la gtam bshad de/ khro zhan mi dmangs kyis dpa' ngar ldan pa'i ngang 'ja' phan btsan 'dzul par 'gog rgol byed dgos pa'i skul ma btang / phyi nyin/ khro zhan mi dmangs gsar brje'i dmag gis dgra lag nas 'phrog pa'i dngos rdzas rnams khyer nas phyir gnas gzhi'i sa khul du log 1938lo'i zla dang por/ cin ri khrin gyisatshogs 'du bsdus te/ mi dmangs gsar brje'i dmag de dpung khag gsum du bgos te/ kha thor nas bya 'gul byed par thag bcad de khro zhan nang logs su song / 1940lo'i zla 8par/ cin ri khrin gyis yang bskyar r+shadamangs gsar brje'i dmag tang srid dmag gsum gyi las byed pa 'i tshogasa'adu bsdus te/ dmag dpung skor chung mang por bgos nas sa gnas so sor mngags te 'thab rtsod byas/khro zhan mi dmangs kyis drag chas 'thab rtsod byed pa dang chabs cig rnam pa sna tshogs kyi 'ja' 'gog 'thab rtsod spel/ dper na/ las mtshams 'jog pa dang / las kur dal 'gor byed pa/ sgrig chas la gtor brlagabyed pa bcas ni rgyun du lag len byed pa'i 'thab rtsod kyi rnam pa red/1940lo'i zla dang po nas zla 8pa'i bar las mtshams thengs 623bzhag pa dang / der zhugs pa'i mi grangs khri tsho 4 9yod/ 1942lo'i zla 3par/ ci krig to'i (lkomacha)mkha' dmag gzhi sa'i khro zhan gyi bzo ba bzhi brgyas dragapos gyen langs byas te/ dgra bo'i gnam gru 70dang / snum mdzod gnyis mer bsregs pa dang / 'ja' dmag 142bsad de 'ja' phan btsan 'dzul par rdung rdeg chen po byas/zhi bde rgya mtsho'i dmag 'khrug langs rjes/ 'ja' jag gis krung go'i byardo ཿ6ra sa khul dang khro zhan gyi sa gnas so sor skor bcom byed pa je

mgyogs su btang / khro zhan mi dmangs gsar brje'i dmag gis cin ri khrin gyi mgo khrid 'og dka' ngal sna tshogs khyad du bsad de/ 'ja' phan btsan 'dzul pa mgo 'dzul reg bar 'ja' 'gog rgyun 'khyongs byas/we the nam(7tshe)/ we the nam ni h+pha ran si'i mi ser spel yul yin te/h+pha ran si'i mi ser spel yul srid gzhung gis 'ja' phan la 'os med 'grig thabs byas pas/ 'ja' phan gyis 1940lo'i zla 9ba'i nang las sla mor hin rdi kri na'i byang phyogs btsan bzung byas shing / 1941lo'i zla 7par yang hin rdi kri na'i lho phyogs btsan bzung byas/ de nas bzung / we the nam mi dmangs kyis 'ja' phan dang h+pha ran si btsan rgyal ring lugs rgyal khab gnyis kyi gnya' gnon nyis brtsegs myangs/ 1940lo'i zla 9ba'i tshes 27nyin/ leng hrin zhing chen (670)byang ri'i mi dmangs kyis sa de'i gung khran tang rtsa 'dzugs kyi mgo khrid 'og phe 'gog 'ja' 'ded kyi drag po'i 'os langs byas/ 1940lo'i zla 11par hin rdi kri na gung khran tang gis 6 hin di kri na'i h+pha 'ja' h+pha shi si la ngo rgol byed pa'i mi rigs 'thab phyogs gcig sgril 'dzugs pa'i thag bcad cing / drag chas kyi 'os langs byas te srid dbang 'phrog pa'i 'char gzhi gtan 'bebs byas/ 1941lo'i zla 5bar hu'u kri men (707)gyis mgo khrid 'og hin di kri na gung khran tang gis 6 hin rdi kri na'i h+pha 'ja' h+pha shi si la ngo rgol byed pa'i mi rigs 'thab phyogs gcig sgril ’ de smyo we the nam sger tshugs mna' mthun ’ du bsgyur/ (bsdus ming we mthun du btags )'thab phyogs gcig sgril de ni gung khran tang gis mgo khrid byed pa'i we the nam rgyal skyob tshogs pa bcu drug gis grub/ lo de'i zla 10bar we mthun gyis bsgrags gtam dang / rtsa 'dzin spel te/ we mthun gyi dmigs yul ni h+pha 'ja' btsan rgyal ring lugs la ngo rgol dang / mi rigs sger tshugs brtson len byed pa/ dmangs gtso'i spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi srid 3)snang

dbyin me la dmag brda gtong ba'i yi ge'i thog ming rtags ma bkod par 6 rang dbang the lan milas 'gul gyi mgo khrid de/ hur brtson gyis dbyin me'i mna' 'brel dmag la 'brel gtugs dang mnyam 'brel byas par ma zad/ 'ja' phan btsan 'dzul par ngo rgol byed pa'i drag chas 'os langs rtsa 'dzugs byed pa'i gra sgrig byas/ 4 rang dbang the lan la zhugs mkhan gyi mi khri tsho lnga lhag yod/ de'i nang gi mang che ba ni rgyal gces dmag dpon dang /srid gzhung gi mgo ba/ gzhung sgrub pa 'bring chung / shes yon can bcas yin/ phyi rgyal na yod pa'i 66rang dbang the lan gyi khongs mis the lan la rgyang sdusgrags dril sgrog dang / gsang 'phrin mi sna bskyed bsrings bcas byed gin da/ the lan gung khran tang gis dka' khag shin tu che ba'i cha rkyen 'og gsang ba'i sgo nas tsa 'ja' 'gog blos btang ru khag ji rtsa 'dzugs byas shing /gsang ba'i gsar 'gyur sgrub pa bcas kyi sgo nas 'ja' 'gog dril bsgrags byas/ 1942lor the lan gung khran tang gsar tu btsugs pa khyab bsgrags byas par ma zad/ rtsa tshig chen po bcu spel nas mi rigs sger tshugs dang dmangs gtso'i gsar brje brtson len byed pa'i dar cha bsgrengs/ skabs der the lan mi dmangs kyi 'ja' 'gog 'thab rtsod zhan pa'i gnas tshul las the gung gis mang tshogs skul slong byed pa nas mgo mi rtsom ka med byung /dpal 'byor 'thab rtsod kyi byed thabs la brten nas rgya che'i bzo ba skul slong byas te las ka dal las byed pa dang / las mtshams 'jog pa/ 'ja' dmagagi mkho chas gtor brlag byed pa bcas byas/ cha rkyen nges can zhig bskrun rjes/ the gung gis thog mar man ku'u sogs sa khul nas bzo ba'i tshogs pa rtsa 'dzugs byas te/ stobs shugs gtog nas 'ja' 'gog mtho rlabs gsar ba gdong len byed pa'i gra sgrig byas/ 329

'bar ma( khri)/ 'ja' dmag gis grong khyer rang khong (4khu )bzung rjes/ 'bar ma'i gung khran tang gis 'bar ma'i byang phyogs su nges med rgol rdung dmag 'khrug rtsa 'dzugs byas par ma zad/ snga gzhug tu 'bar ma'i dkyil khul dang / nub phyogs dang lho phyogs nas 'ja' 'gog gnas gzhi'i sa khul btsugs/ 1943lo'i lo stod du 'bar ma'i gung khran tang gis 'thus mi'i tshogs chen thengs dang po 'tshogs te/ mig lnga'i 'gan khur gtso bo ni 'ja' phan btsan 'dzul par 'gog rgol byas te mi rigs sger tshugs brtson len byed rgyu de yin pa gtan 'bebs byas/ der brten/ 'bar ma gungayin tang gis hur thag gis mi rigs ma rtsa'i gral rim la mnyam 'brel byed rgyur brtson len byas/ 1943lo'i zla 8pa'i tshes 1nyin/ 'ja' phan btsan 'dzul pas pa mo la (༅r+sā)rgyal khab kyi 6 gtso bdag 'khur tu bcug nas 'bar ma'i mi la tshab sgrub pa byed du 'jug pa'i lag thabs gsar ba bkol/ rgyal gces dmag dpon ang hran (77)dang 'bar ma'i gung khran tang gi mgo khrid pa bde chen bstan dar (choṣ+ṭha༅lko)gnyis kyang 'thab jus lagazhigs nas pa mo'i srid gzhung du zhugs/ yang hran gyis rgyal srung pu'u krang gi 'gan khur ba dang bde chen bstan dar gyis zhing las pu'u krang gi 'khan khur/ 1944lo'i zla 8par/ gung khran tang gi gros bton 'og 'bar mas 6 h+pha shi si la ngo rgol byed pa'i mi dmangs rang dbang mna' mthun tshogasapa mi btsugs te/ dmag spyi ang hran gyis mna' mthun tshogs pa'i kru'u zhidang / bde chen bstan dar gyis spyi khyab hru'u ci yi 'gan khur/ 6 rang dbangamana' mthun tshogs pa mini yongs khyab kyi h+pha shi si la ngo rgol byed pa'i 'thabaphyogs gcig gyur gyi rtsa 'dzugs yin pa dang / mna' mthun tshogs parazhugs pa'i mi khri tsho 20lhag yod pa'i nang drag chas mi sna khri tsho 5lhag yod/ mibardidī / rang dbang mna' mthun tshogs pa'i ches mtho'i u yon lhan khang

grub yod cing / de'i khongs gtogs kyi 'bar ma'i gsar brje'i dmag gi dmag spyi ni ne blun (lkom)gyis khur/ snye rang dbang mna' mthun tshogs pa mi btsugs rjes/ 'bar ma'i 'ja' 'gog 'thab rtsod la yongs khyab kyi mang tshogs kyi rmang gzhi yod pas/ myur bar 'ja' 'gog 'thab rtsod de mtho rlabs gsar ba'i phyogs la skul 'ded byas/ma le ya(6r+sā༅)/ 'ja' dmag gis ma le ya la btsan 'dzul byas rjes/ ma le ya gung khran tang gis mi rigs so so dang / tang khag so sor yongs khyab tu mnyam 'brel byas te/ 'ja' 'gog mi rigs kyi 'thab phyogs gcig gyur btsugs pa dang / drag po'i 'thab rtsod kyis ma le yar srung skyob byas/ dbyin ji mi ser spel yul srid gzhung gis rang gi khe phan gyi dgos mkho'i ched du ma gung gi khrims mthun go gnas khas blangs thog khrims la bcug pa'i gung khran tang yon glod la btang ste/ ma gung gis mnyam du 'ja' 'gog byed pa'i 'dod blo dang len byas/ 'ja' dmag gis phyogs yongs nas ma le ya bzung rjes/ ma gung gis gros mgo bton 'og sa gnas so sor bkram yod pa'i nges med rgol rdung ru khag rtsa 'dzugs mnyam 'brel byas nas gcig gyur gyi ma le ya mi dmangs 'ja' 'gog dmag btsugs shing / dmag mi 700lhag yod/ 1942lo'i zla 2bar sing ga phor 'ja' dmag la shor rjes nas 1943lo'i ston kha bar 'ja' 'gog dmag gis dmag 'thab thengs 20lhag byas pa dang / dgra dmag 600lhag bsad/'ja' 'gog 'thab rtsod khrod/ ma gung gis mi rigs 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi srid jus rgyun 'khyongs byas te/ ma le mi dang / krung go'i mi/hin rdi'i mi sogs mi rigs chen po gsum la mthun sgril byas te mnyam du 'thab rtsod byas/ krung go'i mi ni ma le ya'i 'ja' 'gog byed pa'i stobs shugs gtso bo zhig yin/ 'ja' phan btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis krur+sha sbyor

btsan 'dzul byed pa'i dmag 'khrug bslangs rjes/ rgya che'i ma le ya'i phyir sdod rang mis hur thag gis dngul dang dngos rdzas phul te mes rgyal gyi 'ja' 'gog la rgyab skyor byas/ 'ja' dmag gis ma le ya btsan bzung byas rjes/phyir sdod rang mis mtshon cha bzung ste 'ja' 'gog nges med rgol rdung ru khag la zhugs/ ma le ya'i 'ja' 'gog dmag gi mang che ba ni phyir sdod krung go ba yin/ de'i nang gi ru zhin krig phyir sdod krung go ba'i blos blangs dmag ni tshang ma krung go bas grub pa red/ de ltar phyir sdod krung go bas ma le ya'i 'ja' 'gog 'thab rtsod khrod nus pa gal chen thon/nyinardo nyi zhi ya(yitsho༅por+sā)/ 'ja' dmag gis hin rdi nyi zhi ya btsan bzung byas rjes/ hin rdu nyi zhi ya'i thon khungs 'dzoms po 'phrog nas btsan 'dzul dmag 'khrug la bkol ched/ nyin rdu nyi zhi ya khag gsum du bgos te/ so sor dmag mi'i srid gzhung gsum gyi thad ku'i tshod 'dzin 'og bzhag kra wa (loṣ+ṭha)dang / ma tu'u la (677)'ja' dmag gi skam dmag cun 16pa'i khongs gtogs byas pa dang / su'u min ta la ni (smo/ci lhotsho)'ja' dmag gi skam dmag cun 25ba'i khongs gtogs byas pa/ ho lan lagatogs pa'i pho lo krig (zo༅ma)dang / shar hin nyi'i gling phran dag 'ja' phan mtsho dmag gi lho phyogs dmag gru ru khag la gtogs par byas/ kho tsho'i mi ser spel yul gyi dbang bsgyur je mgyogs su gtong ched/ 'ja' dmag srid gzhung gis tsa ye she ya gsum gyi las 'gul ’ spel te/ 'ja' phan ni ra tshe she ya gling gi lam ston sgron me dang / e she ya gling gi mgo khrid pa/ e she ya gling gi srung skyob byed mkhan bcas yin pa'i dkrog gtam bsgrags/'ja' phan gyis phyogs gcig nas thon khungs 'dzoms po 'phrog ste/ hin nyi mi dmangs gla g.yog tu bkol cing / 6 mes rgyal srung skyob dmag ’ dang /6 da~X snon sogs dmag don rang bzhin dang dmag don phyed ga'i rang

bzhin ldan pa'i rtsa 'dzugs btsugs te/ hin rdu'i na gzhon rnams 'ja' phan btsan 'dzul dmag 'khrug gi yo byad byed du bcug pa dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas nyin rdu mi dmangs la bsam shes byed mdog gis tsa hin nyi la rang skyong byed du 'jug rgyu yin ’ par bshad/ hin nyi'i mi rigs ma rtsa ring lugs kyi mgo khrid pa rnams dus yun ring por ho lan mi ser spel yul pas gnya' gnon byas te/ kho tsho'i nang gi mi mi nyung pa dus yun ring por btson 'jug gam rgyang 'phud du btang ba red/ zhi bde rgya mtsho'i dmag 'khrug langs rjes/ de tsho'i nang gi 'thus tshab mi sna ste/ dper na/ su'u ca no (lomebastsa)dang ha ta (khya 7)sogs kyis 'ja' phan gyi mir brten nas hin nyi'i mi rigs sger tshugs yong ba'i stong bsam bcangs/ 'ja' phan btsan 'dzulapas kyang chab srid kyi shugs rkyen yod pa'i chab srid bya 'gul pa 'di dag bed spyad nas hin nyi mi dmangs la mgo skor btang ste/ kho tsho'i mi ser spel yul gyi dbang bsgyur srung skyob byed gang thub byas/ 1943lo'i zla 8par 'ja' phan btsan bzung srid gzhung gis tsa ye she ya las 'gul mtshams 'jog tu bcug ste/ de'i tshab la lha mang tshogs kyi khe dbang lte gnas ces pa zhig btsugs shing / su'u ca no dang ha ta yang rtsa 'dzugs 'dir zhugs/phyis su 'ja' phan btsan 'dzul las khungs kyis 6 mang tshogs kyi khe dbang lte gnas mil mi rigs sger tshugs kyi bsam blo yod pa shes nas 1944lo'i zla 3par rtsa 'dzugs de 'thor tu bcug su'u ca no sogs kyis kyang sna khyad par can gyi gdung len ru khag ces pa zhig btsugs te/ mu mthud nas 'ja' phan gyis mis sgrub tu 'jug pa'i hin nyi sger tshugs byed pa'i bya 'gul spel/su'u ca no sogs kyis 66khrims mthun gyi mi rigs sger tshugs brtson len byed pa'i chabs cig nyin nyi gung khran tang gis mgo khrid pa'i mang tshogs kyi rgyal gces rtsa 'dzugs kyis gsang ba'i sgo nas 'ja' 'gog 31zlob

rtsod sgrub bzhin yod/ hin nyi gung khran tang gi ming du grags pa'i mgo khrid pa hra lis spro tin (74khu1)gyis rang nyid sku dngos kyis hin nyi'i ches che ba'i gsang ba'i 'ja' 'gog rtsa 'dzugs shig la mgo khrid byas shing / dkyil kra ba dang shar kra ba sa khul nas bya 'gul spel/ gsang ba'i 'ja' 'gog rtsa 'dzugs de zhing sde dang / tha na smyo mes rgyal srung skyob dmag mi dang 66dmag snon ’ gyi nang du'ang thon yod/ zhing sde nas sa zhing phyir 'phrog pa'i 'thab rtsod rgyun mi chad par byung zhing / ra mes rgyal srung skyob dmag ’ gis kyang 'os langs byas/ nang rul pas gdams stabs 1943lo'i zla 11par hra lis h+pho nyin sogs 'ja' 'gog mi sna 53stabs ma legs par dgra bos 'dzin bzung byas/ de'i nang gi mi bzhis rang srog blos btang pa dang / hra lis spro tin su'u ca no sogs kyis shugs chen pos skyabs stabs srog thog la ma bzhag kyang /'dzam gling dmag 'khrug gnyis pa mjug sgril reg bar du btson 'jug byas pa red/ nyin nyi gung khran tang gi mgo khrid pa gtso bo 'dzin bzung thebs rjes/ krung dbyang gi mgo 'dren med par gyur yang / gzhi rim tang gi rtsa 'dzugs kyi tang yon rnams kyis ches dka' sdug che ba'i cha rkyen 'og 'thab rtsod mtshams ma bzhag par 'ja' 'gog la rgyal kha thob reg bar rgyun 'khyongs byas/ gong nas bshad pa'i rgyu rkyen de dag gi dbang gis su'u ca no dang ha ta sogs kyi 66khrims mthun mi'athab rtsod de mang tshogs kyi nang du shugs rkyen che ba dang / hin nyi gung khran tang gis mgo khrid byed pa'i 'ja' 'gog 'thab rtsod de nyams chung gi tshad na yod/gli li bran(lkoṣ+ṭhar+sā)/ 'ja' phan gyis h+phi li phen btsan bzung byas rjes/ nang rul pa btsal te/ sngon chad kyi rgyal srung pu'u krang hor hi par ca si (r+sālo ༅po40lo)gtso bo yin pa'i 6 srid 'dzin u yon lhan khang ’ bsdo/sdu te/ h+pha shi si'i dbang bsgyur spel/ h+phi li phen gyi zhing bdag ma rtsa

can chen po'i sngon chad kyi dbang bsgyur tshogs pa'i nang gi mi skor zhig me khi a sug dang mnyam du o si khru li ya la bros shing de nas a me ri ka la song ba dang / skor zhig 'ja' phan mi'i thag sgul 'dra gzugs srid gzhung gi ‘ srid 'dzin u yon lhan khang midu zhugs pa red/ sngon gyi rgyal srung pu'u krang phud da dung dpon rigs mtho shos khrims 'dzin pu'u krang lo ler (777)dang /grong khyer ma ni la'i (6khu7)hri krang war ca si (777)lo)sogs yod pa red/ 1943lor lo ler gyis h+phi li phen 6sger tshugs ’ byas rjes kyi tsun thun rdzun ma1 ༵༵)/gror btsugs pa'i h+phi li phen gung khron tang gis mi rigs 'ja' 'gog 'thab rtsod la mgo khrid byed pa'i 'gan khur ljid mo phrag tu blangs/1942lo'i zla 2par/ h+phi gung gis gros gzhi bton 'og h+phi li phen gyi h+pha shi si la ngo rgol byed pa'i tshogs pa so sos 'ja' 'gog 'thab phyogs gcig gyur btsugs/ lo de'i zla 3par h+phi gung gis mgo khrid byed pa'i nges med rgol rdung rukhag cig gis 'ja' 'gog drag chas 'thab rtsod kyi me mda' ang dang po brgyab/ de nas cang ma 'gor bar h+phi li phen mi dmangs kyi 'ja' 'gog dmag dpung btsugs pa khyab bsgrags byas/ 1942lor thon rjes 'ja' 'gog drag dpung myur bar 'phel rgyas byung ste kri tos 42dang mi 5000lhag la 'phar/ 1944lo'i ston khar mi dmangs kyi 'ja' 'gog dmag dpung 'phel rgyas byung nas mi khri gcig la bud pa dang / 'ja' dmag gtor pham du 'gro khar dmag mi khri 10lhag la 'phar/ 'ja' 'gog gi dus rim hril bo'i nang /mi dmangs 'ja' 'gog dmag gis dmag 'khrug thengs 1200lhag brgyab pa dang / dgra dmag dang rdzun dmag 25000lhag tshar gcod byas/h+phi li phen du sdod pa'i krung go ba yang h+phi li phen gyi 'ja' 'gog 'thab rtsod la hur brtson gyis zhugs/ h+phi lin phen gyi mi dmangs 'ja' 3༷/ga

dmag dpung gi gcig gyur gyi bkod 'doms 'og h+phi li phin du sdod pa'i krung go bas ming la 6 bzhi brgyad kri tos zer ba'i 'ja' 'gog nges med rgol rdung ru khag cig btsugs/ ming la 2 bzhi brgyad kri tos zer don ni krung go gung khran tang gis mgo khrid byed pa'i 'ja' 'gog drag dpung zhin si cun dang pa lu'u cun la gus 'dud byed pa'i ched yin/ zu bzhi brgyad kri tos 7kyis h+phi li phen mi dmangs kyi 'ja' 'gog 'thab rtsod kyi las don khrod rang gi byas rjes bzhag(gsum) yo rab gling mi dmangs kyi h+pha shi si la ngo rgol byed pa'i 'thab rtsod/yi go si la wi ya (nan sil spru/zug46rke1zeng))/ hes thi lis yi go si la wi ya'i gtso bdag tshu wis thi khi we chi (cho chas r+sha)'jar man dang 'ja' phan/ dbyi tha li bcas h+pha shi si'i rgyal khab gsum gyi mna' 'brel chings yig 'jog pa'i nang zhugs su bcug rjes/ yi go si la wi ya'i mi dmangs mang tshogs kyis de la 'gog rgol byas shing / 66'chi dgos kyang bran g.yog mi byed mi ces pa dang / smyo gros chod 'jog pa'i rgyal 'tshong pa rtsa rdzogs byed dgos ’ ces pa sogs kyi 'bod tshig bsgrags/ mi dmangs kyis h+pha shi sir ngo rgol byed pa'i blo kha mtho ba'i gnas tshul 'og mkha' dmag gi dmag spyi zhi mo we chis (mcho cha)1941lo'i zla 3pa'i tshes 26nyin srid 'gyur bslangs te tshu slus thi khi we chi skor tshogs 'dzin bzung byas nas srid gzhung gsar ba btsugs shing / nyes thi li'i 'char gzhi stong zad du gyur/ de'i rjes kyi 1941lo'i zla 4ba'i tshes 6nyin/ 'jar man ma'o so li dang 'brel te rnam pa 336
ri 6 7 trerdo ṇ+ḍaṃ

nges med rgol rdung ru khag de dngos su yi go si la wi ya'i bcings 'groladamag la bsgyur zhing / 1943lo'i zla 11par the tho la dmag spyi chen mo'i mtshan ༵ r+sha kā na~X wi/ ya'i bcings 'grol dmag gis lo bzhi'i dmag 'khrugakhrod mnga' khongs mang che ba bcings 'grol byas par ma zad/ 'jar dbyi'i h+pha shi si'i dmag shugs che ba bkag skyil byas/ 1941lor 'jar dbyi'i yi na si la wi ya nas bsdad yod pa'i dmag dpung gi mi grangs khri tsho 51yod cing /1942lo'i lo smad du khri tsho 66la 'phar/ 1943lor dbyi tha li mgo btags pa'i yar sngon la dmag shugs yang khri tsho 70la 'phar/ mi rigs bcingasa'agrol dmag 'khrug hril bo'i nang yi go si la wi ya mi dmangs bcings 'gro dmag gis dmag 'khrug bgrang las 'das pa brgyud cing / dgra bo'i rnam rgargya che ba'i tshur rgol thengs bdun la 'gog rgol byas/ mtshams mtshams lodagra dmag khri phrag bcu lhag gi dmag shugs btang / yi go si la wi ya'i ṣ+pedamangs bcings 'grol dmag de dpa' ngar che 'ing dmag rgyag la mkhasapas khyon bsdoms dgra dmag khri tsho 45rtsa med du btang / 1945lor na tsha dmag dpung pham khar yi go si la wi ya'i bcings 'grol dmag khri tsho 807'phel ba ni/ gtso bo rang gi stobs shugs la brten nas rang rgyal khagabacings 'grol byas pa red/wi go si la wi ya ni yo rob gling mi dmangs kyis h+pha shi si la ngo rgol byedapa'i 'thab rtsod kyi gzi brjid ldan pa'i dar cha zhig yin zhing / h+pha shi si la lhargol byed pa'i las don khrod/ yi go si la wi ya mi dmangs kyi mi grangs khri chabargya dang bdun cus rang srog blos btang pa red/ de'i nang du yi gung ṣ+katang yon khri tsho 5yod/ yi go si la wi ya'i gzi brjid ldan pa'i 'thab rtsodadekā tāzlog 'khrug gi dus su h+pha shi si la ngo rgol byed pa'i mna' 'brel rgyal

lab kyi khas len dang rgyab skyor thob/yar pa ni ya(༅lo༅༅༅)/ spyi'i mi grangs khri tsho brgyar mi long pa'i a ra pa ni yas kyang h+pha shi si la ngo rgol byed pa'i dmag 'khrug khrod byas rjes chen po bzhag 1939lo'i zla 4bar dbyi tha li'i h+pha shi sis ar pa ni ya btsan bzung byas rjes ar pa ni ya mi dmangs yar langs nas 'gog rgol byed pa'i 'thab rtsod byas/ 1941lo'i zla 11par ar pa ni ya'i gung khran tang btsugs shing / ho khra (r+sā4)gtso byas pa'i gnas skabs krung dbyang srid gzhung gis thog ma nas drag chas 'thab rtsod byed par phyogs pa dang / tsa h+pha shi si tshar gcod byed dgos/ rang dbang mi dmangs la gtogs mi shes pa'i 'bod tshig bsgrags/ 1941lo'i lo smad du ar pa ni ya'i sa gnas so so nas nges med rgol rdung ru khag byung ste yongs khyab du dgra bo'i dmag don dang / 'grim 'grul/ 'phrin gtong sgrig chas la gtor brlag byas/ 1942lo'i zla 9par/gung khran tang gis gros mgo bton 'og ru ar pa ni ya'i bcings 'grol 'thab phyogs mi btsugs/ 1943lo'i zla 7par/ ar pa ni ya'i mi rigs bcings 'grol dmag gi spyi khyab dmag spyi khang btsugs/ skabs der ar pa ni yar nges med rgol rdung ru khag gi dbyin 20lhag yod cing / dbyi tha li'i h+pha shi si'i dmag dpung khri tsho 10la 'gog rgol byas/ 1943lo'i zla 7par ma'o so li nyi go sa nas lhung rjes/ 'jar man h+pha shi si de'i rjes la mthud nas thon pas/ ar pa ni mi rigs bcings 'grol dmag 'khrug de yang bskyar sngar las kyang dka' tshegs che ba'i dus skabs shig la thon/ 'jar dmag gis ar pa ni yar btsan 'dzul byed pa'i dmag dpung khri tsho 7btang zhing / deng rabs can gyi mtshon cha spras pa'i na tsha'i dmagadapung gis bcings 'grol sa khul la rnam pa rgya che ba'i tshur rgol byas/ar pa ni ya mi dmangs kyis zas kyis lto mi 'grang pa dang gos kyis ༵༵ mi

'gul yin/ h+pha gung ni h+pha ran si'i mi dmangs kyis h+pha shi si la ngo rgol byed pa'i 'thab rtsod kyi ches mdun gral du yod la/ na tsha'i dmag dpung gis h+pha ran si la btsan 'dzul byas rjes h+pha gung gis grong khyer dang grong gseb kyi ngal rtsol mi dmangs rtsa 'dzugs byas nas rnam pa sna tshogs kyi 'thab rtsod zus/1941lo'i zla 5bar h+pha gung gis gter 'don bzo ba khri tsho 10tsa 'dzugs byas nas las mtshams chen po gza' 'khor gsum gyi nang bzhag cing / gter 'don bzo ba 'di dag gi khrod nas h+pha ran si'i rgyal nang nas h+pha gung gis chesasnga ba'i 6 nges med rgol rdung ru mi ’ dang phu rang dbang me mda' rgyag mkhan rtsa 'dzugs byas/ lo de'i zla 5ba'i tshes 15nyin/ h+pha gung gis mi rigs bcings 'grol 'thab phyogs gcig sgril 'dzugs pa'i bsgrags gtam spel nas/ 'gog rgol rtsa 'dzugs so sor mthun sgril byas nas h+pha shi si la ngo rgol byed pa'i 'thab phyogs gcig sgrol 'dzugs pa'i skul ma btang /1943lo'i zla 5ba'i tshes 27nyin/ h+pha ran si'i gung khran tang dang /spyi tshogs tang / drag spyod tang sogs srid tang khag 16gi tshogs pas h+pha ran si'i gcig gyur gyi 6 rgyal yongs 'gog rgol las 'gul u yon lhan khang btsugs nas rang mu'u lan (/khyi ṣ+ṭha༅)kru'u zhir 'dems thon byung /1944lo'i zla 3par/ tang khag so so'i 'gog rgol rtsa 'dzugs kyi drag chas stobs shugs gcig bsdus kyis 6 nang logs dmag mi ces pa btsugs nas 'gog rgol las 'gul u yon lhan khang gis mgo khrid byas/ tshang mas spyi mthun gyis te ko lo ni h+pha ran si'i 'gog rgol las 'gul gyi bla srog yin par 'dod/ 1944lo'i zla 6pa'i tshes 6nyin/ mna' 'brel dmag dpung no man ti ( ༅ṭha)nas skam sar bud rjes/ h+pha ran si'i 66nang logs dmag mgyogs myur du gong du 'phel zhing / nyin 'ga' las ma 'gor bar mi 3/zlos

khri tsho 50yod pa'i 'thab 'dzing dpung sde zhig tu gyur/ dpung sde 'dis mjug mthar h+pha shi si pham par byed pa dang h+pha ran si yongs rdzogs bcings 'grol byed pa'i brgyud rim khrod nus pa gal chen thon/ge3 se(zhi la(lko ))1941lo'i zla 4bar 'jar man h+pha shi sis ke ri se btsan bzung byas rjes/ ke ri se'i sa gnas so so'i mkhar sgor mi rnams khong khro skye ba'i gartags can gyi dar cha bkal yod/ zla 5ba'i tshes 31nyin gyi mtshan mor ke ri se'i rgyal gces na gzhon gnyis kyis srog 'chor ba'i nyen khar ma 'dzems par mkhar gyang thog gi na tsha'i dar cha zhig mar blangs te ke ri se'i rgyal dar bkal/ dpa' ngar ldan pa'i bya spyod 'di ni ke ri se mi dmangs kyis h+pha shi si'i btsan 'dzul la 'gog rgol byed pa'i sngon brda zhig tu gyur/ de nas bzung ke ri se'i mi dmangs kyis gcig rjes gnyis mthun du nges med rgol rdung ru khag rtsa 'dzugs byas nas gang sa gang du btsan 'dzul dmag la 'jab rgol byas/1941lo'i zla 9ba'i tshes 27nyin/ ke ri se'i gung khran tang gis gros mgo bton 'og ke ri se'i mi rigs 'thab phyogs gcig sgril btsugs pa khyab bsgrags byas shing / de la zhugs mkhan gung khron tang dang / gcig gyur sbyi tshogs tang / zhing las tang / drag spyod tang bcas kyi rtsa 'dzugs yod pa red/ bcings 'grol 'thab phyogs gcig sgril gyis gcig gyur mgo khrid byas 'og 'gog rgol rtsa 'dzugs sna tshogs kyi drag chas stobs shugs gcig bsdus kyis rgyal yongs mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag btsugs/1943lor thon skabs mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi mi grangs khri tsho 7la 'phel rgyas byung / dmag 'khrug dus skabs hril bo'i nang / ke ri se'i mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis h+pha shi si'i dngos gama'i dmag dpung khri tsho shā12 cu lhag bkag skyil byas pa dang / 'jar dmag khri gnyis la nye ba

bsad cing / stong lnga lhag gson bzung byas/ 1943lo'i dbyar kha'i bar/rgyal khab kyi mnga' khongs kyi sum cha'i gnyis bcings 'grol byas/ ke ri se mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis rgyal khab yongs khyab nas 'jar dmag la phar rgol byas pas/ 'jar dmag gis zhi zhi li gling phran nas hri gsum gyi dmag shugs 'then te ke ri ser sdod pa'i dmag dpung la rgyab rogs mi byed ka med byung bas/ zhi zhi li gling phran gyi 'gog srung je lhod du gyur nas dbyin me'i mnyam 'brel dmag dpung zhi zhi li gling phran nas skam sar 'bud par rgyab skyor chen po byas/ de min mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag dang mnyam du gnas pa'i gzhan pa'i drag chas stobs shugs 'ga' yang yod kyang / de dag spra shugs rkyen mi dmangs bcing 'grol dmag dang 'gran thub pa gcig kyang ༵/4lo'i zla 3par/ ke ri se'i mi rigs bcings 'grol 'thab phyogs kyis mi rigs bcings 'grol chab srid u yon lhan khang btsugs te/ gnas skabs srid gzhung gi 'gan blangs shing / ke ri se'i gung khran tang gis de'i nang du nus pa gal chen bton/ dbyin jis dmag 'khrug gi rjes nas kho tsho'i ke ri se na yod pa'i stobs shugs slar gso byed ched/ phyogs gang mang nas bya thabs btsal thog 194lo'i zla 9bar dbyi tha li'i kha se tha (rdo stsa)nas ke ri se'i drag chas stobs shugs gcig gyur byed pa'i gros tshogs sheg bsdus te/ ke ri se'i drag chas stobs shugs yod tshad kyis thun mong du mi rigs mthun sgril srid gzhung zer ba'i bkod 'doms la nyan dgos pa dang /ke ri se srid gzhung gis drag chas dmag dpung yod tshad dbyin ji'i krung cang dmagadapon ro sa khi pis (7 lo142)la sprad nas bkod 'doms byed dgos pa'i thag bcad/ de nas bzung ke ri se mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag la sger tshugs kyis dmag 'thab byed pa'i dbang cha dang rang 3)snang

sbyad par gyur ba de ni nor 'khrul che ba'i 'thab jus shig ma red mi zer ka da k+ta /ri se'i mi rigs bcings 'grol 'thab phyogs kyis drag chas kyi 'thab rtsod byed pa dang mnyam du/ rnam pa rgya che ba'i sgo nas las mtshams 'jog pa dang / rngam ston khrom skor sogs rtsa 'dzugs byas te/btsan 'dzulapar rdung deg byas/ dper na/ 1943lo'i zla 3pa dang zla 7par/ grong khyer ya den (77)nas mi khri tsho nyi shu dang khri tsho sum cus rngam ston khrom skor byasashing / skabs shig la ngal rtsol pu'i thog khang chen mo bzung / ke ri se midamangs kyi 'thab rtsod kyis dgra bor rdung rdeg chen po byas shing / yo rogagling gi h+pha shi sir ngo rgol byed pa'i dmag 'khrug la byas rjes bzhagapho lan(ṣ+ṭha༅)/ 'jar man h+pha shi sis pho lan bzung rjes 6 mi rgyud thad nas pho lan gyi mi bsal snyigs la 'ded pa'i ya nga ba'i srid jus lag bstar byas te/ gdug rtsub che ba'i sgo nas pho lan gyi mi dmar gsod byas pa dngakade'i nang du yug the mi'i (7〉〉〉las dbang lhag par tu sdug na tshas jagatshogs kyis pho lan nas yug the mi'i sa khul btsugs te yug the'i mi rgyud tsamed du gtong ba'i re ngan bcangs/ kho tshos da dung pho lan gyi sa gnas musor gcig bsdus btson ra sna tshogs 280btsugs te/ dug rlangs gis migasod pa'i thabs spyad de pho lan gyi mi mang po dmar gsod byas/ grong khyer war sa'i (8rkyeskya re)lho nub phyogs kyi o si we zhin gcig bsdus btson ra (sgo smosatshosto tshor+sā)nas dus skabs shig la nyin rer mi khri gcig re dug rlangasakhang du bcug nas bsad/ tshod dpag byas pa ltar na yo rob gling gi rgyalakhab so so nas yong ba'i nyes med mi dmangs khri phrag 300lhag o si we zhin btson ra nas bsad/ dmag chen gyi skabs su spyi'i mi grangs khri phrag 35ni//da pa'i pho lan mi'i nang du khri phrag 530pho shi sis dmar gsod byas pa

dang / khri phrag 250'jar man la bskyal nas bran g.yog byed du bcug de las pho lan mi dmangs kyis 'dzam gling dmag chen gnyis pa'i nang myangs pa'i chag sgo tshabs chen yin pa mthong thub pa red/ yin na'ang / pho lan mi dmangs gnas tshul tshabs chen des dpa' zhum du 'jug ma thub pa dang /rgyal shor bran g.yog de bas kyang byed mi 'dod pas/ kho tshos 'jar jag la 'gog rgol byas te/ rgyal khab skyob pa'i las don la zhugs/ rgyal khab shor rjes/ 'gog rgol las 'gul gyi rtsa 'dzugs gcig rjes gnyis mthud du btsugs/ de'i nang du stobs shugs cung che ba'i rtsa 'dzugs 50lhag yod/gtor pham du btang ba'i pho lan rgyal khab kyi lhag lus dpon dmag mi nyung pa zhig kyang snga gzhug tu 'gog rgol las 'gul gyi rtsa 'dzugs su zhugs shing /de'inang gi hro zho dmag dpon to pu'u rang si ci (lkolko/1lo6)yis mgo khrid byed pa'i nges med rgol rdung ru khag cig gis h+pha shi si'i dmag dpung la rdung deg chen po byas/1939lo'i zla 9ba'i zla stod du rgyal khab bskyur nas phyi la bros byol byas pa'i pho lan srid gzhung gis zla 9ba'i zla smad du pha ri si nas yul 'khyar srid gzhung btsugs shing / phyi lor lun ton la spar/ 1941lor yul 'khyar srid gzhung gis rgyal nang nas 6 drag po'i 'thab rtsod mna' 'brel tshogs pa btsugs shing / 1942lor 6 gsang ba'i dmag ’ ces par bsgyur/1941lo'i zla 7pa'i zla smad du su'u len dang pho lan yul 'khyar srid gzhung bar du phyi 'brel 'brel ba btsugs par ma zad/ 6 phan tshun rogs ram gros chod ’ bzhag gros chod ltar su'u len nas pho lan gyis su'u len rgyal nang nas dmag dpung zhig 'dzugs par 'thad pa byung zhing / dmag mi khri tsho bdunadang stong tsho lnga bsdus/ dmag dpung 'dir an di sis (ṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭhamo)mgokhrid byas/ phyis su su'u len dang kha bral te mna' 'brel dmag 3)snang

dang mnyam 'brel byas nas/ dbyi tha li'i dmag 'khrug sogs la zhugs shinganadamag grangs khri tsho 15yas mas la 'phar/ gzhan su'u len du sdod pa'i gung khran tang yon gzhi rkang byas pa'i pho lan rgyal gces mi snas su'u len nas che mulan rgyal gces pa'i mna' mthun ’ btsugs/ mna' mthun tshogs pa 'disapho lan gyi dang blangs dmag dpung zhig btsugs shing / phyis su de rmang gzhibyas nas ha lam mi grangs khri 10yod pa'i dmag dpung zhig tu 'phel ba dngasu'u len dmag dpung gis gcig gyur gyis mgo khrid byas te/ su'u legagayul sa nas 'jar man la 'thab pa'i dmag 'khrug tu zhugs/pho lan rgyal nang du pho lan gung khran tang gis hur brtson byas 'og1942lo'i lo stod du pho lan bzo ba'i tang btsugs pa khyab bsgrags byas/bzo ba'i tang btsugs ma thag myur bar mi dmangs go hrag dmag dpung btsugs te/ shugs chen gyis nges med rgol rdung dmag 'khrug spel te phyogasakun nas 'jar man h+pha shi si la 'jab rgol byas/ 1943lor mi dmangasago hrag dmag dpung gi ru khag 80lhag gis pho lan rgyal nang nas dmag 'thangabyas/ lo der go hrag dmag dpung gis dmag 'thab thengs 200lhag byas te 'jar dmag 1300lhag tshar gcod byas/ lo de'i zla 4bar war sa'i yug rdzis khul du 'os langs byas rjes/ 'jar man tang we cun gyis than khe dang gnam rgyu me skyogs sogs kyis ya nga ba'i drag gnon byas/ phyis su stobs shugs la khyad par chen po yod pas 'os langs pham song ba dang / 'os pa/sa la zhugs mkhan mang che bas dpa' ngar ngang rang srog blos btang pa 1944lor mna' 'brel dmag la bstud mar rgyal kha thob pa'i gnas tshul 'og pho lan yul 'khyar srid gzhung dang de'i gsang ba'i dmag gis rgya/ /6 war sa nas drag po'i 'os langs byed pa'i thag bcad/ zla 8pa'i tshes

1nyin/ 'os la ngas byed mkhan gyis btsan 'dzul par 'jab rgol byas/ gu 'os langs kyi dpung sde de myur bar mi grangs khri tsho 5la 'phel zhing / 'jar tre dmag gis de la ya nga ba'i drag gnon byas/ 'os langs pas srang lam nas nyin 63gyi ring la dmag 'thab rgyun 'khyongs byas kyang / mjug mthar stobs shugs la khyad par chen po yod pa'i stabs kyis 'os langs pham song ba na tshas gcig bsdus btson ra'i red/ thengs 'di'i war sa'i 'os nang gi yug the mi/langs khrod yang pho lan mi dmangs khri tsho nyi shus rang srog blos btang zhing /gung khran tang mi dang go hrag dmag gi mgo khrid pas rgyal khab kyi don du tha ma 'i khrag thig gcig phul/ war sa mi dmangs kyi dpa' ngar ldan pa'i bya 'gul ni yo rob gling mi dmangs kyis h+pha shi si la ngo rgol byed pa'i sto bas kyi mig dpe zhig red/yo rob gling mi dmangs kyis h+pha shi si la ngo rgol byed pa'i 'thab rtsod de gong nas bshad pa'i rgyal khab de dag du spel bar ma zad/ rgyal khab gzhan dag gis kyang gcig rjes gnyis mthud du spel/ dper na/ 1943lo'i zla 2par/ no we (77)mi dmangs kyis skabs der 'jar man h+pha shi sis no we nas btsugs pa'i rdul phran mtshon cha bzo byed kyi ljid chu bzo grwa gtor zhing /lo gcig gi rjes nas yang bskyar 'jar jag gis ljid chu 'jar man la skyel ba'i 'char ga'i la'ang gtor brlag byas/ je khe si lo wa khe mi dmangs kyis h+pha shi sir ngo rgol byed pa'i 'thab rtsod khrod yig li wu'u si byu'u chi khi /hālko/

6lo 'i༅༅)lta bu'i h+pha shi si la ngo rgol byed pa'i dpa' bo zhig byung / yigathu'u chi khis mi'i rigs la rin thang gzhal du med pa'i snying stobs de 〈'gag gsod gtong rdang 'og gi snyan zhu〉ces pa bris/ gzhan yang ro ma ni ya dang / po ka ri ya/ ho lan/ per krim/ 'jar man/ dbyi tha li sogs rgyal khab kyi mi dmangs thams cad kyis h+pha shi si la ngo rgol byed pa'i 'thab rtsod khrod nyams pa med pa'i byas rjes bzhag

sa bcad bcu gcig pa/ mna' 'brel rgyal khab kyi dmag 'khrug rjes kyi 'dzam gling gi bkor+sha sgrig skor/(gcig) su'u me dbyin rgyal khab gsum gyi mo si kho'i phyi 'brel pu'u grang gi chogs 'du/'dzam gling dmag 'khrug gnyis pa de ches dka' khag che ba'i dus skabs brgyud de 1943lor thon rjes/ mna' mthun rgyal khab la rgyal kha thob pa'i re ba'i skya rengs shar yong / de'i mtshon rtags ni a h+phe ri kha'i g.yul sa'i a la man g.yul 'gyel la rgyal kha thob pa dang / mna' mthun dmag dpung a h+phe ri kha byang ma nas skam sar bud thub par ma zad/ 'khor nye'i rgyalatab kyi dmag dpung a h+phe ri kha nas phyir ded pa dang / mna' mthun rgyal khab kyi dmag dpung gis zhi zhi li gling phran bzung pa/ ma'o so li nyi go sa nas lhung pa/ a me ri ga'i dmag dpung gis zhi bde rgya mtsho'i g.yul sa nas krung thu'u to gling phran dang kwa dar kha na'i g.yul 'gyel la rgyal kha thob pa/khyad par du su'u dmag la si ta lin ki li nas rgyal kha chen po thob pa sogs kyis mtshon yod/ gong gi rgyal kha 'di dag 'dzam gling dmag 'khrug gnyis pa'i 'gyur mtshams gyur yod/'on kyang / rgyal kha thob la nye skabs mna' mthun rgyal khab bar nas phan tshun yid ches mi byed ba'i nyams nyen rim bzhin lhang la bud ༵ byed/
