krung gor btsan 'dzul byed pa'i 'ja' dmag gi spyi khyab bkod 'doms pa dang tshun nying tshis nan cin nasamago sgur ba'i yoge'i thog ming rtags 'god pa/mang / 1931lo'i dgu ba'i tshes bco brgyad nyin gyi dus 'gyur nas 1945lor 'ja' phan btsan 'dzul pa mgo btags pa'i bar gyi lo bcu bzhi'i ring / krung go'i mi khri tsho stong gcig lhag dmag 'khrug nang shi ba dang /dpal 'byor gyi gyong gud la a skor dung phyur 600lhag byung /krung go'i mi dmangs las gzhan da dung 'ja' phan h+pha shi si'i rdog rdzis 'og tshud pa'i e she ya rgyal khab so so'i mi dmangs kyis kyang / 1945lo'i dbyar khar mna' mthun rgyal khab la gzhogs 'degs byas nas 'ja' dmag la phar rgol byas te/ mes rgyal bcings 'grol byed pa'i gzi brjid ldan pa'i las don la rang rang gi byas rjes bzhag kho tsho'i dpa' bo'i mdzad rjes kyang h+pha shi sir ngo rgol byed pa'i 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis par rgyal kha thob pa'i lo rgyus deb ther du bkod pa red/khro zhan byang ma mi dmangs kyis cin ri khrin gyi mgo khrid 'og yun ring 'gog rgol byed pa rgyun 'khyongs byas shing / mi dmangs kyis drag po'i 4rdozlos

shugs gong spel dang stobs shugs che ru btang nas dgra bor rgyun ma chad par rdungadeg byas te/ khro zhan mi rigs kyi bcings 'grol 'thab rtsod la mjug mtha'i rgyal kha thob par rmang gzhi bskrun/ 1945lo'i zla 8tshes 9nyin/ su'u len gyis dmag dpung btang nas 'ja' phan la dmag 'khrug byed pa'i nang zhugs rjes/ khro zhan mi dmangs gsar brje'i dmag dpung gis cin ri khrin gyi sdugo khrid zlog su'u dmag la gzhogs 'degs byas te khro zhan gyi byang phyogs ba nga~X trī na~X /sdu/nan)nas hin rdu kri na gung khran tang gis 'ja' phan gyis gleng med du mgo btags pa thos rjes/ mna' mthun dmag dpung la gzhogs 'degs byas nas we the nam rgyal nang du song ste/ thog mar 'os langs byas nas btsan 'dzul pa'i lag nas srid dbang phyir len pa thag bcad/ zla 8pa'i tshes 16nyin/ we the nam gyis hu'u kri min kru'u zhi byas pa'i mi rigs bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang dang gnas skabs srid gzhung btsugs/ zla 8pa'i tshes 19nyin/ ho ne+e nas mang tshogs khri bcus 'os langs chen po byas te btsan 'dzul pa'i lag nas rgyal sa'i srid dbang phyir 'phrogaho de'i rjes nas hrin hwa (77)dang zhi gung (por+sā)sogs grong khyer gyi mi dmangs 'os langs la'ang snga gzhug tu rgyal kha thob/ zla phyed tsam gyi ring la yo nan gyi brgyad pa'i gsar brje la mgyogs myur tu rgyal yongs kyi khyab khongs nas rgyal kha thob/ zla 9ba'i tshes lhanyin/ hu'u kri min gyis ho ne'i pa thin thang chen nas mang tshogs khri tsho lnga bcu yod pa'i tshogs chen thog 66sge tshugs bsgrags yig ’ sgrog 'don byas pa dang / we the nam dmangs gtso spyi mthun rgyal khab dngos su btsugs pa khyab bsgrags byas/mna' mthun rgyal khab kyis 1945lo'i lo stod du 'bar ma nas phar rgozhi ni/ mgo brtsams te/ zla 3pa'i nang yang hran (77)gyis mgo khrid

byas pa'i 'bar ma'i rgyal dmangs dmag gis man te li (477)nas sngon la 'os langs byas pa dang / dmangs yongs kyis 'ja' 'gog 'os langs byed mgo brtsams / zla lnga ba'i tshes 1nyin/ 'bar ma mi dmangs kyis rgyal sa rong kong bcings 'grol byas pa dang / mna' mthun dmag dpung la gzhog 'degs byas te 'ja' phan btsan 'dzul ba 'bar ma nas mthar skyod btang /yin na'ang dbyin ji'i dmag dpung gis 'bar ma mi dmangs kyi rgyal kha'i 'bras bu 'phrog pa red/ma le ya mi dmangs kyis lo gsum lhag ring gi dka' spyad 'gog rgol brgyud nas rgyal yongs kyi phyed ka yan chad kyi zhing sde'i sa khul bcings 'grol byas/ 'ja' phan gyis mgo btags pa khyab bsgrags byas rjes/ ma le yar btsan 'dzul byed pa'i 'ja' dmag gis mgo mi 'dogs par mu mthud nas 'chikha'i 'phag 'tshag byas kyang / ma le ya mi dmangs kyis de dag snying rje med par tshar bcad nas/ rang gi mnga' khongs yongs rdzogs bcings 1grol hās kyang / dbyin ji'i mi ser spel yul gyi dbang bsgyur slar yang phyir na pa h+pha r+sha si/ la ngo rgol byed pa'i dmag 'khrug la rgyal kha thob pa'i skya rengs shar la nye ba'i skabs su/ hin nyi gung khran tang gis mgo khrid byed pa'i h+pha shi si la ngo rgol byed pa'i gzhon nu'i rtsa 'dzugs kyis hin nyi sgor tshugs byed pa'i go skabs legs po zhig la thon pas/ btsan 'dzul ba'i 4 sbyin par mi sgug par rang gis sger tshugs brtson len byed dgos par bsam/ nyin nyi gung khran tang gis e ti (4ma'i)sogs mngags nas su'u ca no dang ha ta sogs la 'brel gtugs byas/ su'u ca no dang ha ta gnyis ni skabs der 'ja' phan gyi mis btsugs pa'i 6 nyin di nyi zhi ya'i sger tshugs gra sgrig zhib dpyod tshogs pa ’ yi kru'u zhi gtso bo dang gzhon pa gnyis yin/ zla 8pa'i tshes 17315/3ya

ca ta'i mang tshogs khrom lam du bud nas rgyal sa phyir 'phrog gsar brje'i rnam pa 'phel rgyas su 'gro bar gzhigs nas su'u ca no sger tshugs bsgrags gtam spel te nyin nyi sger tshugs byed par 'thad pa byung /e she ya rgyal khab so so'i zla 8pa'i snga gzhug gi ldog rgol chen po des/'ja' phan h+pha shi sir mjug mtha'i rdung deg btang bar ma zad/ h+pha shi si la ngo rgol byed pa'i 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa'i mjug mtha'i rgyal kha thob pa je mgyogs su btang / der ma zad e she ya rgyal khab so so'i mi dmangs kyi mi rigs sger tshugs yong bar rmang gzhi blos 'khel ba bskrun/(drug) 'ja' phan btsan 'dzul pa mgo btags pa dang /'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa mjug sgrol/a me ri gas 'ja' phan la rdul phran mtshon cha g.yugs pa dang / su'u len gyis dmag dpung btang nas 'ja' phan la dmag 'khrug rgyag par zhugs pa/ krung go dang e she ya'i rgyal khab so'i mi dmangs kyis 'gog rgol chen po bslangs pa des 'ja' phan 'gro lam med pa'i gnas la bskyal ba dang /h+pha shi si'i mgo gte la skrag snang skyes/ su'u len gyis dmag dpung btang nas dmag 'khrug la zhugs pa dang / a me ri gas khrang chi la rdul phran mtshon cha gnyis pa g.yugs pa'i zla 8pa'i tshes 9nyin gyi lnga dror/ 'ja' phan srid gzhung gis brel 'tshub ngang ches mtho'i dmag 'khrug mdzub ston gros tshogs 'tshogs te/ 〈po tshi than bsgrags gtam nyidang len byed min la gros bsdur byas/ gros tshogs thog bsam 'char phyogs gnyis la chad pas gros thog gas/ ༵ 'jog ma thub pa red/ phyi 'brel blon chen tung zhang ma'o te 'thus

tshab byas pa'i phyogs khag gis 'ja' phan gyi rgyal po'i lam lugs sor bzhag byed chog pa'i cha rkyen 'og 〈po tshi than bsgrags gtam 〉dang len byed pa'i 'dod tshul bzung / skabs der dbu bzhugs blon chen len mu'u yang mgo 'dogs par 'thad cing / khos bya thabs med pa'i ngang nas 6 nye 'khor gyi gnas bab la bltas na po tshi than gyi bsgrags gtam dang len mi byed ka med red mi ces bshad/ skam dmag gi blon chen a nan we ci dang / skam dmag gi blo 'don dmag dpon mes cin mes kri leng (choṭhar+sā766)/ cun lin pu'u tsong krang h+phin then krin tshi leng (༈rjeyomajo'i)bcas 'thus tshab byas pa'i phyogs khag gis skabs der (po tshi than bsgrags gtam 〉dang len byed mi zer ka med byung yang / de la cha rkyen bzhi bton pa ni/ (1)'ja' phan gyi rgyal po'i lam lugs la srung skyob byed pa khag theg byed dgos/ (2)dmag 'khrug nyes can rnams 'ja' phan srid gzhung rang gis thag gcod rgyu/ (3)'ja' phan rang nyid kyis dmag gras nas phyir 'bud pa'i byed thabs kyis rang 'gul sgos drag chas med pa byed rgyu/(4)mna' mthun dmag dpung gis 'ja' phan bzung mi chog pa dang / gal srid de ltar byed ma thub na mna' mthun dmag dpung nyung nyung zhig las 'ja' phan la mi yong ba dang / yong na'ang tho khe yor mi yong pa byed dgos/ de ltar phyogs gnyis gas rtsod gleng byas nas phyogs gcig gis kyang 'grig thabs ma byas pa red/dbu bzhugs blon chen lin mus lta tshul gcig gyur ma byung bar brten pyinas ches mtho'i dmag don gros tshogs de gnas skabs 'tshogs mtshams 'jog pa dang / phyi dro srid 'dzin las khungs kyi gros tshogs 'tshogs te myur zer gleng med du mgo 'dogs rgyu yin nam mu mthud nas dmag 'khrug byed pa'i gnad don la gros bsdur byed pa'i bsam 'char bton/ srid 'dzin las khungs kyi bsam 'char yang khag gnyis la chad nas gros thog ga//kā la

'jog ma thub pa red/ der brten dbu bzhugs blon chen lin mus gros tshogs 'tshogs mtshams bzhag nas gnad don rgyal bor zhus te smyo rgyal pos smra ba lan gcig ’ byed par bsgrags/nyin de'i dgong mor rgyal po'i pho brang gi mkha' zon dong nang nas sku mdun gros tshogs 'tshogs/ dbu bzhugs blon chen lin mus gros tshogs la mgo 'dzin byas/ khos thog mar rgyal bor 'ja' phan srid gzhung gis 〈po tshi than bsgrags gtam 〉dang len byed rtsis yod mod/ 6 gong gi bsgrags gtam du sku nyid ches mtho'i dbang bsgyur pa byed pa'i rgyal po'i bka' dbang tshud par byed dgos ’ shes zhus pa na/ phyi 'brel blon chen tung zhang gis de la gsal bshad byas nas/ dus skabs 'dir 'ja' phan gyis 〈po tshi than bsgrags gtam 〉dang len byed pa las 'os med/ rgyal khab kyi gnas bab bdag srung byed dgos pa'i re ba las 'don mi rung / rgyal bo'i lam lugs gnas thub na 'ja' phan mi rigs bskyar dar yong pa'i re ba yod pa red ces bshad rjes/ skam dmag blon chen a nan gyis 6 de gtan nas mi chog drag chas dmag dpung la rang gi sa cha nas dmag 'khrug thengs gcig rgyag pa'i spobs sems gra ma nyams par yod/ nga tsho'i cha rkyen bzhi bo tshang ma khas blangasan ma gtogs/ nga tshos mu mthud nas 'thab 'dzing byed pa las 'os med ces bshad/ dmag don blo 'don dmag dpon mes cin dang /dmag bka'i las khungs kyi dmag dpon h+phin then sogs kyis a nan gyi bsam 'char rgyun 'khyongs byas/phyogs gnyis gas rtsod gleng byas pa'i don de nyin dkar mi zhig gis rgyal bor zhus yod pas/ mtshan mo'i sku mdun tshogs 'du'i thog rgyal po yos rin (lko42)gyis 6 gnas tshul gyi rgyus gsal bor lon mipa'i sgo nas rgyal khapa snro6 gnas bab srung thub pa'i cha rkyen 'og 6 po tshi than bsgrags gtam

dang len byed pa'i 6 dbang thag bcad/ mi khros 6 spyi nas min kri rgyal pos rgyal khab gsum gyis the gtogs byed skabs ①bka' thag bcad pa la dpe bltas nas dbang thag gcod dgos mishes bshad/zla 8pa'i tshes 10nyin/ 'ja' phan srid gzhung gis bar sdod rgyal khab su'o tser dang su'e ten gnyis kyi srid gzhung brgyud nas krung go dang / a me ri ga dbyin ji/ su'u len bcas mna' mthun rgyal khab bzhi la yi ge bskur te/ 〈po tshi than bsgrags gtam 〉dang len byed 'dod kyang / tsa 'ja' phan dze+e /rjo snaX pa/ dalugs mu mthun nas bzhag chog pa'i mi bka' 'khrol zla 8pa'i tshes 10nyin/ tu'u lu'u min gyis skud med glog 'phrin las 'ja' phan gyis mna' mthun rgyal khab la bskur ba'i yi ge'i don shes rjes/de ma thag tu rgyal srid blon chen per na si dang / skam dmag gi pu'u krang hri tin hrin/ mtsho dmag gi pu'u krang h+phu le si the dang mtsho dmag gi hrang cang dmag dpon li he (45nyornga)bcas bos yong nas gros sol byas/ tu'u lu'u min gyis de dag la re re bzhin bsam 'char dris/ hri tin hrin gyis rgyal po'i lam lugs rang sor bzhag na a me ri kur phan pa yod par bshad/su'o tser srid gzhung gis khyer yong ba'i 'ja' phan gyi yi ge dngos su mthong rjes/ a me ri gas yang bskyar krung go dang / dbyin ji/ su'u len srid gzhung bcas kyi bsam 'char bsdu len byas/ rgyal khab gsum po'i srid gzhung gis de la 'thad pa yin tshul bshad rjes/ zla 8pa'i tshes 11nyin/ a me ri gas mna' mthun rgyal khab kyi tshab byas te 'ja' phan srid gzhung la gsum ni /gākā / k+shi sna blo/shā /shā nikhrakā gā sdo rdosnaskru /shā 〉ngatu /nga ཿrdo 1 ཿ sdo/1smi swā :ltaḥswā pa(sdo zad du bcug 0bstan/ 457

tsa mgo btags pa'i dus nas bzung 'ja' phan gyi rgyal po dang 'ja' phan srid gzhung gis nges par tu mna' mthun rgyal khab kyi ches mtho'i dmag spyi'i bka' dang len byed dgos pa dang / lha 'ja' phan srid gzhung gi mtha' mjug gi rnam pa ni po tshi than bsgrags gtam gzhir bzung ste/ 'ja' phan mi dmangs kyis rang dbang gis bsam 'char bton pa'i 'dod blo la bstun dgos ’ shes lan btab/ zla 8pa'i tshes 13nyin/ 'ja' phan du sdod pa'i se'i ten gyi gzhung tshab kyis mna' mthun rgyal khab kyi lan glog 'phrin gyi lam nas rgyal sa tho khe yo la btang /zla 8pa'i tshes 14nyin/ 'ja' phan srid gzhung gis yang bskyar sku mdun tshogs 'du 'tshogs te/ mjug mthar mna' mthun rgyal khab kyi lan la gros mol byas/ dbu bzhugs blon chen lin mu'u yar yong nas 6 'di nas yang sku nyid la bka' thag gcod pa'i 'o brgyal zhig zhu rgyu yod/ sku nyid kyis ngo rgol byed mkhan gyi bsam 'char la gsan rjes da gzod bka' 'bebs par zhu mi zhes bshad/ skam dmag blon chen a nan gyis ngu ngag bton nas mgo 'dogs par gtan nas mi 'thad tshul bshad/ a nan gyis gtam bshad rjes rgyal bos grags 'gul ci yang med pa'i tshogs rar skor lta zhig byas rjes/ dal mor gtam bshad/ 6 ngas bltas na dmag 'khrug mu mthud du brgyab na 'grig rgyu ma red rgyal khab gyi gnas bab skor la sems khral byed pa der gnas lugs yod mod/ pha rol ba'i gsal bshad la bsam shes byed pa'i don ldan pa red/ gang ltar yang ngas de bden pa yin min la lta 'dod med/ nga rang nyid ci ltar byas rung zhes bshad nas 'dir thon skabs/ rgyal po'i skad 'dar zhing mig mtha' nas shor grabs yod pa'i mig chu bkag skabs der tshogs 'dir zhugs mkhan rnams kyis ma/shā ḍi skad chen pos ngu ngag bton pas/ sngon chad dmag gi las la rngam

nas mgo thog na gnam las med pa'i h+pha shi si btsan 'dzul pas kho tsho'i mtha' mjug 'di lta bu'i yid skyo dgos pa zhig yin pa gang nas shes/ rgyal bos dbang thag bcad rjes/ dbu bzhugs blon chen lin mus 66mgo 'dogs zhu ba'i yi ge zhig bris/ nyin de'i dgong mor yos rin gyis 6 mgo 'dogs zhu yig mi sgrog 'don byas pa'i sgra blangs/ zla 8pa'i tshes 15nyin/ 'ja' phan gyis 6 dmag 'khrug mtshams 'jog pa'i mi yi ge bsgrags/ nyin der lo brgyad cur bud yod pa'i lin mus 6 dmag 'khrug mtshams 'jog mi pa'i las 'gan 'grub rjes/ rgyal por go gnas las 'bab pa'i yi ge phul/ zla 8pa'i tshes 17nyin/ rgyal rgyud kyi khongs mi tong cig ler (lkolkoṣ+ṭha)chin wang gis dbu bzhugs blon chen khur pa dang / rkang ba mi bde ba'i krong kong khes (r+sā70)phyi 'brel blon chen khur/ srid 'dzin las khungs btsugs rjes myur bar rgyal rgyud kyi khongs mi gsum phyi rgyal la mngags nas 'ja' dmag la rgyal bos phab pa'i mgo 'dogs bka' khyab bsgrags/ zla 8pa'i tshes 19nyin/ blo 'don dmag dpon tshab ma krung cang dmag dpon hi pin hu'u si leng (77 khrakhyukhyo)gtso byas pa'i 'thus tshab tshogs pa ma nyi lar (677)song nas/mna' mthun dmag dpung 'ja' phan la yong ba dang mgo btags ming rtags ji ltar 'god dgos pa sogs la gros mol byas/ 'di nas bzung ste zla 9ba'i zla dkyil bar/ e she ya'i shar lho'i rgyal khab khag dang zhi bde rgya mtsho'i gling phran so so/ krung go dang khro zhan sogs la bkrams yod pa'i 'ja' phan btsan 'dzul dmag dpung khri tsho 330lhag gis snga gzhug tu mna' mthun rgyal khab la mgo btags/ zhi bde rgya mtsho'i a ri'i dmag dpung gi spyi'i dmag dpon me khi a sug ni krung go dang / a me ri ga dbyin ji/ su'u len bcas mna' mthun rgyal 459

'u zhe khab khag gi btsan bzung byed pa'i cho ༷4 na — — 3 ci thu paX — dmag dpung gi dmag spyi byas/ zla ngh+ru ga ci 2— 3 sku zhu shā zu r+sā — — 8pa'i tshes 26nas bzung ste/— tsho ༷ nga /7 6 dī —mi dmag gru sna tshogs 383yod pa'i gyi kā na ci gle dmag gru ru khag chen po zhig tho khe yo thu ga ga yang (5 mi mtsho khug tu thon/ zla 8pa'i tshes 28nyin/ a me ri ga'i mdun bskyod tsho dmag dpung tho khe yo'i nye 'dabs kyi gnam gru 'bab thang du babs/ tshes 30nyin/ me dbyin gyi dmag dpung 'bor chen 'ja' phan gyi sa thog la gna' 'brel dmag gi spyi khyab bud/ nyin der/ me khi a sug miling me khu tshosug gnam grur bsdad nas tho khe yor thon cing / gnam gru las 'bab skabs me khi a sug gis gdong la nyi shel zhig gon zhing / kha nang du sbug gu ring po'i gang zag las du ba 'then pa/ brang dgye dgye byas nas gnam gru'i skas thung de las kyang thengs gnyis la 'bab mtshams bzhag ste/ snang ba mthon po'i ngang 66nga ched las dmag mi zhig gis mi grangs khri tsho stong tsho brgyad kyi dmangs srid 'gan khur dang de dag la yongs su tshod 'dzin byed dbang yod ces bshad/ me khi a sug tho khe yor thon pa'i las don thog ma ni tho khe yo'i rgyang bsgrags la do dam byed rgyu dang / rang gi gsar 'gyur cu 'dzugs rgyu de yin/1945lo'i zla 9ba'i tshes 2nyin gyi snga dro'i chu tshod bcu'i thog tho khe yo'i mtsho khug nas a me ri ku'i 6 mes su'u li (smyo1nya'ispri1) mirtags can gyi gnam gru 'dīrdo sa'i dmag gru'i thog 'ja' phan gyis dngos su mgo btags pa'i

mdzad sgo 'tshogs/ krong kong khes 'ja' phan gyi rgyal bo yos rin dang 'ja' phan srid gzhung gi tshab byas pa dang / mes cin mes kri leng gis 'ja' phan gyi dmag spyi khang gi tshab byas te/ a ri dang / krung go dbyin ji/ su'u len bcas mna' mthun rgyal khab kyi 'thus mi'i mdun nas 'ja' phan gyis dngos su mgo btags pa'i ming rtags bkod/ 'ja' phan 'thus tshab tshogs pa'i khongs mi ca le con yas (meX ṣ+ṭha )gyis skabs de'i gnas tshul dngos bris pa 'di lta ste/ 6 gru gzings chung chung myur bar dmag gru'i 'gram du thon pa red/ nga tsho 'khar ba bzung ba'i 'theng bo krong kong khe yi sne khrid 'og dmag gru'i skas thog la 'gos/ khos skas rkang gcig yar 'gos na'ang rngam pa zhig 'then/ nga tsho mi 11po dmag gru'i g.yas phyogs kyi gru thog la thon rjes shar mo gsum byas nas bsgrigs/ tsog tse zhig gi bar chod de mna' mthun rgyal khab kyi 'thus mi'i phyogs su 'khor/ tsog tse'i thog ras ljang gu zhig bkab yod la/ de'i thog tu mgo 'dogs zhu yig dkar po bzhag yod/ ngas dmag 'khrug pham yang mgo 'phang bstod snyam kyang / de ltar byed dka' mo yin te/ dus tshod skar ma gcig la'ang dus rabs du ma 'gor ba'i 'du shes yod ’ ces bshad/ 'ja' phan gyi 'thus mis ming rtags bkod rjes mna' mthun dmag dpung dang mna' mthun rgyal khab kyi 'thus mis ming rtags bkod/ me khi a sug gis mna' mthun dmag dpung gi tshab byas te thog mar ming rtags bkod/ khos smyug gu lnga brjes nas ming rtags bkod cing / sprug gu lnga bo'i nang gi bzhi so sor a me ri ku'i yig tshags khang dang / kho'i ma yum slob grwa ste zhi ten dmag gi slob grwa 'ja' phan gyis 'dzin bzung byas myong ba'i a ri'i dmag dpon zhig dang dbyin ji'i dmag dpon zhig bcas la byin/ gcig ni kho rang gi skye dman la byin/ a me ri ku'i tshab byed mkhan ni mtsho dmag gi hrang cang dmag dpon mes nyi tshi ༵/ pa

khyod shi nga gson gyi dmar 'dzing drag po zhig yin zhing / mjug mthar 'dzam gling gi h+pha shi si la ngo rgol byed pa'i stobs shugs la rgyal kha thob nas mjug sgril ba red/ 'jar man dang 'ja' phan dbyi tha li bcas h+pha shi si'i rgyal khab gsum gyis bslangs pa'i thengs 'di'i dmag 'khrug gi dmigs yul ni/'dzam gling gi khyab khongs su sger sdem gyi bran tu bkol ba'i lam lugs 'dzugs 'dod de red/ der brten 'dzam gling mi dmangs kyi h+pha shi si la ngo rgolabyed pa'i dmag 'khrug ni drang bden gyi dmag 'khrug cig yin/ h+pha shi si'i 'khor lte'i rgyal khab rnams kyis re zhig la btsan drag che tshul du yo rob gling dang / e she ya gling / a h+phe ri kha skam sa chen po bcas nas mi byed dgu byed byas mod/ dmag 'khrug gi ngo bos kho tshor blo khog gtod mkhan med pas/h+pha shi sis bslangs pa'i btsan 'dzul dmag 'khrug la 'dzam gling gi rgyal khab so po'i mi dmangs kyis 'gog rgol drag po byed nges red/ bden don med na rogs ram byed mkhan med pa ltar 'jar man dang / 'ja' phan/ dbyi tha li bcas h+pha shi si'i btsan 'dzul pa dag lo rgyus kyi 'khor los mnan nas rdul du brlag 'dzam gling rgyal khab so so'i mi dmangs rnams kyis mnyam gcig tu h+pha shi si la ngo rgol byed pa'i 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa'i nang mi'i rigs kyi lo rgyus la le tshan gsar ba zhig bsnan/ h+pha shi si la ngo rgol byed pa'i stobs shugs la rgyal kha thob pa des/ h+pha shi si 'khor lte'i rgyal khab kyi 'dzam gling bran g.yog tu bkol ba'i 'char gzhi nag po de rdul du brlag pa dang /de las 'dzam gling mdun du gom pa chen po zhig spos shing / zla bcu ba'i spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi gsar brje'i rjes nas mi'i rigs kyi lo rgyus thog gi lam tshad 'dzin pa'i rdo ring gal chen zhig red/h+pha shi si la ngo rgol byed pa'i stobs shugs la 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa'i khrod nas rgyal kha thob pa des/ 'dzam gling lo rgyus kyi 'phel 4rdopyis

la shugs rkyen zab mo thebs/ thengs 'di'i dmag 'khrug gi mjug 'bras kyis 'dzam gling khyab khongs kyi chab srid stobs shugs kyi bsdur tshad dang rgyal spyi'i 'brel ba la bsgyur bcos chen po thob/ 'jar man dang 'ja' phan/dbyi tha li bcas h+pha shi si'i rgyal khab gsum po rtsa ba nas thor zhig tu gyur dang /dbyin h+pha sogs nub phyogs kyi rgyal khab stobs ldan rnams nyams dmas su btang ba/ me su'u rgyal khab gnyis dmag 'khrug gi rjes nas stobs ldan du gyur nas mjug mthar 'gal zlar gyur pa bcas kyi mjug 'bras byung /'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis par rgyal kha thob pa des spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi stobs shugs che ru phyin pa dang / mi rigs bcings 'grol gyi las don la dbyar mtsho rgyas pa bzhin gong du 'phel bar dngos yod kyi 'gro lam phyes/ mtho tse tung gis che zla bcu ba'i gsar brjes 'dzam gling yongs kyi bzo ba'i gral rim dang gnya' gnon myong pa'i mi rigs kyi bcings 'grol las don la rgya che zhing 'grub thub pa'i rang bzhin yod pa'i dngos yod 'gro lam phyes pa yin na/ h+pha shi si la ngo rgol byed pa'i 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis par rgyal kha thob pa des/ 'dzam gling yongs kyi bzo ba'i gral rim dang gnya' gnon myong ba'i mi rigs kyi bcings 'grol las don la sngar las lhag par 'grub thub pa'i rang bzhin yod pa dang sngar las lhag pa'i dngos yod kyi 'gro lam phyes pa red ces gsungs/ 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis par rgyal kha thob pa des btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi mi ser spel yul gyi sgrig gzhi 'thor mgo tshugs shing /krung go dang / khro zhan/ we the nam bcas e she ya'i rgyal khab dang / yu ko si la wi ya/ pho lan/ ce khe si lo wa khe/ ro ma ni ya/ hang ga ri/ pur ka ri ya/ar pa ni ya sogs yo rob gling gi shar phyogs kyi rgyal khab dag la gung khran tang gis mgo khrid byas nas btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi dbang bsgyur gyi sgrog ladi zlor te/ mi dmangs kyi srid dbang btsugs pa dang / spyi tshogs ring

lugs 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i lam du bskyod/ de dang mnyam du 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis par rgyal kha thob pa'i shugs rkyen 'og ye she ya dang / a h+phe ri kha/ la nyin me gling sogs sa khul nas mi rigs bcings 'grol las 'gul gyi mtho rlabs langs shing / rgya gar dang / 'bar ma/ hin nyi/ h+phe li phen/ e cib/ ar ci ri ya/ su'u tan sogs rgyal khab 'bor chen zhig sger tshugs kyi lam la song / 1945lor mnyam 'brel rgyal khab 'dzugs skabs/ zhugs mkhan gyi rgyal khab 51las med mod/ 1981lor slebs dus mnyam 'brel rgyal khab kyi khongs gtogs rgyal khab 156yod/ mi rigs bcings 'grol las 'gul gyis btsan rgyal ring lugs dang mi ser spel yul ring lugs kyi stobs shugs kyi khyab khongs je chung du btang bas/ deng skabs kyi 'phel rgyas 'gro bzhin pa'i rgyal khab dar bar rmang gzhi bskrun/'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pas mi'i rigs kyi dpal yon dang rgyu nor la gtor brlag tshabs chen bzos mod/ 'on kyang deng rabs kyi tshan rig lag rtsal gyi 'phel rgyas la yang skul 'ded chen po byas/ phas kyi rgol ba las rnam par rgyal ched shar phyogs dang nub phyogs kyi rgyal khab so so'i dmag don gyi tshan rig lag rtsal dang dmag don la 'brel ba yod pa'i tshan rig lag rtsal de dmag 'khrug gi skabs su ha las rgyu yod pa'i 'phel rgyas byung zhing /deng rabs can gyi sngon thon mtshon cha skor zhig byung ba ni/ dper na/ rdul phran mtshon cha dang / rlung 'bud gnam gru/ le ta/ 51 72/ h+phe tan('phur mda'i thog ma)/ mtsho 'og dmag gru gsar ba/ gnam gru 'bab sa'i mtsho gru ban khe sogs lta bu red/ dmag 'khrug mjug sgril ba dang bstun nas/ dmag 'khrug gi dus skabs la 'phel rgyas byung pa'i sngon thon gyi dmag don tshan rig lag rtsal dang dmag don bzo las 'bor chen dmangs bkol dngos rdzas kyi phyogs su 'khor zhing / rdul phran nus pa'i bzo lastu spyang /

mkha' bskyod bzo las/ glog rdul bzo las sogs gsar tu dar ba'i bzo las 'bor chen byung pas/ shar phyogs dang nub phyogs kyi rgyal khab dag gi khrod nas lo rgyus thog gi bzo las gsar brje gang las kyang rgya che zhing gting zab pa'i tshan rig lag rtsal gyi gsar brje byung ste/ mi'i rigs kyi thon skyed nus pa'i chu tshad ches cher mthor 'degs byung /'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa'i lo rgyus kyi nyams myong las/ h+pha shi si 'dra ba'i gdug rtsub che ba'i dmag 'khrug gi stobs shugs la phul du byung ba'i mi sna 'ga' re dang rgyal khab nyung shas shig gi stobs shugs kyis 'gog mi thub pas/ nges par tu 'dzam gling thog mnyam 'brel byed thub pa'i stobs shugs yod tshad mnyam 'brel byas te/ dgra bor rdung deg dang kher rkyang du gtong thub tshod byed dgos pa bstan/ 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa'i rgyal kha ni rgyal spyi'i h+pha shi si la ngo rgol byed pa'i mna' 'brel gyi rlabs che ba'i rgyal kha yin/ mna' 'brel 'dir zhugs mkhan gyi rgyal khab dag gi steng gi bkod pa dang lam lugs mi mtshungs mod/ h+pha shi si'i btsan 'dzul pa pham par byed pa'irtsi'i dmigs yul gyi 'og nas/ mthun pa yong ci thub dang mi mthun pa sor bzhag byas te/ phan tshun rgyab skyor dang / phan tshun gzhogs 'degs/mnyam du 'thab rtsod bcas byas te/ mjug mthar 'od stong 'bar ba'i rgyal kha thob pa red/ der ma zad rgyal kha 'dis deng skabs 'dzam gling zhi bde'i 'phel rgyas dang / lam lugs mang po mnyam gnas byed thub par yang lo rgyus kyi ma dpe bstan/'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa'i lo rgyus kyi nyams myong gis gting zab po'i sgo nas krang po lun sogs kyis 'grig thub byed pa'i srid jus lag bstar byas te/ btsan 'dzul bar 'i bde yong ba zhu thabs byed pa de'i 'bras buswā shātsan 'dzul pa'i dzig rngam je cher song ba dang / myur bar mgo thog la

dmag 'khrug thon te rang nyid la mjug 'bras ngan pa zhig byung ba gsal bshad byas/'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis par rgyal kha thob pa des da dung / deng rabs can gyi dmag 'khrug la nges par tu dpal 'byor gyi rmang gzhi brtan po zhig dgos pa gsal bshad byas/ sngon thon gyi tshan rig lag rtsal la brten pa'i deng rabs can gyi bzo las dang / deng rabs can gyi zhing las/ deng rabs can gyi rgyal srung bcas med na deng rabs can gyi dmag 'khrug khrod rgyal kha thob mi srid pa red/tsho 467

sa bcad bcu bzhi ba/ mjug gi gtam ste dmag 'khrug nyes can dag gi mjug 'bras/'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa ni gna' nas da bar gyi mi'i rigs kyi lo rgyus thog rnam pa ches rgya che ba'i dmag 'khrug cig yin/ thengs 'di'i dmag 'khrug khrod/ snga gzhug tu dmag 'khrug la zhugs pa'i rgyal khab 61yod pa des/ skabs de'i 'dzam gling mi grangs kyi brgya cha'i brgyad cu zin yod pa red/ thengs 'di'i dmag 'khrug gis snga na med pa'i gtor brlag chen po dang chag sgo chen po bskyal yong / de'i nang du su'u len dang krung go'i mi shi ba ches mang / su'u len gyi mi ha lam khri tsho 2700shi ba dang / krung go'i mi ha lam 3500lhag shi ba red/ dmag 'khrug la zhugs pa'i rgyal khab khag gi rgyu nor gyi 'gro gron dang gtor brlag kyang ha las rgyu yod pa zhig red/ cha tshang min pa'i sdom rtsis ltar na rgyal khab so so'i 'phro brlag tu song ba'i rgyu nor ha lam me sgor dung phyur khri phrag bzhi lhag yod pa red/ pho lan lta bu'i rgyal khab chung ba de la mtshon na'ang 'jar man h+pha shi sis btsan 'dzul dang 'phrog bcom byas rkyen/ rang srog shor ba'i mi grangs khri tsho 6①yod pa dang / gyong gud du gyur pa'i rgyu nor me sgor dung phyur 2①yod pa red/ 'jar man dang 'ja' phan dbyi tha li bcas h+pha shi si'i rgyal khab gsum gyis bslangs pa'i thengs 'di'i 'dzam gling 'khrug chen de mjug mthar h+pha shi si pham pa dang /h+pha shi si la ngo rgol byed pa'i mna' mthun rgyal khab la rgyal kha thob pa nas mjudī /la ba red/ me lag len byed mkhan gyis rang nyid mer bsregs pa ste/

dmag 'khrug 'di slong mkhan gyi mgo gte dang rim pa so so'i dmag 'khrug nyes can rnams la lo rgyus kyi chad pa ljid mo phog gla shi si'i mgo bdag gsum gyi nang gi gnyis te lhas thi li dang ma'o so li nyi gnyis kyi mjug 'bras sdug po sngon nas bshad zin pa ltar/ lhas thi lis rang srog bcad nas bem po bsregs pa dang / ma'o so li nyi dbyi tha li'i mi dmangs kyis gson bzung byas nas srog khrims bcad rjes shi ro mes lan srang lam du dpyangs nas khrom ston byas/ des na 'jar man gyi na tsha'i dmag 'khrug nyes can gtso bo ki len dang / zhi mo le/ hi si sogs dang / 'ja' phan gyi dmag 'khrug nyes can gtso bo tung the'o dbyin ci dang / thu'u h+phe yon zhan ler/ pan yon krin si leng bcas kyi mjug 'bras ci ltar yin pa de dpe deb 'di mjug sgril khar re re bzhin bshad par bya/ thog mar na tsha'i dmag 'khrug gi nyes can rnams kyi gnas tshul bshad na/ na tshas srid gzhung rtsa rdzogs byas rjes/ ki pher gyis thi li dang mnyam du rang srog bcad pa ma gtogs/na tshas srid gzhung rtsa rdzogs byas rjes/ ki pher gyis nyes thi li dang mnyam du rang srog bcad pa ma gtogs/ mna' 'brel dmag dpung mang che ba gson bzung byas/ 1945lo'i zla 11pa'i tshes 20nyin/ nyig lun po rgyal spyi'i dmag don khrimasakhang gis 'jar man gyi na tsha'i dmag 'khrug nyes can gtso bo dag la 'dri gcod byas/ 'dri gcod zla ba bcu'i ring la byas rjes/ 1946lo'izla 9ba'i tshes 30nas zla bcu ba'i tshes 1bar khrims thag bcad pa gsal bsgrags byas/ khrimasakheng gis ki lin (2 cho)dang / li pin the lo phu(tshor+sātshe r+sā)/ khe ther(75lo)/ khar nyin pol na(rdopo ma po)/ ro sin po(706)/ h+pho ling kho(lkoṣ+ṭhakhyim)/ h+pho re khi(747)/ hri thi le khrel(ṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭhaza7)/ se si —dbyin kha the( lo r+sālto7)/ hwakhir(7༵༵)/

yo ter (294ṣ+ṭhapo)bcas nyes can 11la 'gegs gsod kyi khrims thag bcad cing / hi si (7lo)dang/ le dar(tsho po)/ me khi (chom)bcas la tshe btson gyi khrims thag bcad/ si pher (glo po)dang / zhi la hi (tsho 0)gnyis la lo nyi shur btson 'jug byed pa'i khrims thag bcad/ nyig li thi (rgo76)dang / tin nyi tshi (74khuṣ+ṭha)gnyis la so sor lo bco lnga dang lo bcur btson 'jug byed pa'i khrims thag bcad/'gegs gsod byed pa'i khrims de 1946lo'i zla 10ba'i tshes 16nyin gyi zhogs par lag bstar byas/ 'gegs gsod ma byas pa'i chu tshod gnyis kyi sngon la ki len gyis dug sman 'thung nas rang srog bcad/ bshad tshul ltar na khos dug sman lte ba'i 'gram gyi rma shul gyi bu ga zhig tu sbas yod par bshad/ki lin gshags bcos byas myong la/ gshags bcos kyi rjes nas rma shul na bul ga chung bu zhig yod de/ khos dug sman bug ga de'i nang du sbas pa sus kyang ma shes pa red/ 'gegs gsod byed sa ni nyig lun po khrims ra'i nang yin te/ thog mar 'gegs gsod byas pa ni hes thi li'i phyi 'brel pu'u krang li0na the lo phu yin pa dang / 'gegs gsod rjes ma byas pa ni o si khru ri ya'i rgyal btsong ba/ na tshas ho lan la dbang bsgyur byed mkhan nyes can se si —dbyin kha the yin/'ja' phan gyi h+pha shi si'i dmag shed can la'ang snga gzhug tu mjug 'bras ya nga ba thob/ rgyal bo yos rin gyis 6 bka' thag bcad ’ nas (po tshi than bsgrags gtam 〉dang len byed pa khyab bsgrags byas rjes/ skam dmag gi blon chen a nan mgo gte yin pa'i h+pha shi si mkhregs 'dzin byed mkhan phyogs khag gis srid 'gyur bslangs te/ rgyal pos khyab bsgrags byas pa'i mgo btags zhus ba'i yi ge 'phrog te/ zhi bde la mos pa'i phyogs khag 'dzin bdīt+ta byed rgyu dang / rgyal po'i pho brang btsan 'dzin byed pa/ de nas 6 gnam

sras la btsan skul gyis rgyal phran rgyal por bka' 'bebs su bcug nas/kho tshos bshad pa'i 6 rang sa nas shi 'thab byed pa zhes pa de lag len byed rtsisabyas/ phyis su skam dmag gi dmag don blo 'don pa dmag dpon mes cin mes kri leng ma 'thad pas/ kho tsho grag 'gul byed ma phod pa red/ zla 8pa'i tshes 15nyin/ rgyal po'i mgo 'dogs pa'i yi ge khyab bsgrags byas rjes/a nan gyis bsam don ma 'grub pa shes nas rang yul du lto ba gshags nas rangasrog gcod rtsis byas kyang / gri brdab pa srog thog la ma khel bas khos khrag dmar gyi nang nas chu tshod gsum tsam la sdug 'phag byas/ kho'i zhabs phyi ba ci bya gtol med du gyur te phar 'gro tshur 'gro byas nas bsdad kyang /mjug mthar sman pas kho'i dpung ba'i thog khab gcig brgyab pas de mur shi lam du song / skam dmag blon chen a nan gyis rang srog bcad rjes kho dang 'dra bar h+pha shi si dmag rgyal ring lugs kyi bsam blos khengs yod pa'i ngan rengs pa skor zhig ste/ dper na/ sngon gyi spyi gnyer blon chen cin we dang /lin mu'u da 'dzin las khungs kyi blon chen zho chon dang / cho then/ dmag dpon pin then yas kri (cho gyeṣ+ṭha)sogs dmag dpon 10dang / sngon chad zing 'khrug slong bar 'dod pa'i a nan gyi mnga' 'og gi mi kha shas bcas kyis snga gzhug tu a nan la dpe bltas nas rang srog bcad pa red/h+pha shi si'i ngan rengs pa nyung shas sheg gis snga gzhug tu rang srog bcad pa de/ dmag 'khrug slong pa'i gte bo tung the'o dbyin ci la mtshon na 'chi sar lag g.yug byed pa zhig min mi srid pa red/ 'ja' phan gyis mgo btags rjes/ tung the'o ni kun gyis dmod mo byed sa zhig tu gyur/ g.yas phyogs pas ra khos rgyal bo'i don du rang srog gcod dgos mizhes pa dang /dmag 'khrug gi khrod nas gnyen nye shi ba rnams kyis 6 khos lto ba gshags nas rgyal dmangs la nyes sel byed dgos shes gshe gshe btang / tha na tushā sa'i
